‎他们知道狼这种凶猛的动物会捕食绵羊
‎所以  这个比喻让使徒明白
‎传道工作将会遭到很多人的反对
‎耶稣就这样提醒使徒
‎要避开潜在的危险
‎现在我们来考虑一下
‎蛇和鸽子的比喻
‎不管在耶稣的时代
‎还是在今天
‎说一个人像蛇一样
‎听起来都不是称赞的话
‎为什么呢?
‎因为蛇的名声不太好
‎“最初的蛇”为人类带来了巨大的灾难
‎可是  今天的每日经文说
‎“要像蛇一样”
‎耶稣为什么这么说呢?
‎我们要在哪方面像蛇一样呢?
‎根据创世记的描述
‎耶和华上帝所造的动物中
‎蛇是最谨慎的
‎这就是耶稣想要强调的重点
‎耶稣吩咐门徒在传道时需要小心
‎尤其是在面对反对的时候
‎蛇真的很谨慎吗?
‎一说到蛇
‎许多人连看都不想看
‎更别说仔细研究它的特性了
‎所以还是听听一位
‎英国动物学家怎么说的吧
‎他说  甚至在发动攻击时
‎蛇也会非常小心谨慎
‎它会尽量瞄准目标
‎给对方致命的攻击
‎根据这位动物学家的描述
‎蛇会好几次冲向敌人
‎却故意不碰到对方
‎有时甚至连嘴都不张开
‎它在做什么呢?
‎原来它在练习
‎它的确非常谨慎
‎这位动物学家说
‎在反复练习几次后
‎如果蛇意识到对手来势汹汹
‎就可能小心地展开蜷曲的身体
‎以便迅速逃跑
‎蛇真的很谨慎!
‎我们都知道
‎耶稣参与了创造蛇的过程
‎他非常了解蛇谨慎的特性
‎这就是耶稣提醒门徒要培养的特质
‎尤其在面对猛烈反对的时候
‎我们就更需要谨慎行事
‎那么  耶稣为什么在比喻中
‎提到鸽子呢?
‎想一想  如果我们只像蛇一样谨慎
‎却没有鸽子的特性
‎传讲好消息时就会缺乏温情
‎所以  我们需要平衡一下
‎那鸽子有什么特性呢?
‎它们看起来就很平和温顺
‎很招人喜欢
‎由于鸽子天性温顺
‎有些人甚至把它们誉为
‎鸟类世界的绵羊
‎所以  圣经描述耶稣的门徒像鸽子一样
‎这多么贴切!
‎但是  如果只有鸽子的温顺
‎而没有蛇的谨慎
‎会怎么样呢?
‎《洞悉》书说
‎“鸽子信任人类”
‎“很容易落入陷阱或网罗  被人捉住”
‎所以  耶稣说“要像蛇一样谨慎”
‎这样  就算我们性情温和
‎也不会因此就被利用
‎也不会轻易落入陷阱
‎现在请打开马可福音第12章
‎我们知道耶稣性情温和
‎像鸽子一样
‎他很温和  仁慈  有同情心
‎不过  他也“像蛇一样谨慎”吗?
‎我们来看看
‎马可福音12:14的最后一句话
‎“纳人头税给凯撒  可以不可以呢?”
‎骄傲的法利赛派给耶稣设了一个圈套
‎企图让耶稣说出对罗马政府不利的话
‎如果耶稣只“像鸽子一样清白无邪”
‎就会马上说
‎“对  应该纳税给罗马政府”
‎法利赛派就会拿这个回答作为把柄
‎激起民众对耶稣的反感
‎那么  耶稣怎样“像蛇一样谨慎”呢?
‎在15-17节  法利赛派问道
‎“我们该纳不该纳?”
‎“耶稣看穿他们的虚伪  就对他们说”
‎“你们为什么试探我?”
‎“拿一个罗马银元给我看”
‎“他们拿了来  耶稣对他们说”
‎“这是谁的像  谁的名号?”
‎“他们说  是凯撒的”
‎“耶稣说  凯撒之物要还给凯撒”
‎“上帝之物要还给上帝”
‎“他们就都敬佩他”
‎如果耶稣只是单纯地说
‎对  要纳税给罗马政府
‎民众就会感到愤怒
‎而不是敬佩他了
‎耶稣非常谨慎
‎避开了这个圈套
‎在什么情况下
‎我们需要谨慎行事呢?
‎其中一个就是  在和别人交谈的时候
‎不要认同或者批评
‎某个政党或政治领袖
‎我们要向耶稣学习
‎要听从罗马书第13章的劝告
‎就算当权者不诚实  腐败
‎或者缺乏能力
‎我们还是要表现尊重
‎有一个弟兄
‎我就不说他是哪个国家的了
‎他最近告诉我
‎对他来说  保持中立最大的挑战
‎就是要避免说出批评当前政府的话
‎我们可能都有同感
‎比如  在和难民交谈时
‎就要特别留意这一点
‎许多国家现在有成千上万的难民涌入
‎这些难民因为遭到政治或种族迫害
‎被迫离开家园
‎他们的内心应该是非常痛苦的
‎他们很想告诉别人
‎迫使他们逃难的政府有多不好
‎我们可以怎样
‎“像鸽子一样”传讲好消息
‎同时又“像蛇一样谨慎”呢?
‎我们需要“像鸽子一样”
‎对难民表现耐心
‎留心听他们说话
‎因为他们可能很想说说自己的遭遇
‎同时  我们也要“像蛇一样谨慎”
‎不要参与政治话题的讨论
‎倒要听从分部的指引
‎用适当的方式分享好消息
‎免得给自己或别人带来麻烦
‎向难民传道时
‎我们也要表现谨慎
‎要留意自己的衣着打扮
‎戴的首饰
‎以免冒犯他们
‎比如  在缅甸
‎如果一位女士穿露肩的衣服
‎就会被视为穿着不合体统
‎因此  在向难民传道时
‎我们要尊重他们的文化和习惯
‎新闻媒体又怎么样呢?
‎我们看新闻时
‎也需要“像蛇一样谨慎”
‎在一些国家
‎媒体是由政府控制的
‎所以  他们的新闻报道很有偏向性
‎有时  他们会针对耶和华见证人
‎做负面报道
‎这些报道明显是捏造的
‎如果一个人只是“像鸽子一样清白无邪”
‎就可能听信这些报道
‎信心开始动摇
‎但如果我们“像蛇一样谨慎”
‎就不会轻易受骗了
‎在那些所谓的自由国家又怎么样呢?
‎他们的媒体值得信赖吗?
‎作为基督徒  我们要小心
‎千万不要受个别媒体的观点影响
‎我们不该采纳新闻报道中的政治观点
‎倒要谨记
‎保罗在提摩太后书1:13的劝勉
‎经文说
‎“这一套健全的话语”
‎“你要怀着因基督耶稣”
‎“而有的信心和爱心  坚守不懈”
‎作为耶稣的门徒
‎我们要听从耶稣
‎在马太福音10:16的话
‎“像蛇一样谨慎”
‎“像鸽子一样清白无邪”

ko.text: ‎노어 형제는 우리가 ‎너무 멀리 이동할 필요가 없도록
‎마침 그 가족이 헛간 일을 마친 터라
‎우린 집에 들어가 같이 커피를 ‎마시고 아침 식사도 함께 했죠.
‎그 가족은 우릴 보면서 ‎‘대체 이 형제들이 여긴 왜 왔을까?’
‎“왕국 농장보다 뉴욕에 더 가까운 곳에 ‎농장을 하나 매입하려 하는데,
‎그 가족은 깜짝 놀라 ‎서로를 쳐다 보다, 우릴 봤죠.
‎노어 형제와 라슨 형제와 ‎제가 이곳에 오는 길이었는데,
‎그때 마침 우리에게 순회 감독자와 ‎지역 감독자 명단이 있었기 때문에,
‎우리에겐 타자기도 없었고, ‎컴퓨터도 없었고, 설계 도면도 없었어요.
‎농장 가옥에다 임시 주방을 차려 ‎카페테리아 식으로 식사를 했는데,
‎형제들은 앉을 곳만 있으면 ‎현관이든 마당이든 어디서든 먹었어요.
‎농장 건물 지하실에서 ‎형제들이 잘 수 있게 했는데,
‎옥수수 창고나 건초 더미 두는 곳 같이
‎25년 이상 전 시간 봉사를 한 브루클린 ‎베델 성원들이 모두 초대되었습니다.
‎프랜즈 형제는 일어나 에덴 동산의 ‎아담과 하와 얘기부터 시작했습니다.
‎지금처럼 낙원과 같은 곳으로 ‎바꿔 놓는 걸 보았습니다.
‎흥미로운 건, 얼마 안 있어 ‎우린 형제들을 외국으로 보내서
‎그리고 뉴욕시에서는 그런 건물을 ‎지을 땅을 살 수도 없었습니다.
‎새 부지를 찾았지만 ‎마땅한 곳을 못 찾고 있었는데,

en.text: Another great example of Jehovah guiding his servants
is the construction of the Wallkill Bethel complex
here in the United States.
Before that location was acquired and built,
the organization owned another property outside of New York City
called Kingdom Farm.
That’s actually where the Gilead School was held at the time.
But the location was not ideal,
so Brother George Couch was assigned to find a new property
that later became Wallkill Bethel.
Brother Couch served at the world headquarters
until his death in 2007.
Please enjoy listening to his account of what happened
—told in a way that only our dear Brother Couch could.
Brother Knorr said in around the early 1960’s sometime
about looking at getting another farm
closer to New York so we didn’t have to travel so far.
So one cold Saturday morning, I called Brother Larson
and I said, “Brother Larson, do you want to take a trip with me?”
He said, “I’ll go with you.”
I didn’t tell him where I was going.
So we came up here to the Gobel place,
and I came up with the intention of asking Brother Gobel
where he’d advise us to look for buying a farm,
and so we got here about ten o’clock.
It was cold.
They had finished the barn work, and we came in the house
and had a cup of coffee and had a bite of breakfast with them.
And, of course, they kept looking at us
wondering, ‘What in the world are you doing up here?’
And so finally we said,
“We’re thinking of getting a farm
“closer to New York than Kingdom Farm
and thought maybe you’d have some ideas,”
and it just stunned them.
They looked at one another, and then they looked at us.
And I thought, ‘What in the world did we say wrong?’
And she said, “You know, yesterday we put this farm up for sale.”
And we were the buyers of it,
but we had no workers.
And so one Tuesday morning,
Brother Knorr and Brother Larson and I
were coming up here to the farm
and we brought up the subject
of where we were going to get help.
Brother Knorr made this suggestion,
“Well, why don’t you bring in some circuit and district overseers
“and call them in for a short time
and have them help?”
And so we had the file with us of the circuit and district overseers,
so on our way up, we picked out 50 circuit and district overseers.
We wrote them a letter and told them
that it was a special assignment;
it would only last about six months.
We didn’t have a typewriter; we didn’t have a computer;
we didn’t have blueprints.
When we started the job,
Brother Dexter Busching bought himself a calculator
to do the stressing and straining —the figuring work on it—
and that’s how we built the building.
The schedule was from daylight to dark.
We set up a temporary kitchen in the farmhouse
and fed cafeteria style, which worked out quite well.
The brothers ate on the porch and out in the yard
—wherever they could sit down.
We got the basement in on the farm building,
and the brothers put beds in there.
So it was makeshift.
We had everything but tents.
And I’d say most of our pick-and-shovel brothers
slept in the corn cribs;
they slept in the haymow;
they slept anywhere they could put a bunk up.
All the brothers at Brooklyn Bethel
with 25 years or more seniority
were invited to come up,
and they had a nice steak meal for us.
Brother Knorr gave the dedication talk,
and then he called on Brother Franz
to say a few words.
And Brother Franz got up,
and he started back in the garden of Eden with Adam and Eve.
And what he was saying was that man started off as a farmer,
and he sort of developed that to a certain extent.
After that, I came up here every week,
no doubt, for the next 10 to 15 years.
I saw the brothers turn this piece of ground
from a junkyard to a paradise it is today.
That started the Society in their construction work
—our own construction work.
Then we built several other buildings after that.
We saw that we could do it.
And the interesting thing is it wasn’t long after that
we started to send the brothers
into foreign lands
to help the brothers build the branch homes, missionary homes,
Kingdom Halls.
Just to be honest with it, we had to get out of New York.
Our buildings weren’t big enough
to take the modern presses;
they weren’t high enough.
The weight limit on buildings wouldn’t hold them.
You couldn’t buy land in New York City
to put up a building like you have there;
it was almost an impossibility.
So there was only one thing to do.
Our presses were old, and we had to replace them.
There was no place in New York to put them.
We looked for land, but we couldn’t find any place.
The Lord just drove us up here.
When you look back over things, sometimes you think,
‘My, someone had some wise thinking
and good foresight.’
No, the Lord’s spirit did.
The Lord is running the organization.
It’s a theocratic organization.
Sometimes it’s surprising where the idea comes from
on what you’re going to do.
Don’t worry about what it’s going to be like after Armageddon.
It will be just the way we want it because the Lord is going to do it.
The Lord didn’t see fit to put it in the Bible.
We don’t need to know now.
We got our hands full now just preaching.
What the Lord has in mind for the future, who knows?

cn.text: ‎‪‎‪耶和华指引他仆人的一个好例子
‎‪‎‪就是在美国华基尔兴建伯特利
‎‪‎‪组织原本在离纽约市很远的地方
‎‪‎‪有一块土地
‎‪‎‪称为“王国农场”
‎‪‎‪当时的基列学校就在那里举行
‎‪‎‪但这个地点不太理想
‎‪‎‪组织就委派乔治·库奇弟兄
‎‪‎‪寻找新的土地
‎‪‎‪就是现在位于华基尔的分部
‎‪‎‪库奇弟兄一直在总部服务
‎‪‎‪直到2007年去世为止
‎‪‎‪我们来听听库奇弟兄以他独特的说话风格
‎‪‎‪描述当时所发生的事
‎‪‎‪在20世纪60年代初
‎‪‎‪诺尔弟兄曾说
‎‪‎‪要找个比较接近纽约市的地方做农场
‎‪‎‪这样我们就不用跑很远
‎‪‎‪后来一个星期六早上
‎‪‎‪那天很冷
‎‪‎‪我打电话给拉尔逊弟兄说
‎‪‎‪“拉尔逊弟兄，你要不要跟我出去走走？”
‎‪‎‪他说：“好，我们走。”
‎‪‎‪我没说要去哪里
‎‪‎‪结果我们去了戈贝尔的家
‎‪‎‪因为我想请教他有关购买农场的事
‎‪‎‪我们10点左右到他家
‎‪‎‪那时很冷
‎‪‎‪戈贝尔一家才刚从农场工作完回来
‎‪‎‪我们进到屋里
‎‪‎‪喝了杯咖啡
‎‪‎‪跟他们一起吃早餐
‎‪‎‪当然，他们一直很好奇地看着我们
‎‪‎‪可能在想
‎‪‎‪你们跑来我家这个小地方
‎‪‎‪到底要做什么啊？
‎‪‎‪后来我们跟他们说
‎‪‎‪我们想买个离纽约市近一点的农场
‎‪‎‪比王国农场更近的地方
‎‪‎‪不知道你们有没有什么好建议？
‎‪‎‪他们听完，就愣了一下
‎‪‎‪彼此看了一眼
‎‪‎‪我心想
‎‪‎‪“我们说错什么了吗？”
‎‪‎‪结果姐妹说
‎‪‎‪我们昨天才决定要把农场卖掉！
‎‪‎‪后来我们就买下他们的农场
‎‪‎‪但问题是我们没有工人
‎‪‎‪一个星期二早上
‎‪‎‪我和诺尔弟兄还有拉尔逊弟兄打算去农场
‎‪‎‪在路上我们聊到要怎么找人来帮忙
‎‪‎‪诺尔弟兄就建议
‎‪‎‪不然就叫一些分区监督和区域监督过来
‎‪‎‪请他们短时间来帮忙一下
‎‪‎‪我们把分区监督和区域监督的名单拿出来
‎‪‎‪结果在去农场的路上就挑了50个监督
‎‪‎‪我们写信给这些监督
‎‪‎‪说有个特别的委派
‎‪‎‪大概只要六个月的时间
‎‪‎‪那时我们没有打字机
‎‪‎‪没有电脑
‎‪‎‪也没有建筑施工图
‎‪‎‪我们开始动工后
‎‪‎‪德克斯特·比兴弟兄就自己买了一台计算机
‎‪‎‪用来计算建筑结构
‎‪‎‪我们就这样把房子盖起来了
‎‪‎‪我们在工地从天亮忙到天黑
‎‪‎‪还在农舍里盖了一间临时的厨房
‎‪‎‪准备一些食物让工作的弟兄自己来领取
‎‪‎‪这样做其实还不错
‎‪‎‪弟兄们拿了食物就到室外的门廊
‎‪‎‪或外面的院子找地方坐着吃
‎‪‎‪那里的农舍有地下室
‎‪‎‪弟兄们就铺床睡在那里
‎‪‎‪反正都是暂时的
‎‪‎‪我们什么都有就是没有帐篷
‎‪‎‪这些努力工作的弟兄
‎‪‎‪有的睡在玉米谷仓里
‎‪‎‪有的睡在干草堆上
‎‪‎‪反正哪里可以睡就睡哪
‎‪‎‪那时在布鲁克林伯特利服务25年以上的人
‎‪‎‪都特别受到邀请来吃牛排大餐
‎‪‎‪诺尔弟兄发表呈献礼演讲
‎‪‎‪他请法兰兹弟兄简单说几句话
‎‪‎‪但法兰兹弟兄却开始演讲
‎‪‎‪从亚当和夏娃在伊甸园里开始说起
‎‪‎‪其实他要说的是人类一开始也是农夫
‎‪‎‪以务农为生
‎‪‎‪结果就越说越长
‎‪‎‪之后我每个星期都去华基尔工作
‎‪‎‪我这样做大概有10至15年的时间吧
‎‪‎‪我看到弟兄们怎样把这鸟不生蛋的荒地
‎‪‎‪变成现在这样美丽的乐园
‎‪‎‪从那时开始组织的建筑都由我们自己包办
‎‪‎‪后来我们也盖了几栋房子
‎‪‎‪我们发现我们是可以做得到的
‎‪‎‪有趣的是，从那之后不久
‎‪‎‪我们就派一些弟兄去国外帮忙盖分部
‎‪‎‪海外传道员之家、王国聚会所
‎‪‎‪但老实说，印刷厂不在纽约市会比较好
‎‪‎‪因为我们纽约的大楼放不下新的印刷机
‎‪‎‪建筑的天花板不够高
‎‪‎‪机器的重量也超过建筑物的承重能力
‎‪‎‪再说，纽约市
‎‪‎‪也找不到那么大的地可以盖印刷厂
‎‪‎‪根本就不可能有！
‎‪‎‪最后解决方法只有一个
‎‪‎‪那时我们的印刷机太旧了
‎‪‎‪要换新的
‎‪‎‪但纽约市没有地方放得下这些印刷机
‎‪‎‪我们想在市区找一块够大的地
‎‪‎‪却怎么样都找不到
‎‪‎‪结果你看
‎‪‎‪上帝就把我们弄到这里啦！
‎‪‎‪回头看看过去发生的事
‎‪‎‪有时你会想
‎‪‎‪哇，哪个人这么聪明
‎‪‎‪这么有远见！
‎‪‎‪都不是
‎‪‎‪是圣灵指引的
‎‪‎‪是上帝在引导事态
‎‪‎‪指挥这个组织
‎‪‎‪有时候，我们会很惊讶这些想法是怎么来的
‎‪‎‪怎么会发展成现在这样？
‎‪‎‪我们不用担心哈米吉多顿之后的发展
‎‪‎‪上帝没有把所有细节写在圣经里
‎‪‎‪我们现在不用知道那么多
‎‪‎‪光是传道工作就够我们忙了
‎‪‎‪谁知道未来上帝想要怎么做呢？

ko.text: ‎자신의 시간과 활력을 바치는 면에서 ‎훌륭한 본이 되는 형제는
‎라슨 형제가 어떻게 여호와의 ‎인도를 신뢰했는지 보시기 바랍니다.
‎한 방울만 떨어져도 바늘이 닿으면 ‎판이 망가져 버렸죠.
‎매일 축음기를 사용했는데, ‎특별 파이오니아를 할 때 특히 그랬죠.
‎어느 날은 책을 전하고 ‎배를 한 자루 받아,
‎성서관 생각을 해 봤냐고 물으셔서 ‎그게 뭐냐고 했죠.
‎베델 얘기를 하기 시작하셨고 ‎7시간 반이나 얘길 나눴습니다.
‎그 후, 계속 그 생각을 하면서 ‎여호와께 기도했어요.
‎“세 달 후면 새 인쇄기가 오는데, ‎로드 형제가 맡을 거네.
‎배울 수 있다면, ‎지금 이 기계는 자네가 맡게나.”
‎3개월 뒤부터 그 일을 맡아 ‎일 년 반 동안 계속했죠.
‎노어 형젠 제가 할 일이 뭔지 ‎설명하기 시작하셨죠.
‎그리곤 제가 지금도 ‎사용하는 잊지 못할 말을 하셨죠.
‎전 노어 형제의 보조자로 ‎일 년 반 동안 훈련을 받았습니다.
‎다 저보다 베델에 온 지 오래됐고, ‎헌신적인 분들이셨죠.
‎이 두 분은 약 50년 동안 ‎공장을 청소하는 일을 했는데,
‎이 땅에 이곳 본부, ‎베델 같은 곳은 없다고요.
‎“다른 건 생각 안 해 봤어요” ‎라고 말하죠.
‎제가 계속 베델 봉사를 하는 데 ‎큰 힘이 되었습니다.
‎그분이 의도하신 대로 ‎모든 게 이루어질 것을 알았죠.
‎하느님의 왕국이 오고, 그분의 뜻이 ‎하늘에서처럼 땅에 이루어져서
‎우리는 병도 없이 건강하게 ‎평화로운 이 땅의 낙원에서
‎이 땅 낙원에서 ‎영원한 생명을 누리게 될 겁니다.

en.text: An excellent example of one who gave of his time and energy
is Brother Max Larson.
He served at world headquarters for over 72 years
until his death in 2011.
He saw firsthand
many exciting developments in our modern-day history.
In this archive interview,
please observe how Brother Larson trusted in Jehovah’s direction.

cn.text: ‎‎‪有位弟兄付出了全部的时间和精力服务
‎‎‪他就是麦克斯·拉尔逊弟兄
‎‎‪他在总部服务超过72年
‎‎‪直到2011年去世为止
‎‎‪他亲眼见证组织一路以来的发展
‎‎‪拉尔逊弟兄一直全心信赖耶和华的指引
‎‎‪是我们的好榜样
‎‎‪我们来看看他的经历
‎‎‪以前我们传道时会用留声机
‎‎‪当时，唱片一遇到水就会溶解
‎‎‪华盛顿州常常下雨
‎‎‪只要水滴到唱片上，就不能播放了
‎‎‪我们得非常小心，不让唱片淋到雨
‎‎‪通常唱片的开场白是
‎‎‪“宗教是个网罗和骗局”
‎‎‪这句开场白很吸引人
‎‎‪留声机对传道工作的帮助很大
‎‎‪我每天都会用
‎‎‪尤其是做特别先驱的时候
‎‎‪那时一个月要用200小时传道
‎‎‪真的很忙
‎‎‪做特别先驱的那几个月
‎‎‪我都用留声机传道
‎‎‪四个月后我就到伯特利服务了
‎‎‪经济大萧条时，我们用书刊换食物
‎‎‪有天我换到一大袋梨
‎‎‪回到家，已经九点半了
‎‎‪我住在王国聚会所的阁楼
‎‎‪区域监督霍夫曼弟兄是受膏基督徒
‎‎‪就住在旁边的露营车里
‎‎‪我问他：“你想吃点梨子吗？”
‎‎‪他说：“我妻子很喜欢吃梨子！进来坐吧！”
‎‎‪他问我：“你想去圣经书屋吗？”
‎‎‪以前都这样叫伯特利的
‎‎‪他解释那是什么地方
‎‎‪我们一聊就是七个半小时
‎‎‪听完后，我觉得很棒！
‎‎‪回房间后，我没有马上睡觉
‎‎‪反而找了张纸和笔，写信去伯特利
‎‎‪我把信寄了才去睡
‎‎‪我每天都为这件事向耶和华祷告
‎‎‪四个月后，我收到回信
‎‎‪信上只有几行字
‎‎‪我们收到你的申请了
‎‎‪如果你能马上来，就可以开始服务
‎‎‪那个时代，没有飞机
‎‎‪所以大冬天的，我搭了六天六夜的公共汽车
‎‎‪在蒙大拿州和北达科他州都碰到暴风雪
‎‎‪最后才到了纽约
‎‎‪我到伯特利的第一份工作
‎‎‪诺尔弟兄带我去装运部
‎‎‪我在那绑纸箱绑了一星期
‎‎‪后来，诺尔弟兄把我调去印刷厂
‎‎‪他说，三个月内我们会有一台新印刷机
‎‎‪罗德会操作那台
‎‎‪你要学会操作这台旧的
‎‎‪三个月内，我就开始操作了
‎‎‪做了一年半后
‎‎‪诺尔弟兄又来了
‎‎‪他说：“你想在办公室工作吗？”
‎‎‪我说：“这是我最不想做的”
‎‎‪他解释办公室的工作
‎‎‪说了一句话很有用，我到今天都没忘
‎‎‪他说，只坐在办公室的监督
‎‎‪无法掌握全部情况
‎‎‪好监督会关心人
‎‎‪所以你每天要来工厂两次看看大家
‎‎‪我一直这么做
‎‎‪我当了助手一年半
‎‎‪有天晚上，大家都走了
‎‎‪大办公室里，他的桌子离我大概五米吧
‎‎‪他说，我接到电话
‎‎‪爸爸走了
‎‎‪电话从圣迭戈（圣地牙哥）打来的
‎‎‪当时，大家都叫卢述福“爸爸”
‎‎‪他沉默了一下说
‎‎‪麦克斯，我要去124号照顾全世界的需要
‎‎‪工厂就交给你
‎‎‪那晚我失眠了
‎‎‪我来伯特利才三年
‎‎‪但没想到，我在工厂一做就做了59年
‎‎‪我才来伯特利三年，却要当印刷厂监督
‎‎‪我很需要帮助
‎‎‪大家都愿意帮助我
‎‎‪印刷厂有九个部门
‎‎‪每个部门的监督都是受膏基督徒
‎‎‪我会请教他们一些事
‎‎‪他们各有所长
‎‎‪如果对圣经有问题，我就去找克赖恩弟兄
‎‎‪他是圣经专家！
‎‎‪其他问题，我就去找别人
‎‎‪他们帮助我做好监督的工作
‎‎‪我很珍惜这些属灵成熟的人
‎‎‪虽然他们在伯特利的时间比我久
‎‎‪但没有因为我做监督而觉得不舒服
‎‎‪反而很愿意付出
‎‎‪以前我们叫清洁工“清洁管理员”
‎‎‪有两个弟兄做了大概50年的清洁工
‎‎‪他们都是受膏基督徒
‎‎‪他们很重视自己的服务
‎‎‪展现了受膏基督徒的精神
‎‎‪我常说
‎‎‪世上没有比在伯特利工作更好的事了
‎‎‪在总部工作是最棒的
‎‎‪有些人问我
‎‎‪你想过要做别的工作吗？
‎‎‪我说：“我根本没有想过要做其他事”
‎‎‪我有个很好的妻子，聪明灵巧
‎‎‪很爱耶和华又很愿意付出
‎‎‪她常常鼓励我，帮助我继续留在伯特利
‎‎‪管理工厂这么多年来
‎‎‪我经常感谢耶和华提供的指引
‎‎‪我知道事情一定会按上帝的意思进行
‎‎‪组织不断成长跟我们所祈求的一样
‎‎‪我们求上帝的王国来临
‎‎‪求他的旨意实现，像在天上一样
‎‎‪仁慈的天父保证，我们不会再生病
‎‎‪会在和平的乐园里享受完美健康的身心
‎‎‪我们都希望也渴望忠于耶和华
‎‎‪帮助别人认识上帝
‎‎‪到时，我们可以跟一大群人一起渡过大患难
‎‎‪在地上乐园、上帝王国的统治下
‎‎‪永远快乐地生活

ko.text: ‎최근 몇 년 사이 로마니어 구역에서 ‎눈에 띄는 증가가 있었습니다.
‎로마족 사람들은 불가리아 전역에서 ‎대개 자체 공동체를 이루어 사는데,
‎본래 고유한 언어와 문화를 가지고 ‎인도에서 유럽으로 들어왔죠.
‎배운 걸 구역에 효과적으로 ‎적용할 수 있도록 마련했습니다.
‎모국어로 교육을 받으니 ‎그 내용이 마음에 직접 새겨지네요.
‎전 새벽 4시 반에 일어나 ‎일터로 가서 일을 마무리한 다음에,
‎조금 힘들긴 하지만 여호와에 관해 듣고 ‎그분에 관해 더 알게 되면
‎어린아이들이 그분을 만나러 왔을 때 ‎감정 이입을 하셨어요.
‎이 내용을 통해 ‎저도 구역 사람들을 볼 때
‎이 학교가 로마족 주거 지역에서 ‎로마니어로 진행돼서 정말 좋았어요.
‎10년 전 로마니어 구역에서 ‎전파 활동을 시작했을 땐
‎우리가 로마니어로 파이오니아 학교를 ‎열 거라곤 상상도 못 했죠.
‎재미있는 건, 그 시절에 ‎성경 공부를 했던 사람들이
‎자신들의 연구 사회자와 함께 ‎바로 이 학교에 참석했다는 거예요.

en.text: ‎This was the first school
‎in the Romany language in Bulgaria.
‎In recent years,
‎we have seen remarkable growth
‎in the Romany field.
‎There are many Roma people living all over Bulgaria,
‎generally in their own neighborhoods.
‎The Roma came to Europe from India with their own languages and culture.
‎Roma people are happy to talk to Jehovah’s Witnesses,
‎sensing no discrimination or prejudice.
‎As a result,
‎Romany congregations and groups have been formed.
‎At the first Memorial held in the Romany language,
‎a congregation with 26 publishers
‎had 703 in attendance.
‎In this rapidly growing field,
‎half of the publishers serve as pioneers.
‎Seeing the progress in this field,
‎the branch wanted the pioneers to be trained in their mother tongue
‎so that they could apply the information according to the needs of the territory.
‎This is a wonderful gift from Jehovah,
‎because when we receive it in our own language,
‎it is embedded directly into our hearts.
‎I feel very happy that the school
‎is in the Romany language
‎because I can see not only Jehovah’s love
‎but also how he spoils us.
‎This has been a wonderful achievement,
‎considering that we didn’t have any material
‎translated for the school in the Romany language.
‎This meant that the instructors and the students
‎prepared in a different language,
‎but everything was presented in Romany.
‎I have to get up at 4:30 a.m.
‎to go to and finish my secular work
‎before the school, which starts at 8:30 a.m.
‎It is a little difficult for me,
‎but hearing about Jehovah and understanding more about him
‎gives me renewed energy.
‎I heard an example about Jesus
‎and how he showed empathy for the young children who went to see him,
‎but his apostles tried to stop them.
‎However, Jesus put himself in the place of those children.
‎This really helps me to see the people in our territory
‎and to put myself in their place,
‎because I too once lived like them and know how they feel.
‎When we speak about spiritual things
‎—things about God—
‎we want to speak in our mother tongue
‎because it touches our heart.
‎I personally saw how the hearts of the pioneers
‎were deeply touched by having the school in their language.
‎As a Roma,
‎I often feel rejected by others,
‎but at the school,
‎it was completely the opposite.
‎I was really happy that the school
‎was held in our Roma neighborhood
‎and that I could speak in my language.
‎Who would have imagined ten years ago,
‎when the preaching work
‎started in the Roma neighborhood,
‎that we would have a pioneer school?
‎Interestingly,
‎some of those who started to study the Bible back then
‎attended the school together with their Bible teachers.
‎If someone had said that this would happen,
‎we would have thought, ‘He has a vivid imagination.’
‎Jehovah made this possible!

cn.text: ‎这是在保加利亚举行的
‎第一届罗姆语先驱训练班
‎近年来  越来越多的罗姆人
‎接受了圣经真理
‎罗姆人分散在保加利亚的各个地方
‎一般来说他们都住得比较集中
‎罗姆人是从印度迁移到欧洲来的
‎有自己的语言和文化
‎罗姆人喜欢和耶和华见证人交谈
‎因为他们觉得见证人没有偏见
‎于是  一些罗姆语会众和小组成立了
‎第一次用罗姆语
‎举行耶稣受难纪念聚会时
‎有一群会众只有26个传道员
‎但出席人数却达到了703人
‎这里的传道工作迅速扩展
‎有一半的传道员是先驱
‎因此  分部希望说罗姆语的弟兄姐妹
‎能用母语参加先驱训练班
‎这样他们就能运用所学的知识
‎更有效地帮助地区里的人
‎这是来自耶和华的宝贵礼物
‎用母语参加训练班让我们很受感动
‎很想把学到的用在传道上
‎我真的特别开心
‎能参加罗姆语的训练班
‎我真的感受到
‎耶和华的爱远远超出我们的想象
‎先驱训练班使用的出版物
‎都还没翻译成罗姆语
‎所以  能举行这个训练班
‎实在是个很大的成就
‎导师和学员会用别的语言做准备
‎但课程是用罗姆语进行的
‎每天早上4:30我就得起床
‎把当天的世俗工作做完
‎然后8:30参加先驱训练班
‎这样的时间安排
‎确实会让我有点儿累
‎不过  训练班的内容
‎让我更好地认识耶和华
‎这让我又得到了力量
‎培训时讲了耶稣的一个例子
‎他对孩子很亲切
‎当孩子们来到他身边时
‎使徒们设法阻止
‎耶稣却设身处地地考虑孩子们的感受
‎非常仁慈地对待他们
‎这推动我在传道时也努力体恤别人
‎因为在认识真理前
‎我也活得跟他们一样
‎我能明白他们的感受
‎当谈论跟上帝有关的话题时
‎我们都很想用母语来表达
‎因为这样能表达出内心深处的感受
‎我清楚看出  参加母语的训练班
‎大大鼓励了先驱们
‎也推动他们积极传道

ko.text: ‎여기 사는 형제 자매들 대부분은 ‎절대 진리를 배울 수 없었을 겁니다.
‎외딴 지역 사람들에게 전도하기 위해 ‎열심 많은 형제 자매들이
‎안데스 산맥의 추운 고지대를 따라 난 ‎좁은 길을 올랐습니다.
‎케추아어를 쓰는 사람들에게 ‎그들의 언어로 좋은 소식을 전하려고
‎하지만 모국어로 전파 활동을 하는 데는 ‎몇 가지 어려움이 있었어요.
‎한 가지는 케추아어로 된 ‎좋은 성경 번역판이 없다는 것이었죠.
‎성경 본문에서 그 이름을 보는 ‎것만큼의 효과는 없었습니다.
‎또 거짓 교리의 영향 때문에 ‎진리를 가르치는 데 어려움이 있었죠.
‎그분의 이름을 알아야 하고, ‎그 이름의 의미도 이해해야 합니다.
‎이 산악 지대 곳곳에서 어떻게 ‎여호와의 큰 이름이 거룩해졌을까요?
‎하느님의 이름은 더 이상 ‎케추아 사람들에게 숨겨져 있지 않죠.
‎여호와를 알 수 있는 ‎소중한 기회를 갖게 됐습니다.
‎좋은 소식을 보내 주신 여호와께 ‎매일 매일 감사를 드립니다.

en.text: ‎My name is Faustino Camacho Quispe.
‎My family and I speak Quechua or,
‎as we say, runa simi
‎—the language of the people.
‎We live in an agricultural community
‎in the mountains of Peru.
‎Our way of life depends on farming.
‎We grow crops such as corn,
‎potatoes, wheat,
‎and quinoa.
‎We also raise a small amount of livestock.
‎Many people who speak Quechua have moved to larger cities,
‎but others, like us, still enjoy
‎a more traditional way of life in the country.
‎My family and I are Jehovah’s Witnesses.
‎Most of our brothers and sisters in this area
‎would never have been able to learn the truth
‎had there not been anyone sent here to preach in Quechua.
‎the Peru branch office began to expand
‎the work in the Quechua-language field.
‎In order to reach those living in isolated areas,
‎zealous brothers and sisters climbed narrow roads
‎in the frigid elevations of the Andes Mountains.
‎Great efforts were made in order
‎to bring Quechua-speaking people
‎the good news in their own language.
‎The people loved having publications in their mother tongue.
‎However, there were some challenges
‎carrying out this work.
‎One problem was not having a good translation
‎of the Holy Scriptures in Quechua.
‎The commonly used translations here in Peru
‎omit God’s name in the main text.
‎It can be found in the glossary of some Bibles,
‎and sometimes we used that in order to preach.
‎But even so, it didn’t have the same impact
‎as seeing it in its proper place.
‎That, along with the influence of false doctrines,
‎made it difficult for us to teach the truth.
‎When we teach people about the Bible,
‎we want them to draw close to God;
‎we want them to become his friends.
‎But no one can be God’s friend
‎if they don’t know his name.
‎For people to be able to come to love God,
‎they have to know his name,
‎and they have to understand what it means.
‎It was difficult for us to use the Bible at the meetings,
‎in the field ministry, and in our family worship.
‎How could Jehovah’s great name be sanctified
‎throughout this mountainous region?
‎How could the Quechua people get to know God
‎when his name was hidden?
‎The answer to our prayers came when Quechua congregations
‎throughout the country were invited to a special program
‎Imagine the great joy we felt when Brother Jackson
‎of the Governing Body announced the release
‎of the New World Translation of the Christian Greek Scriptures
‎in two Quechua languages!
‎Language number 136:
‎It’s the Christian Greek Scriptures
‎in Quechua Ayacucho!
‎But we also have number 137:
‎It’s Quechua Cuzco!
‎What a wonderful gift we’ve received today!
‎This new Quechua Bible
‎is a grand victory for Jehovah’s great name.
‎God’s name is no longer hidden from the Quechua people,
‎giving them the precious opportunity
‎to come to know our loving Creator, Jehovah.
‎I feel proud to use our new Bible to teach
‎my family and neighbors Jehovah’s name.
‎I am thankful every day
‎that Jehovah sent this good news to the mountains
‎to us who speak runa simi
‎—the language of the people.

title: 러시아가 여호와의 증인 지부 사무실을 몰수하다

ko.text: ‎외국 단체가 소유한 여호와의 증인 러시아 사무실을
‎펜실베이니아 워치 타워 성서 책자 협회로 이전되었습니다.
‎이 시설의 소유권을 이전한 계약이 유효하다는 것을 증명하는
‎워치 타워 성서 책자 협회로 이전한 계약을 철저하게 검토했습니다.
‎하지만 법적으로 문제가 되는 점은 하나도 찾아내지 못했죠.
‎워치 타워 협회는 이 시설에 대한 세금을 납부해야만 했습니다.
‎러시아 연방에 300만 달러에 달하는 엄청난 액수의 세금을 납부했습니다.
‎만일 그 계약이 법적으로 아무 효력이 없었다면
‎워치 타워 협회는 심리에 참여하도록 허락받지 못했습니다.
‎당시 대법원은 그 재판이 협회의 자산에 아무 영향을 미치지 않을 것이므로
‎협회가 재판에 관여할 필요가 없다고 못 박았습니다.
‎제가 아파트를 소유하고 있는데 거기에 제 친척이 살고 있었습니다.
‎이유가 뭐냐고 하니까, 친척이 법을 어겼기 때문이라는 겁니다.
‎그런데도 막무가내로 제 재산을 빼앗아 가겠다고 하는 겁니다.
‎사실 러시아 정부는 이 시설을 건축하는 데
‎여호와의 증인이 한 러시아 회사로부터 합법적으로 매입했습니다.
‎이 시설은 외국의 여호와의 증인 단체들이 기부한 자금을 사용해
‎따라서 애초에 이 건축 공사를 요청했던 워치 타워 협회가
‎이 시설을 소유하는 것이 당연하다고 볼 수 있죠.
‎그런데 그렇게 사랑과 희생 정신으로 건축한 이 시설을
‎러시아 정교회의 자산을 모두 몰수한다는 법령을 발표한 것입니다.
‎러시아의 현대 역사에서는 전례를 찾아볼 수 없는 일입니다.
‎여호와의 증인들이 신앙 때문에 차별 대우를 받고
‎이젠 그들이 가진 모든 걸 빼앗아 가려 하고 있습니다.
‎과거에 몰수했던 러시아 정교회의 자산을 돌려주고 있습니다.
‎결국에는 증인들의 자산 역시도 그렇게 돌려주어야 할 거라고 생각합니다.
‎물론 종교의 자유 역시도 언젠가는 꼭 다시 허용해 주어야겠죠.
‎빼앗긴 것을 모두 되찾을 수 있게 될 겁니다.
‎하지만 뭔가 다른 요인에 영향을 받은 결정이 내려진다면
‎우린 계속 항소 절차를 밟아 나갈 겁니다.
‎정부가 몰수하고 있는 자산은 여호와의 증인이 여호와께 바친 것입니다.
‎하지만 성경 말씀대로 우리는 ‘모든 염려를 그분에게 내맡길’ 것입니다.

cn.text: ‎‪‎‪俄罗斯谢斯特罗列茨克地方法院

‎‪‎‪不会有损守望台社的权益为由

ko.text: ‎이 책에는 누가가 직접 목격한 사건들도 들어 있습니다.
‎이 책은 약 28년 동안 있었던 사건들을 다룹니다.
‎로마에서 가택 연금 상태로 그 결과를 기다리던
‎사도행전은 누가복음이 기록되고 불과 몇 년 뒤에 기록되었습니다.
‎두 책 모두 같은 사람, 즉 데오빌로에게 보낸 것입니다.
‎이미 그가 장성한 그리스도인이 되어 있었기 때문일 수 있습니다.
‎1장에서 예수께서는 제자들이 “땅의 가장 먼 곳까지 이르러”
‎2장에서는 10일 뒤인 기원 33년 오순절에 있었던 일을 알려 줍니다.
‎사울이라는 사람은 스데반이 죽는 것을 보면서 그것을 좋게 여깁니다.
‎하지만 얼마 후, 사울이 다마스쿠스로 가는 길에
‎10장과 11장은 제자들이 누린 평화의 시기에 대해 알려 줍니다.
‎두 번째 선교 여행에서는 다시 소아시아로 갔다가
‎세 번째 선교 여행은 약 4년에 걸쳐 이루어지며,
‎바울은 두 번째와 세 번째 선교 여행 중에
‎한 추산에 따르면, 사도행전에서 바울이 여행한 거리를 합하면
‎그는 유대 총독 펠릭스와 그의 후임자인 페스투스,
‎자신에 대해 변론하던 중에 바울은 당시 로마 최고의 권력자인
‎심한 박해를 받으면서도 어떻게 두려움 없이 증거했는지,
‎하느님의 왕국의 좋은 소식을 전할 권리를 변호했는지

en.text: An introduction to the book of Acts.
The Gospel writer Luke wrote Acts of Apostles.
Chapters 1 to 12 of Acts
primarily cover the activity of the apostle Peter.
Chapters 13 to 28 feature the activity of the apostle Paul.
Because Luke accompanied Paul on some of his travels,
Luke was an eyewitness to certain events he recorded.
The book of Acts contains a detailed history
of the beginnings of the Christian congregation
and its rapid growth.
The account commences
about where Luke’s Gospel account ends.
Acts covers a period
of approximately 28 years,
from Jesus’ ascension to heaven in 33 C.E.
to about 61 C.E.
while Paul is still under house arrest in Rome
awaiting the outcome of his appeal to Caesar.
The Gospel of Luke and Acts of Apostles
were written just a few years apart
and were both addressed
to the same individual, Theophilus.
Did you know?
When Luke wrote his Gospel account,
he addressed Theophilus
with the title “most excellent,”
possibly indicating that Theophilus
had been a prominent official.
However, Luke does not use that title in Acts,
which could suggest that he was writing
to Theophilus as a mature Christian.
Acts of Apostles contains 28 chapters.
In chapter 1,
Jesus tells his disciples that they will be witnesses of him
“to the most distant part of the earth.”
He then ascends to heaven.
Chapter 2 records that ten days later,
on Pentecost 33 C.E.,
holy spirit is poured out
on about 120 disciples.
Later that day about 3,000 people
are baptized!
Chapters 3 to 9 relate early examples
of how the disciples zealously preach
and perform miraculous signs.
Although they face strong opposition,
they boldly continue to spread the Christian message.
Stephen, an early Christian, is even murdered because of his faith.
A man named Saul witnesses
and approves of the execution of Stephen.
However, not long after that,
Jesus appears to Saul on the road to Damascus.
Subsequently, Saul becomes a Christian
and is later known as the apostle Paul.
Chapters 10 and 11 describe
a period of peace enjoyed by the disciples.
Jehovah uses the apostle Peter
to expand the preaching work to include Gentiles, or non-Jews.
During this time of expansion,
the term “Christian” is coined
to identify Christ’s disciples.
In chapter 12, persecution breaks out again.
Herod puts the apostle James to death and imprisons Peter,
who is later released by an angel.
Chapters 13 to 21 describe
Paul’s three eventful missionary tours
from about 47 to 56 C.E.
Paul travels to Cyprus and parts of Asia Minor
during his first missionary tour.
His second missionary tour takes him back to Asia Minor
as well as to Macedonia and Greece.
Paul’s third missionary tour covers some four years and ends in Jerusalem.
Paul writes six inspired letters
during the period that includes his second and third tours.
According to one estimate,
the book of Acts records Paul traveling nearly 10,000 miles.
In chapter 21,
Paul is wrongfully arrested in Jerusalem.
Chapters 22 to 26 relate Paul’s defense.
He appears before Felix, governor of Judea;
his successor, Festus;
and King Herod Agrippa II.
In the course of his defense,
Paul appeals to Caesar,
the highest Roman authority of the time.
Chapters 27 and 28
describe Paul’s arduous journey to Rome,
which includes a shipwreck.
Acts concludes with Paul under house arrest,
awaiting trial in Rome.
Despite confinement,
he remains busy preaching to all those who come to him.
As you read Acts of Apostles,
note how the disciples were empowered by holy spirit,
how they witnessed fearlessly despite fierce persecution,
and how they used legal means to defend
their right to preach the good news of God’s Kingdom.

cn.text: 使徒行传的执笔者是路加
第1到12章的记载
大部分与使徒彼得的活动有关
第13到28章的记载
则是与使徒保罗有关
路加曾和保罗结伴同行
因此有些事件是路加亲眼所见的
路加在使徒行传中
详细记下基督徒会众的开始
以及会众如何迅速扩展
使徒行传延续了路加福音的记载
涵盖的时间大约28年
从公元33年耶稣升天
到大约公元61年
使徒保罗被软禁在罗马
等候凯撒的判决
路加福音和使徒行传的成书时间
只相隔几年
两卷书都是路加写给提阿非罗的
你知道吗？
路加在路加福音中
称呼提阿非罗为“尊敬的…先生”
这可能表示提阿非罗当时
是个地位显赫的官员
后来路加没有在使徒行传中
用这个头衔称呼他
有人因此推测
那时提阿非罗已经是基督徒了
使徒行传一共有28章
在第一章
耶稣预告门徒会为他作见证
“一直到地上最遥远的地方”
然后耶稣就升到天上去了
第二章描述，在十天之后的五旬节
有大约一百二十个门徒得到神圣力量
那一天，大约有三千人受浸
第3到9章记录耶稣的门徒热心传道
和施行奇迹的经历
尽管门徒受到猛烈的反对
他们还是勇敢地宣扬基督的好消息
有一个早期的基督徒名叫司提反
他因信仰的缘故惨遭杀害
有一个叫扫罗的男子在一旁观看
表示赞同
不久之后
耶稣向前往大马士革的扫罗显现
结果扫罗成为基督徒
后来大家称他为“使徒保罗”
在第10到11章
会众经历一段和平的时期
耶和华任用使徒彼得扩展传道工作
吩咐他向外族人
也就是非犹太人传道
在这段扩展时期
耶稣的门徒首次被称为“基督徒”
第12章描述基督徒再次受到迫害
希律杀了使徒雅各
又把彼得关进监牢
不过天使把彼得救了出来
第13到21章记录
公元47到56年间
保罗三次精彩的传道旅程
在第一次传道旅程中
保罗去了塞浦路斯
和小亚细亚的部分地区
保罗第二次传道旅程
再次去了小亚细亚
也造访马其顿和希腊
保罗的第三次传道旅程花了大约四年
终点是耶路撒冷
保罗在第二次和第三次传道旅程期间
在神圣力量的指引下写了六封信
有学者根据使徒行传的记载
推算出保罗的旅程总长
将近1万6000公里
第21章记录保罗在耶路撒冷遭到逮捕
第22到26章记录保罗受审的经过
他先后在腓力斯、非斯都
和希律·亚基帕二世面前申辩
保罗在申辩时
要求向当时罗马的最高统治者凯撒上诉
第27和28章记录保罗
被送往罗马的艰辛旅程
他在途中遇上船难
使徒行传最后提到保罗被软禁在罗马
等候审判
不过保罗还是努力
向那些来见他的人作见证
你读使徒行传时，请留意
门徒得到神圣力量
热心执行上帝交托的任务
他们在猛烈迫害下勇敢地作见证
门徒借着法律途径
维护宣扬上帝王国好消息的权利

ko.text: ‎지금 우리가 살고 있는 ‎이 마지막 때의 상황에 대해 그리고
‎큰 환난 기간에 있을 일들에 관해 ‎예수께서 하신 말씀입니다.
‎여러분의 주가 어느 날에 올지 ‎여러분이 모르기 때문입니다.”
‎깨어 있으면서 집에 도둑이 ‎침입하지 못하게 했을 것입니다.”
‎집주인은 도둑이 오는 때가 ‎낮일지 밤일지 알고 있습니다.
‎예수의 말씀은 우리가 사는 ‎마지막 날에 관한 것이므로,
‎여러분이 생각지도 않은 시간에 ‎‘사람의 아들’이 올 것이기 때문입니다.”
‎우리가 사는 바로 이 시대에 ‎왜 사람들은 깨어 살피지 못할까요?
‎그들은 모두 말 못 하는 개들이니 ‎짖지도 못하고.”
‎개는 청력이 매우 뛰어나기 때문에 ‎사람이 못 듣는 것도 듣죠.
‎그래서 짖으면서 ‎경고 신호를 줄 수 있는 겁니다.
‎그 때문에 일반 대중은 우리 시대의 ‎심각성을 깨닫지 못합니다.
‎이제 그 비유적인 말 못 하는 개들을
‎이 종이 우리를 위해 해 온 일들을 ‎한번 생각해 보십시오.
‎아직 성취되지 않은 예언을 이해하고 ‎그것에 예의주시하게 도와줍니다.
‎충실한 종이 공급하는 영적 양식의 ‎양을 한번 생각해 보십시오.
‎우리는 이 ‘말 못 하는 개’와 같은 ‎태도를 나타내선 안 될 것입니다.
‎체크만 하고 만다면 그 결과는 ‎대형 사고로 이어질 겁니다.
‎그냥 보기만 하고 아무런 행동도 ‎취하지 않을 순 없죠.
‎“충실하고 슬기로운 종”은 이 면에서 ‎정말 우리에게 훌륭한 본이 되죠.
‎그 질문에 대해 답하고 ‎또 추리하는 데 도움을 줍니다.
‎여기, 점이 없다는 건 점이 생겼을 때 ‎그것을 제거했거나,
‎흠이 생겼을 때 뭔가 ‎조처를 취했다는 걸 뜻합니다.
‎물론 현 세상에서 도덕적으로 ‎깨끗하게 살아가기가 쉽지 않죠.
‎우리의 생각이 올바르지 않다는 ‎조짐이 처음 보일 때,
‎물이 새는 걸 보면 ‎그는 뭔가 조처를 취해야 합니다.
‎“자신의 도덕 표준과 ‎세상의 도덕 표준 사이의 격차가
‎그렇게 느끼고 있지 않다면, ‎그것은 우려할 만한 일입니다.
‎혹시 밤낮 짖어대는 개가 있는 ‎집 옆에 살아 보셨나요?
‎그런데 얼마 지나지 않아 ‎개 짖는 소리에 둔감해집니다.

en.text: ‎If you look at Matthew chapter 24
‎(you may want to open your Bibles there
‎because the text of the day comes from there),
‎we find in chapter 24,
‎starting in verse 29 through chapter 25,
‎Jesus is actually talking
‎about the conditions of the time of the end
‎that we’re, in fact, in right now
‎and, also, what we can expect in the great tribulation.
‎So our scripture is at Matthew 24:42.
‎Let’s read it.
‎It says: “Keep on the watch, therefore,
‎because you do not know on what day your Lord is coming.”
‎So, what is referred to as “coming”?
‎Well, this is speaking about a future time.
‎Jesus will be coming as Judge.
‎When is he coming?
‎Well, what did he say there?
‎‘You do not know the day.’
‎But if you go to the next verse,
‎he sort of narrows his comment and gives us a little bit of a clue.
‎He’s talking about a householder being on watch for a thief.
‎Let’s read it in verse 43.
‎It says: “But know one thing:
‎“If the householder had known in what watch the thief was coming,
‎he would have kept awake and not allowed his house to be broken into.”
‎So if you notice the footnote, it says “at what time of night.”
‎So Jesus said, well, the householder knew either day or night.
‎We’re going to narrow it down to the night
‎—that’s when you need to be on the watch.
‎And so it is that we are in the last days —that’s what he’s speaking about.
‎Now, the “coming” would be at some point in the last days.
‎It’s another reason this illustration is good for us,
‎because he says that the watch will be at night.
‎Now, what happens at nighttime?
‎Well, at nighttime is usually when there’s adversity
‎if there’s going to be adversity.
‎There is gloom
‎—obscurity— at nighttime.
‎That’s when the thieves come in —those who want to do evil.
‎That’s when sometimes armies will launch surprise attacks.
‎That’s where beasts will roam —when they’ll roam.
‎And as a result, notice what Jesus said in verse 44.
‎He says: “On this account [because of that, he said],
‎“you too prove yourselves ready,
‎because the Son of man is coming at an hour that you do not think to be it.”
‎So, what message was he giving us here?
‎Well, in verse 42: “Keep on the watch.”
‎Verse 44, ahh, ‘Prove ourselves ready.’
‎Now let’s take the “keep on the watch,” first.
‎During the times we’re living in right now,
‎why is it that people are not on the watch?
‎They don’t understand what’s happening around us.
‎Well, to understand,
‎we can go to Isaiah 56:10
‎because it gives some indication.
‎Isaiah 56:10
‎—speaking about the leaders of Judah—
‎and listen to what it says.
‎It says: “His watchmen are blind,
‎“none of them have taken note.
‎All of them are speechless dogs, unable to bark.”
‎So the leaders were to be “watchmen”
‎but, instead, he says they were “speechless.”
‎Now, dogs have this very keen sense of hearing,
‎and so they hear before humans.
‎That’s why they can bark, giving a warning.
‎But these leaders weren’t doing it.
‎They weren’t warning the people of the dangers,
‎and thus the spiritual condition that they found themselves in.
‎So the leaders of Judah
‎actually are a fitting symbol
‎of Christendom’s religious clergy today
‎because they’re not warning the people.
‎And that’s why the masses don’t understand
‎the serious times we’re living in.
‎In fact, they are spiritually asleep.
‎Now let’s contrast those speechless dogs, so to speak,
‎with Jehovah’s watchman, “the faithful and discreet slave.”
‎Just think of what they’ve done for us:
‎They keep us alert to the sign of Christ’s presence.
‎They help us to avoid the snares of Satan the Devil.
‎They help us to understand
‎and stay focused on the unfulfilled prophecies.
‎In fact, just think of the amount of spiritual food
‎that they’re giving us.
‎Truly, they are in fact on the watch
‎and, as a result, they’re helping us to stay on the watch.
‎But remember, Jesus now narrowed it down to an individual.
‎We have to ‘prove ourselves ready,’ he said.
‎So to stay ready, we cannot have
‎this ‘speechless dog’ tendency in ourselves.
‎Now, what do we mean?
‎Well, think about this:
‎If our night watchman is on his shift and he’s going around
‎and he sees water damage, rather, a water leak
‎—what is he going to do about it?
‎Will he simply take note of it?
‎Well, if he only takes note of it,
‎the result is going to be major damage.
‎So inherent within being a watchman
‎is that you have to do something about it.
‎You can’t just see it and not act on it.
‎And so it is with each one of us.
‎When we look at “the faithful and discreet slave,”
‎what a beautiful example they’re giving us.
‎They’re fulfilling their assignment in a superior way.
‎But we must each ask ourselves,
‎‘Is my internal dog barking?’
‎Now, the words of Peter here in 2 Peter chapter 3
‎are going to help us to answer and to reason on that question.
‎It’s at 2 Peter 3:10.
‎It says: “Jehovah’s day will come as a thief.”
‎OK, in verse 11, it says that we need to figure out
‎‘what sort of persons’ we are in these areas
‎—‘in our holy acts of conduct and our deeds of godly devotion.’
‎And then in verse 14, we’ll read it:
‎“Therefore, beloved ones, since you are awaiting these things,
‎“do your utmost to be found finally by him
‎spotless and unblemished and in peace.”
‎So, obviously, spotless means
‎that when there was a spot, we got rid of it,
‎or when there was a blemish, we did something about it.
‎So to manifest these holy acts of conduct
‎that verse 11 is talking about,
‎we have to stay morally clean.
‎Now, we’re living in a world that doesn’t want us to be morally clean.
‎They’re doing everything to try to get us to think wrong
‎—to do things that Jehovah objects to.
‎When we have the first indication
‎that our thinking is not right,
‎maybe there’s an unclean thought or idea
‎that comes into our mind, what do we do?
‎Well, remember the watchman.
‎When he sees the leak, he needs to do something about it.
‎Otherwise, there’ll be damage.
‎And so it is with us.
‎Even if we are thinking —if we have a thought—
‎of deviating from Jehovah’s moral standards,
‎then the figurative dog better start barking
‎and we better do something about it.
‎If we don’t do so,
‎listen to the comments of the March 2015 Watchtower.
‎It says: “Are we finding the gap
‎“between our moral standards and those of the world widening?
‎“If not, we have cause for concern.
‎“Could it be that our personal standards,
‎“though higher than those of the world, are eroding?
‎“If so, we need to take positive action
‎to correct matters in order to please God.”
‎So if we detect a spiritual spot,
‎or blemish,
‎let’s go to Jehovah God in prayer
‎and ask him for help.
‎Let’s do research in a way that helps us
‎to identify the weakness
‎and also how to fix it.
‎And if needed, let’s reach out for help.
‎Have you ever lived next to a neighbor
‎that had a dog that barked all the time?
‎It barked for days, for weeks, for months,
‎barking and barking.
‎Pretty soon you became oblivious to the bark.
‎Well, may that never happen
‎when our internal dog is barking.
‎Yes, may we all be determined to heed Jesus direction:
‎“Keep on the watch.”
‎‘Prove ourselves ready.’

cn.text: ‎请打开圣经到马太福音24章
‎今天的每日经文就出自这一章
‎从马太福音24:29开始
‎一直到25章
‎耶稣都在谈论末世的情况
‎也就是现在的世界形势
‎还有将来大患难期间会发生的事
‎我们来读一下今天的经文
‎马太福音24:42
‎“所以  你们要不断守望”
‎“因为不知道你们的主”
‎“在什么日子来到”
‎关于耶稣“来到”
‎经文怎么说呢?
‎经文说这件事会发生在未来
‎耶稣会以审判官的身份来到
‎什么时候呢?
‎耶稣说  我们不知道是什么时候
‎不过  耶稣在下一节经文
‎做了一个进一步的说明
‎给出了一些线索
‎他谈到一位家主正在守望
‎防止小偷进来
‎我们来看看43节
‎“有一件事你们要知道”
‎“家主如果知道几更天有贼来”
‎“就会保持警醒”
‎“不容贼挖洞进家里来”
‎一般来说
‎人们不知道小偷什么时候会来
‎但耶稣比喻里的家主
‎知道贼会在晚上来
‎所以  在晚上守望很重要
‎因此  耶稣想说的是
‎生活在最后的日子
‎我们需要不断守望
‎因为耶稣会在最后日子的

title: 하느님의 이름의 사용을 지지하는 고대 사본

ko.text: ‎참조할 수 있는 가장 오래된 ‎그리스어 성경 사본들엔
‎아주 초기부터 원문의 필사자들은 ‎하느님의 이름을 그냥 대체해 버렸고
‎그리스어 성경은 신성한 히브리어 ‎성경에 추가된 영감받은 기록물이었죠.
‎따라서 히브리어 성경에 약 ‎7000번이나 사용된 하느님의 이름이
‎그리스어 본문에 테트라그람마톤이 ‎한 번도 아니고 곳곳에 있었던 거죠.
‎두 명의 여호와의 증인은 ‎이집트 카이로에 있는 그 단편들을
‎신세계역 번역 위원회의 우리 형제들이 ‎연구•조사를 하고 있을 때,
‎그 일은 하느님의 영원한 이름이 ‎드러나야 한다는 점을 확증해 줬습니다.
‎여호와를 섬기려는 모든 사람이 ‎그 이름을 알아야 했습니다.
‎예수께서 아버지께 기도하며 말씀하신 ‎이런 내용이 참됨을 보여 줍니다.
‎“저는 아버지의 이름을 알려 주었고 ‎또 알려 주겠습니다.”
‎우리 여호와의 증인들은 “그분의 ‎이름을 위한 백성”이 되어 뿌듯합니다.
‎여호와란 분을 알려면 반드시 ‎그분의 이름을 알아야 하죠.
‎여호와께서 그분의 백성을 사용해 ‎「신세계역」 성경을 마련해 주신 것을 보면
‎그분이 “자신의 이름을 위한 백성”을 모으고 ‎계신다는 점이 너무나 분명해집니다.

en.text: ‎the New World Translation of the Christian Greek Scriptures was released.
‎“I have the extreme pleasure of releasing
‎“the New World Translation
‎of the Christian Greek Scriptures!”
‎This translation was unique
‎in that it restored the divine name, Jehovah,
‎237 times in the main text
‎of the so-called New Testament.
‎But how could they do that, considering that for centuries
‎many Bibles did not use Jehovah’s name?
‎And why did the divine name need to be restored?
‎The oldest copies we have available
‎do not use the divine name
‎in the Christian Greek Scriptures;
‎they use substitutes like God or Lord.
‎Very early on,
‎the copyists of those original manuscripts,
‎they simply replaced
‎—they got into the practice of replacing— God’s name.
‎We know that this is not a translation
‎because one is a name and the other one is a title.
‎And it’s not even a synonym for Jehovah, for a name.
‎Since the Greek Scriptures
‎were an inspired addition
‎to the sacred Hebrew Scriptures and,
‎in fact,
‎Jehovah’s name, God’s name,
‎was used some 7,000 times in the Hebrew Scriptures,
‎the sudden disappearance in the Greek text is inconsistent.
‎Even though the New World Bible Translation Committee
‎believed that Jehovah’s name should appear
‎in the text of the Christian Greek Scriptures,
‎they also knew that at that time
‎virtually all Bible scholars disagreed with that belief.
‎Those scholars argued that by the time of Jesus,
‎even the Greek translation of the Hebrew Scriptures, the Septuagint,
‎no longer contained the divine name.
‎So why would the writers of the New Testament
‎use the divine name when their copies of the Holy Scriptures in Greek
‎did not contain the Tetragrammaton?
‎This view was based on faulty information.
‎How so?
‎Did the Septuagint still use
‎the divine name in Jesus’ time?
‎Let’s consider one piece of evidence
‎that answers this question.
‎Something amazing happened in 1944.
‎A theological journal published a picture
‎of a Greek Septuagint fragment
‎from the Papyrus Fouad 266 collection.
‎Now, inside that fragment there was the divine name.
‎In the Greek text, you had the Tetragrammaton,
‎not just once but throughout.
‎Now, this fragment was very old, dating back to the first century B.C.E.,
‎but the important point is that this was proof, clear proof,
‎that the divine name was originally there.
‎Two Jehovah’s Witnesses were asked
‎to obtain photographs of these fragments,
‎which were located in Cairo, Egypt.
‎The New World Translation Committee was very interested in this
‎because they started translating
‎the Greek Scriptures in 1947.
‎After obtaining permission, pictures of 12 of the fragments
‎were published in the foreword of the New World Translation
‎of the Christian Greek Scriptures.
‎What amazes me about this is the timing.
‎When our brothers —this New World Translation Committee—
‎did their research, before even translating,
‎suddenly something that was unknown
‎until essentially 1944
‎came to light that confirmed
‎that the eternal name of God
‎had to be revealed; it could no longer be hidden.
‎It should be shown to everyone who wants to worship Jehovah.
‎This careful preservation supports what Jesus said in prayer
‎at John 17:26, when he said to his Father:
‎“I have made your name known . . . and will make it known.”
‎As Jehovah’s Witnesses, we are proud to be “a people for his name.”
‎Knowing his name is essential to knowing Jehovah himself,
‎and the fact that Jehovah has provided this arrangement
‎through his people
‎makes it very clear
‎that he was gathering “a people for his name.”
‎This is why this Bible translation is so beautiful,
‎because it brings us closer to Jehovah.
‎Jehovah is not just a Lord somewhere, which could apply to anyone,
‎but he is Jehovah, our God.
‎He extends his hand to us and says, well,
‎‘I’m Jehovah; call me by that name.’

title: 로버트 시렌코: 하느님의 백성은 그분의 이름을 영광스럽게 한다 (베드로 전서 2:10)

ko.text: ‎하느님의 백성 즉 하느님의 ‎영적 이스라엘을 이루고 있었습니다.
‎오늘 성구 앞 구절에서, ‎베드로는 그들의 임무를 설명했습니다.
‎1세기 중앙장로회 모임에서 한 것으로 ‎보고된 말과도 일치합니다.
‎‘그 후에 내가 돌아와서 다윗의 ‎무너진 천막을 다시 일으킬 것이며
‎그것은 남은 자들이 내 이름으로 불리는 ‎모든 이방 사람들과 함께
‎유일하신 참하느님의 이름을 지니는 건 ‎정말 자랑스럽고 영광스런 일이죠.
‎그분을 잘못 알리는 거짓 가르침들을 ‎폭로할 의무 아래 있습니다.
‎먼저 많은 사람이 속아 넘어간 ‎한 거짓말의 예를 말씀드리죠.
‎아마 미술계 역사를 통틀어 가장 ‎극적인 사기극을 벌인 사람일 겁니다.
‎그는 페르메이르 작품을 흉내 낸 ‎6개의 그림을 만들어냈습니다.
‎「엠마우스의 예수와 사도들」 ‎(Christ and the Disciples at Emmaus)이란 그림이죠.
‎당시 미술사 분야의 최고 권위자는 ‎그 그림이 오리지널 캔버스에 그려진,
‎가장 오래된 그리스어 사본들에서는 ‎찾을 수 없는 표현입니다.
‎그리고 수 세기 동안 교회들은 ‎삼위일체 교리를 퍼뜨렸습니다.
‎“결국 삼위일체 교의는 ‎4세기 후반에 가서야 고안된 것이다.
‎하느님께 기도한 것은 ‎시늉에 불과했다는 뜻이 될 것이다.
‎••• 예수가 죽었음을 인정한다면, ‎또 다른 딜레마에 빠진다.
‎왜냐면 많은 사람이 믿듯, ‎세 하느님이 모두 하나라면
‎어둡고 미신적인 과거로부터 ‎우리에게 물려준 교의를 옹호하기 위해,
‎네, 여호와의 백성은 오직 ‎한 분인 참하느님에 관한 진리를
‎하느님의 이름을 거룩하게 하기 위해 ‎기울여 온 노력은
‎“그때에 여호와를 두려워하는 사람들이 ‎저마다 자기 친구와 서로 말하니,
‎‘내가 특별한 재산을 산출하는 날에 ‎그들이 나의 소유가 될 것이다.’”
‎자신을 두려워하고 자신의 이름을 ‎소중히 여기는 사람들을 사랑하시며

en.text: ‎By the time the apostle Peter
‎wrote the words of today’s text,
‎individuals who were Jews,
‎proselytes, Samaritans,
‎and Gentiles had been brought
‎into the Christian congregation
‎as God’s people,
‎the spiritual Israel of God.
‎In the verse before today’s text,
‎Peter outlined what their mission was.
‎Let’s open to 1 Peter chapter 2 and read that.
‎It’s in verses 9 and 10 of 1 Peter 2.
‎He wrote:
‎“But you are ‘a chosen race, a royal priesthood,
‎“‘a holy nation, a people for special possession,
‎“that you should declare abroad the excellencies’
‎“of the One who called you out of darkness into his wonderful light.
‎“For you were once not a people,
‎but now you are God’s people.”
‎And, of course, this refers to the spirit-anointed members
‎of the congregation who would be responsible
‎for glorifying Jehovah’s name as his Witnesses.
‎And this harmonizes with what Peter had said years earlier
‎in the first-century governing body meeting,
‎as reported in Acts chapter 15.
‎So let’s turn there, Acts 15,
‎and we will begin with verse 14.
‎It says: “Symeon has related thoroughly how God
‎“for the first time turned his attention to the nations
‎“to take out of them a people for his name.
‎“And with this the words of the Prophets agree,
‎“just as it is written:
‎“‘After these things I will return and raise up again
‎“‘the tent of David that is fallen down;
‎“‘I will rebuild its ruins and restore it,
‎“‘so that the men who remain may earnestly seek Jehovah,
‎“‘together with people of all the nations,
‎“‘people who are called by my name,
‎says Jehovah, who is doing these things.’”
‎Now, what about the rest of us
‎who are not anointed Christians
‎but who call ourselves Jehovah’s Witnesses?
‎Are we also God’s people?
‎Well, most certainly!
‎And what a proud honor it is for us
‎to bear the name of the only true God.
‎But with that name comes responsibility,
‎one that other religious groups do not want to take on.
‎You see, we are under obligation
‎to bear witness to Jehovah,
‎to tell the truth about him,
‎and to expose false teachings
‎that misrepresent Jehovah.
‎And a classic example of an unscriptural dogma
‎that God’s people have exposed is the Trinity,
‎which reminds me of another hoax
‎that fooled many people who should have known better.
‎It’s the true story about a man named van Meegeren,
‎a Dutch artist, born in 1889,
‎who perpetrated what may have been
‎the most sensational art hoax of all time.
‎You see, he never won the critical acclaim
‎that he thought he was due as an artist.
‎So to get back at the art critics,
‎he decided to demonstrate his talent
‎by producing a painting that would fool them all,
‎and he set out to imitate
‎the famous 17th-century Dutch impressionist,
‎Johannes Vermeer.
‎Well, van Meegeren spent 4 years figuring out
‎how to make a new painting look 300 years old.
‎The canvas was the easy part.
‎He just took a lesser-known painting
‎from the 17th century and removed the picture.
‎His biggest problem was getting oil paint
‎to harden thoroughly, which usually takes 50 years.
‎He solved it by mixing his pigments with a synthetic resin
‎instead of oil and then baking the canvas.
‎Well, van Meegeren produced six paintings
‎that were passed off as Vermeers.
‎His greatest sold in 1937.
‎It was entitled Christ and the Disciples at Emmaus.
‎The most authoritative art historian of the day
‎said it was a genuine Vermeer masterpiece,
‎untouched, on the original canvas,
‎and that it had no restoration done to it.
‎But in reality, it was a fake.
‎The critic’s opinion was taken as gospel in the art world,
‎so much so that this critic had been nicknamed “The Pope.”
‎Eventually, though, a chemical analysis proved
‎that the paint contained an ingredient that had not been discovered
‎until two centuries after Vermeer died,
‎and that’s what exposed van Meegeren as a fraud.
‎Well, something similar went on during the apostasy
‎that took place after the death of the apostles.
‎Less than 300 years after the Bible was completed,
‎a Trinitarian added to 1 John 5:7 the words
‎“in heaven, the Father, the Word, and the Holy Ghost:
‎and these three are one.”
‎However, this addition does not appear
‎in the oldest Greek manuscripts,
‎proving it’s a fake; it’s a corruption of God’s Word.
‎And yet for centuries, the churches propagated the Trinity doctrine.
‎As recently as the 19th century,
‎almost all Bible translations
‎had this spurious addition.
‎As late as 1897, Pope Leo XIII
‎upheld the corrupted text
‎of the Latin Vulgate.
‎Interestingly, the New Catholic Encyclopedia
‎comments on this and says: “The Trinitarian dogma
‎“is in the last analysis a late 4th century invention.
‎“Among the Apostolic Fathers,
‎“there had been nothing even remotely approaching
‎such a mentality or perspective.”
‎Well, Jehovah’s anointed Witnesses
‎firmly rejected Christendom’s Trinity dogma.
‎In 1915, The Watch Tower exposed the foolishness
‎of teaching a doctrine that contradicts the Bible.
‎The Watch Tower said:
‎“In what a jumble of contradictions
‎“and confusion do they find themselves who say
‎“that Jesus and the Father are one God!
‎“This would involve the idea
‎“that our Lord Jesus acted the hypocrite when on earth
‎“and only pretended to address God in prayer,
‎“when He Himself was the same God. . . .
‎“The Father has always been immortal, hence could not die.
‎“How then, could Jesus have died? . . .
‎“The Scriptures declare, however, that He did die. . . .
‎“If they admit that Jesus really died, they take the other horn of the dilemma;
‎“for believing that their three Gods
‎“are all one person as many do,
‎“when Jesus died they must all three have died.
‎“If they all died, who raised them to life?
‎“How foolish all this sounds! . . .
‎“Shall we thus contradict the Apostles and Prophets and Jesus Himself,
‎“and ignore reason and common sense, in order to hold
‎“to a dogma handed to us from the dark, superstitious past,
‎“by a corrupt apostate Church?
‎Nay!” says The Watch Tower.
‎Well, Jehovah’s people continue to uphold the excellencies
‎ of the only true God.
‎Whether in ancient times, as with the natural Israelites
‎or in modern times, as with spiritual Israel,
‎Jehovah’s words through Isaiah are still true.
‎Look at it at Isaiah 43:21.
‎Of course, we know in Isaiah chapter 43
‎Jehovah declares: “You are my witnesses.”
‎And in verse 21 he says:
‎“The people whom I formed for myself
‎so that they might declare my praise.”
‎And the effort that Jehovah’s Witnesses​
‎—God’s people​— have put forth to expose
‎ Bible teachings that are false,
‎to teach the truth about Jehovah,
‎and to sanctify God’s name has taken on proportions
‎never attained by any other religious group.
‎And Jehovah takes notice of that.
‎Look at Malachi the 3rd chapter.
‎Malachi chapter 3,
‎beginning with verse 16.
‎Malachi 3:​16:
‎“At that time those who feared Jehovah spoke with one another,
‎“each one with his companion,
‎“and Jehovah kept paying attention and listening.
‎“And a book of remembrance was written before him
‎“for those fearing Jehovah and for those meditating on
‎“[or the footnote says, possibly, “treasuring”] his name.
‎“‘And they will be mine,’ says Jehovah of armies,
‎‘in the day when I produce a special property.’”
‎So Jehovah truly does love those
‎who fear him and treasure his name,
‎making them truly God’s people.

cn.text: 今天的经文出自使徒彼得
写给基督徒会众的信
当时会众里有犹太人
归信犹太教的人
撒马利亚人和外族人
他们都已经成为上帝的子民
也就是“上帝的以色列”
在彼得前书2:9
彼得概述了他们有什么使命
请打开彼得前书第2章
读这里的经文
彼得前书2:9,10这样说:
“你们‘是上帝挑选的一族人
是有王权的祭司
是圣洁的国族
是专属于他的子民
应该宣扬他的美德’
因为他已经呼召你们从黑暗出来
进入他奇妙的光里
你们以往不是上帝的子民
现在却是他的子民”
当然，经文的说话对象
是会众里受神圣力量任命的人
他们有责任颂扬耶和华的名
为他作见证
这跟多年前彼得在公元1世纪的
中央长老团会议上说的一致
这些话记在使徒行传15章
让我们一起翻到使徒行传15章
我们会从第14节开始读
“西门刚才详述了上帝第一次眷顾外族人时
怎样从他们当中选出一群归他名下的子民
这件事跟先知书上的话完全吻合
圣经上写着:‘这些事以后
我要回来重新建起大卫倒塌的帐篷
重建废墟，把帐篷再次竖立起来
让余下的人跟所有国族中称为我名下的人
一起恳切寻求耶和华
这是耶和华说的’”
那么我们呢？
我们也为耶和华作见证
但不是受任命到天上
我们也是上帝的子民吗？
当然是！
我们很荣幸能够成为
独一真神名下的子民
可是，这也意味着我们有一项责任
这是其他宗教团体不愿意承担的
这项责任就是
为耶和华作见证
告诉别人跟上帝有关的真理
并且揭露那些曲解耶和华的错误教义
在不符合圣经的教义当中
三位一体是个典型的例子
说到这里，我想到了一个骗局
当时，连许多专家也上当了
这是个真实的故事
有一位荷兰画家
名叫汉·凡·米格伦
生于1889年
他曾经制造了艺术史上
可以说是最轰动的一场骗局
米格伦觉得自己很有才华
但从未得到艺术评论家的认可
为了报复他们，证明自己的才华
他决定画一幅作品愚弄他们
他就伪造了17世纪著名的荷兰印象派画家
约翰内斯·维米尔的画作
米格伦花了4年的时间研究
如何使油画看起来像300年前画的
旧的画布不难找
只要找一幅17世纪不出名的油画
把上面的颜料去掉就行
最难的是让颜料干透
因为这通常需要50年
他没有用油
而是用合成树脂跟颜料混合
然后把画布拿去烘干
他用这样的方式仿制了维米尔的画作
一共6幅
最著名的一幅在1937年出售
名为《耶稣与他的门徒》
当时一位最权威的艺术史学家说
这是一幅真迹，是维米尔本人的杰作
没有任何破损和修复的痕迹
画布也是当年的画布
但其实这就是一幅赝品
这位专家的话在艺术界相当受重视
他甚至被称为艺术界的“教皇”
后来有化学分析证实
这幅油画中有一种成分
是维米尔去世两个世纪后才有人使用的
人们这才知道米格伦是个大骗子
其实在使徒们去世之后
叛道者也做了类似的事情
圣经写成后不到300年
鼓吹三位一体的人
在约翰一书5:7加了这句话:
“在天上有父，有道，有圣灵
这三位是合一的”
但圣经最古老的希腊语抄本没有这段话
可见这是伪造的
歪曲了上帝的话语
多个世纪以来
教会一直传播三位一体的教义
在19世纪
几乎所有的圣经译本都还是保留着
这节杜撰的经文
1897年，教皇利奥十三世
坚持在《通俗拉丁文本圣经》里保留这句话
值得留意的是
根据《新天主教百科全书》
三位一体这个教义
其实是在公元4世纪末才出现的
1世纪末到2世纪中叶的宗教作家
都没提过三位一体
或者任何相关的主张
受任命到天上的基督徒
坚决不认同一般教会主张的三位一体教义
在1915年，《守望台》指出
教导人跟圣经矛盾的教义是愚不可及的
《守望台》说:
“有些人声称耶稣和天父是同一位
他们的这种说法
是多么矛盾、多么混乱！
这样的说法会让人以为
主耶稣是个虚伪的人
他如果是上帝，他祷告就是装出来的
既然天父是永远不死的
耶稣又怎么会死去呢？
圣经说耶稣确实曾经死去
如果他们承认耶稣真的死了
又会陷入另一个困境
因为上帝如果是三位一体的
那么当耶稣死去时，三位就都死了
要是这样，谁来复活耶稣呢？
这个教义多么荒唐！
这个教义来自腐化叛道的教会
从黑暗的迷信时期流传下来
不符合使徒、先知和耶稣的教导
也违背常识
我们该相信这个主张吗？
怎么可能！”
一直以来
耶和华的子民不断告诉人
有关上帝的真理
耶和华曾通过以赛亚
对古代血统上的以色列人说过一些话
记载在以赛亚书43章
这些话在今天也适用于“上帝的以色列”
在以赛亚书43:10
耶和华说:“你们是我的见证人”
在21节耶和华继续说:
“这族人是我为自己塑造的
我要使他们宣扬我可颂可赞的事”
耶和华见证人作为上帝的子民
一直以来都努力揭露不符合圣经的教义
我们也教导人关于上帝的真理
使上帝的名彰显为圣
这些是其他任何宗教团体都没有做到的
耶和华十分珍视这一切
让我们一起看看玛拉基书
玛拉基书第3章
从16节开始
“那时候，敬畏耶和华的人彼此交谈
耶和华一直留心倾听
敬畏耶和华、细想他名字的人
［脚注说，也可译作珍视他名字的人］
都被记录在他面前的纪念册上
天军的统帅耶和华说:
‘日后我要使一群人成为我珍爱的产业
他们会归我所有’”
由此可见
耶和华真的很爱那些敬畏他
并珍视他名的人
让他们成为自己名下的子民

ko.text: ‎영어를 사용하는 전 세계 형제 자매들은 ‎큰 기쁨과 유익을 얻었습니다.
‎「신세계역」 제1권이 발표된 지 ‎60년이 넘는 시간이 지났고,
‎그리고 헝가리어가 있는데 이 언어론 ‎2000년에 처음 발행되었습니다.
‎형제 자매들은 자신의 언어로 나온 ‎「신세계역」 개정판에 대해
‎방금 읽은 내용을 깊이 ‎묵상하는 데 도움이 되죠.
‎‘나의 종 갈렙은 다른 생각을 가졌다’고 ‎번역되어 있죠.
‎형제 자매들은 하느님의 말씀을 ‎더 잘 이해하게 되었습니다.
‎성구를 읽어 줄 때 사람들이 더 빨리 ‎이해하는 걸 느낄 수 있어요.
‎사람들은 성경을 읽을 때 ‎대부분의 내용을 이해할 수 있습니다.
‎본문에 복잡하게 많은 단어가 ‎들어 있지 않기 때문입니다.
‎히브리어의 문장 구조나 표현 방식을 ‎모방하려고 하지 않은 거죠.
‎그 결과, 현대어를 사용하니까 ‎글이 더 자연스럽고 명료해졌죠.
‎화가 났는지, 절망했는지, ‎슬픈지 곧바로 알 수 있죠.
‎일례로 마태 11장에서 예수께서 ‎자신의 멍에를 메라고 말씀하실 때,
‎그런데 개정된 성경엔 ‎이 부분이 여러 문장으로 나뉘어 있어서,
‎「신세계역」 개정판은 곧 ‎더 많은 언어로 발행될 것입니다.
‎여호와께서는 그분이 분명하고 ‎이해하기 쉬운 언어로 말씀하실 때
‎그렇게 할 때 우리는 ‎여호와를 훨씬 더 잘 알게 되고,

en.text: ‎The release of the revised version
‎of the New World Translation of the Holy Scriptures
‎in the English language in 2013
‎had a wonderful impact on the English-speaking world.
‎As Brother Jackson noted,
‎more than 60 years had passed since the release of the first volume
‎of the New World Translation, and during that time,
‎the English language had changed as well.
‎During 2017,
‎the revised version
‎of the New World Translation of the Holy Scriptures
‎has been released
‎in some major European languages,
‎such as Italian (originally released in 1963),
‎Dutch (also originally released in 1963),
‎Greek (originally released in 1997),
‎and Hungarian (originally released in 2000).
‎How do the brothers and sisters feel
‎about the revised New World Translation in their particular language?
‎The modern language
‎in this revised version of the Bible
‎helps me to understand Bible passages
‎because now it flows better and is much simpler.
‎This helps me to meditate more on what I have just read.
‎At Numbers 14:24,
‎Jehovah speaks to Moses.
‎In the older version, Jehovah says about Caleb
‎that “a different spirit has proved to be with him.”
‎In the revised version, the verse reads
‎that ‘my servant Caleb thinks differently’
‎—very clear and doesn’t need further explanation.
‎Psalm 7:9 now says
‎that Jehovah “examines the hearts
‎and the deepest emotions,”
‎whereas previously it said he examines the ‘hearts and the kidneys.’
‎Now it’s easier to understand.
‎Besides all the aspects of helping to get
‎a better understanding of God’s Word,
‎why are brothers and sisters happy to use this revised version
‎in field service?
‎When reading a scripture,
‎you can tell that people understand
‎it more quickly;
‎there is less need to explain more.
‎And that’s great.
‎I particularly like the glossary;
‎it’s a kind of mini Insight book.
‎It has been very useful
‎when I study and also in the ministry.
‎Furthermore, I like
‎that at the beginning of the Bible,
‎there are 20 introductions
‎that answer questions that people in the territory often ask,
‎and they have Bible verses and very nice illustrations.
‎So they are very clear and practical.
‎To achieve such an awesome result by revising the New World Translation,
‎which important aspects did the translators have to keep in mind?
‎Thanks to the modern language
‎that is used in the revision,
‎readers can understand most Bible passages as they read them,
‎without having to stop and read them over again.
‎This is possible, in part,
‎because the text is not cluttered with too many words
‎—trying to copy the Hebrew syntax and style of expression.
‎Thus, the use of modern language
‎contributes to naturalness and clarity.
‎The language used
‎in the revision also now allows
‎the emotions of the characters to come through more vividly.
‎You straightaway notice when someone
‎is angry or desperate or sad.
‎Like in Matthew 11, when Jesus invites us to take his yoke upon us,
‎his warmth is immediately obvious.
‎In the 2003 edition,
‎only one sentence was packed
‎into seven verses,
‎and its length was half a column,
‎making it very cumbersome to follow the line of thought.
‎In the revised Bible, this part was cut into more sentences,
‎so it is easier to grasp the idea.
‎Many parents have told us
‎that now when they read the Bible
‎with their children,

en.text: ‎Nick, thanks so much for being willing
‎to come along and answer some questions for us.
‎Yes, I’m glad to come.
‎Well, now that we’ve got you here, the first question I’d like to ask you is,
‎What really are these so-called J-References?
‎Well the “J” in the J-References
‎stands for Jehovah.
‎And this is mainly a list of Bibles
‎in Hebrew and other languages
‎that use the divine name, Jehovah,
‎in the main text of the Christian Greek Scriptures
‎—or at least some form of the name Jehovah.
‎And this list began to be compiled
‎by the New World Bible Translation Committee
‎in the 1940’s.
‎So where would we find a list like that now?
‎Well, originally there was a list of 21 such references
‎in the 1950 edition of the Christian Greek Scriptures.
‎Then, in 1984,
‎27 such references were included
‎in the Reference Bible in English.
‎And since that time, many more J-References have been found,
‎and now the list includes
‎over 90 such translations and reference works.
‎And you can find an up-to-date list
‎in Appendix C4 of the [Study] Bible.
‎Very good.
‎So I guess the main question we’re interested in asking you is,
‎Do these J-References prove in themselves
‎that the Tetragrammaton should be in the Christian Greek Scriptures?
‎Actually, no; they don’t.
‎Ah, now, I’m sure most of us weren’t expecting you to say that.
‎So can you explain it a little bit more please?
‎Well, the New World Translation Committee
‎did not rely on the J-References as the basis for their decision
‎to restore the divine name in the Christian Greek Scriptures.
‎You already discussed the basis for the decision
‎earlier in the broadcast.
‎Rather, these J-References provide proof
‎that other translators have made similar decisions
‎when restoring the divine name
‎to their editions of the Christian Greek Scriptures,
‎or the so-called New Testament.
‎So, now that you’re talking about these other Bible translators,
‎could you give us an example of who you’re talking about?
‎Well, a number of them were well-known Bible scholars.
‎For example, 19th-century Lutheran theologian Franz Delitzsch
‎is still considered to be a foremost Bible scholar
‎and a scholar of Biblical Hebrew.
‎Delitzsch’s translation
‎of the New Testament in Hebrew was produced in 1877,
‎and it’s one of the J-References.
‎In fact, it’s still one of the best-known New Testaments
‎in the Hebrew language.
‎In that translation, he discerned when to use Jehovah’s name
‎in places where the Greek text
‎contains the term Kyʹri·os, or Lord.
‎The New World Bible Translation Committee
‎studied all those occurrences from his translation
‎as well as the occurrences in others of the J-References.
‎So how would you summarize what the value is of these J-References?
‎Well, all the J-References,
‎including the new ones in the Study Bible,
‎represent the view of translators and scholars
‎who arrived at the same conclusion
‎that the New World Bible Translation Committee did,
‎namely, that Jesus Christ and the apostles
‎used the name Jehovah in their teaching and in their writings.
‎And this conclusion is reflected
‎in their translation and reference works.
‎Very interesting. That’s fascinating.
‎So if I’ve got it right then,
‎what you’re saying is that if we go to Appendix C, in C3,
‎there we’ve got a list of the reasons
‎why the brothers on the New World Translation Committee
‎decided to put Jehovah’s name in certain verses.
‎And then C4 is virtually
‎a list of other Bible translations
‎where the translators made exactly the same decision.
‎Is that right?
‎That’s exactly right.
‎Ah, that’s good.
‎Well, thank you very much, Nick, for coming along.
‎We really appreciated hearing those expressions from you.
‎Before you go, though, can we ask you, please,
‎Can you take back the love and greetings and an expression of appreciation
‎to all those hardworking brothers and sisters there in Translation Services?
‎Yes, I’d be happy to.
‎Thank you very much.

ko.text: ‎성경 번역의 중요한 목표가 ‎되어야 하는 것은 무엇일까요?
‎이번 달 주제에 ‎바로 그 답이 들어 있습니다.
‎그분은 곧 겪게 될 일 때문에 ‎매우 괴로워하면서도,
‎모든 성경 번역판에 하느님의 ‎고유한 이름이 나와야 하는
‎이번 달엔 이 주제와 관련된 ‎또 다른 부면을 살펴볼 텐데요,
‎신약 성경에 그 이름을 ‎사용하는 것에는 동의하지 않습니다.
‎또 탐정이 되어 ‎몇 가지 조사를 해 봐야 합니다.
‎그 당시 신세계역 성경 번역 위원회는 ‎마태복음을 번역 중이었습니다.
‎히브리어 성경에서 인용한 부분이 ‎아주 많다는 데 유의했을 겁니다.
‎아니면 “주” 같은 대체 표현을 ‎그 이름 대신 쓰셨습니까?
‎마태 22:44을 아주 흥미롭게 ‎처리했단 걸 알게 됐을 겁니다.
‎“주”를 뜻하는 영어 단어 “LORD”를 ‎모두 대문자로 쓴 것이죠.
‎히브리어 본문에 하느님의 이름이 ‎있다는 걸 표시하기 위해 사용됩니다.
‎하느님의 이름이, 원래 그 인용문에 ‎들어 있었다는 걸 인정하는 것입니다.
‎바로 그 무렵에 ‎학자들이 틀렸다는 걸 증명해 준
‎그중 한 가지 발견에 대한 ‎증거 자료를 실어 놓았죠.
‎참조할 수 있는 가장 오래된 ‎그리스어 성경 사본들엔
‎아주 초기부터 원문의 필사자들은 ‎하느님의 이름을 그냥 대체해 버렸고
‎그리스어 성경은 신성한 히브리어 ‎성경에 추가된 영감받은 기록물이었죠.
‎따라서 히브리어 성경에 약 ‎7000번이나 사용된 하느님의 이름이
‎그리스어 본문에 테트라그람마톤이 ‎한 번도 아니고 곳곳에 있었던 거죠.
‎두 명의 여호와의 증인은 ‎이집트 카이로에 있는 그 단편들을
‎신세계역 번역 위원회의 우리 형제들이 ‎연구•조사를 하고 있을 때,
‎그 일은 하느님의 영원한 이름이 ‎드러나야 한다는 점을 확증해 줬습니다.
‎여호와를 섬기려는 모든 사람이 ‎그 이름을 알아야 했습니다.
‎예수께서 아버지께 기도하며 말씀하신 ‎이런 내용이 참됨을 보여 줍니다.
‎“저는 아버지의 이름을 알려 주었고 ‎또 알려 주겠습니다.”
‎우리 여호와의 증인들은 “그분의 ‎이름을 위한 백성”이 되어 뿌듯합니다.
‎여호와란 분을 알려면 반드시 ‎그분의 이름을 알아야 하죠.
‎여호와께서 그분의 백성을 사용해 ‎「신세계역」 성경을 마련해 주신 것을 보면
‎히브리어로 된 하느님의 이름이 ‎들어 있었다는 증거를 찾은 것입니다.
‎형제들이 그 정보를 입수할 수 ‎있었던 건 정말 다행인데,
‎왜냐면 그 단편들이 ‎대중이 볼 수 있게 출판된 건
‎1947년에 발견되기 시작한 ‎또 다른 중요한 자료를 기억하십니까?
‎두루마리 중 많은 수가 ‎예수 시대 전후의 것들입니다.
‎가장 먼저, 각 그림이 원래 ‎어디에 있었는지 알아내야겠죠.
‎일단 그 자리에 가짜 그림이 ‎걸려 있는 게 확인되면,
‎진짜 그림을 원래 있어야 할 자리에 ‎되돌려 놓을 수 있을 겁니다.
‎그림 도둑이 한 것과 ‎같은 일이 벌어진 거죠.
‎우리가 조사해 볼 수 있는 ‎그리스도인 그리스어 성경의
‎현존하는 가장 오래된 사본들도 ‎기원 2세기 말 이후의 것들인데,
‎우리가 알게 된 것처럼, 그때는 ‎이미 범죄가 저질러진 이후입니다.
‎그 이름이 그리스어 본문 어디에 ‎있었는지를 어떻게 알 수 있을까요?
‎그리스어 성경 본문에 나오는 ‎“주”라는 단어를 모두 검토해서
‎즉 여호와의 이름이 원래 있던 자리가 ‎어디인지를 찾는 데 도움이 됩니다.
‎하느님의 이름이 사용된 ‎히브리어 성경 구절을 인용한 곳에
‎그 자리에 여호와의 이름이 ‎있었다는 단서가 되는 것이죠.
‎원래 여호와께서 하신 말씀을 ‎인용한 구절의 주변 문맥에
‎“이 모든 일이 일어난 것은 ‎여호와께서 예언자를 통해 하신
‎이 예언의 소식은 이사야를 통해 ‎여호와께서 하신 말씀이죠.
‎“주”를 뜻하는 그리스어 단어 ‎‘키리오스’ 앞에 정관사가 없는 경우인데,
‎그리스어 문법상 정관사가 붙는 것이 ‎일반적인 곳에 정관사가 없는 경우죠.
‎편집자가 와서 가족들이 그의 ‎사망 소식을 아직 듣지 못했다고 하면서
‎“운전자”란 말 앞에 정관사가 ‎빠지게 되면 이상한 말이 돼 버립니다.
‎그런 예를 마가복음 13:20의 ‎그리스어 본문에서 볼 수 있습니다.
‎그래서 신세계역이 이 구절에 ‎하느님의 이름을 복원한 것입니다.
‎하느님의 이름을 “주”로 바꿨다는 ‎다른 강력한 증거들이 있을 수 있습니다.
‎“집으로 가서 친족들에게 여호와께서 ‎당신에게 해 주신 모든 일과
‎이 성구에서 왜 “주”가 예수가 아니라 ‎여호와라고 할 수 있을까요?
‎도둑맞은 그림들을 원래 자리에 ‎되돌려 놓을 수 있었던 것입니다.
‎「워치타워 온라인 라이브러리」에서도 ‎같은 내용을 보실 수 있습니다.

en.text: ‎In addition to being clear and accurate,
‎what should be the primary goal of any Bible translation?
‎The answer is found
‎in the theme of our program this month:
‎“Father, Glorify Your Name.”
‎It’s based on Jesus’ words
‎recorded at John 12:28.
‎Let’s start by examining the context of those words
‎as found in verses 27 and 28:
‎“‘Now I am troubled, and what should I say?
‎“‘Father, save me out of this hour.
‎“‘Nevertheless, this is why I have come to this hour.
‎“Father, glorify your name.’
‎“Then a voice came out of heaven:
‎‘I have glorified it and will glorify it again.’”
‎Jesus uttered these words
‎just four days before his agonizing death.
‎But even though Jesus was very troubled
‎about what was soon to happen to him,
‎what was his primary concern?
‎It was for Jehovah’s name to be glorified.
‎We today are likewise concerned
‎about the glorification of Jehovah’s name and his reputation.
‎But how can someone be glorified, or made famous,
‎if nobody knows his name?
‎Knowing God’s personal name, Jehovah,
‎is closely tied in with glorifying his reputation.
‎In fact, knowing Jehovah’s name
‎is the very first step in that process.
‎The June 2015 program of JW Broadcasting
‎discussed why God’s personal name
‎should appear in all translations of the Bible.
‎You might find it helpful to review that program.
‎But this month, we will consider another aspect of this subject
‎that is far more controversial, namely,
‎Should the divine name appear in the Christian Greek Scriptures,
‎or what is commonly called the New Testament?
‎Many scholars who agree with us
‎that the divine name should appear in the Hebrew Scriptures
‎disagree with our use of the same name
‎in the New Testament.
‎So, what prompted the translators of the New World Translation
‎to restore the divine name 237 times
‎in the Christian Greek Scriptures?
‎The answer to that question involves some fascinating events
‎that seem to be too amazing to be just coincidence.
‎It also requires us to do some detective work.
‎Sound intriguing?
‎It is!
‎So let’s start our journey together.
‎First of all, imagine that you are back in the late 1940’s
‎—the time when the New World Bible Translation Committee
‎was translating the book of Matthew.
‎As they started the project,
‎no doubt they realized that Matthew’s account contains
‎many quotations from the Hebrew Scriptures.
‎Many of these contain the Tetragrammaton,
‎that is, the divine name in Hebrew letters in the original text.
‎For example, let’s consider Matthew 22:44.
‎This verse records Jesus quoting the words of Psalm 110:1:
‎“Jehovah said to my Lord: ‘Sit at my right hand.’”
‎But did Jesus use the divine name when making this quote?
‎Or did he substitute the divine name
‎with an equivalent such as “Lord”?
‎Well, the brothers would have realized
‎that many editions of the King James Version
‎did something very interesting at Matthew 22:44.
‎In that verse, the English word “LORD”
‎is written in capital letters.
‎This technique is used throughout the King James Version
‎to indicate where the original Hebrew text uses the divine name.
‎So using “LORD” in capital letters in this verse,
‎in effect, acknowledges that the name of God
‎was originally in this quote.
‎The implication is
‎that Jesus used God’s name when making this quote.
‎However, in the years prior to the release of the New World Translation,
‎many scholars argued that long before Jesus came to earth,
‎the Jewish people had already removed the Tetragrammaton
‎from the Greek translation of the Hebrew text —the Septuagint.
‎If true, that would mean
‎that copies of the Holy Writings used in Jesus’ day
‎would not have contained the divine name.
‎So, what should the Translation Committee do?
‎Should they use the divine name in their translation or not?
‎This is where the story becomes intriguing.
‎Around that time, some exciting discoveries
‎were made that proved those scholars wrong.
‎One of these discoveries was documented by the brothers
‎in the foreword of the 1950 edition
‎of the New World Translation of the Christian Greek Scriptures.
‎It involved some papyri copies of the Septuagint
‎that dated back to around the time of Jesus.
‎What did these papyri fragments reveal?
‎Let’s find out in this documentary report.
‎the New World Translation of the Christian Greek Scriptures was released.
‎“I have the extreme pleasure of releasing
‎“the New World Translation
‎of the Christian Greek Scriptures!”
‎This translation was unique
‎in that it restored the divine name, Jehovah,
‎237 times in the main text
‎of the so-called New Testament.
‎But how could they do that, considering that for centuries
‎many Bibles did not use Jehovah’s name?
‎And why did the divine name need to be restored?
‎The oldest copies we have available
‎do not use the divine name
‎in the Christian Greek Scriptures;
‎they use substitutes like God or Lord.
‎Very early on,
‎the copyists of those original manuscripts,
‎they simply replaced
‎—they got into the practice of replacing— God’s name.
‎We know that this is not a translation
‎because one is a name and the other one is a title.
‎And it’s not even a synonym for Jehovah, for a name.
‎Since the Greek Scriptures
‎were an inspired addition
‎to the sacred Hebrew Scriptures and,
‎in fact,
‎Jehovah’s name, God’s name,
‎was used some 7,000 times in the Hebrew Scriptures,
‎the sudden disappearance in the Greek text is inconsistent.
‎Even though the New World Bible Translation Committee
‎believed that Jehovah’s name should appear
‎in the text of the Christian Greek Scriptures,
‎they also knew that at that time
‎virtually all Bible scholars disagreed with that belief.
‎Those scholars argued that by the time of Jesus,
‎even the Greek translation of the Hebrew Scriptures, the Septuagint,
‎no longer contained the divine name.
‎So why would the writers of the New Testament
‎use the divine name when their copies of the Holy Scriptures in Greek
‎did not contain the Tetragrammaton?
‎This view was based on faulty information.
‎How so?
‎Did the Septuagint still use
‎the divine name in Jesus’ time?
‎Let’s consider one piece of evidence
‎that answers this question.
‎Something amazing happened in 1944.
‎A theological journal published a picture
‎of a Greek Septuagint fragment
‎from the Papyrus Fouad 266 collection.
‎Now, inside that fragment there was the divine name.
‎In the Greek text, you had the Tetragrammaton,
‎not just once but throughout.
‎Now, this fragment was very old, dating back to the first century B.C.E.,
‎but the important point is that this was proof, clear proof,
‎that the divine name was originally there.
‎Two Jehovah’s Witnesses were asked
‎to obtain photographs of these fragments,
‎which were located in Cairo, Egypt.
‎The New World Translation Committee was very interested in this
‎because they started translating
‎the Greek Scriptures in 1947.
‎After obtaining permission, pictures of 12 of the fragments
‎were published in the foreword of the New World Translation
‎of the Christian Greek Scriptures.
‎What amazes me about this is the timing.
‎When our brothers —this New World Translation Committee—
‎did their research, before even translating,
‎suddenly something that was unknown
‎until essentially 1944
‎came to light that confirmed
‎that the eternal name of God
‎had to be revealed; it could no longer be hidden.
‎It should be shown to everyone who wants to worship Jehovah.
‎This careful preservation supports what Jesus said in prayer
‎at John 17:26, when he said to his Father:
‎“I have made your name known . . . and will make it known.”
‎As Jehovah’s Witnesses, we are proud to be “a people for his name.”
‎Knowing his name is essential to knowing Jehovah himself,
‎and the fact that Jehovah has provided this arrangement
‎through his people
‎makes it very clear
‎that he was gathering “a people for his name.”
‎This is why this Bible translation is so beautiful,
‎because it brings us closer to Jehovah.
‎Jehovah is not just a Lord somewhere, which could apply to anyone,
‎but he is Jehovah, our God.
‎He extends his hand to us and says, well,
‎‘I’m Jehovah; call me by that name.’
‎What an amazing find!
‎They found proof that the divine name in Hebrew letters
‎was included in the text of the Septuagint
‎that would have been available in Jesus’ day
‎and just at the right time
‎—the time when the members of the Translation Committee
‎were making the decision as to whether they should use
‎the name Jehovah in their translation of the Christian Greek Scriptures.
‎We are so happy that the brothers were able to find this information
‎because these fragments were not released for general publication
‎until much later in 1971
‎—years after the time when the committee needed to make that vital decision.
‎But that’s not all!
‎Do you remember what other important material
‎was discovered starting in 1947?
‎It was the Dead Sea Scrolls.
‎Many of these scrolls were dated to around the time when Jesus was on earth.
‎And what did these scrolls contain over and over again?
‎You guessed it
‎—the Tetragrammaton— the divine name.
‎Isn’t it interesting
‎that these discoveries were made around the time
‎when our brothers were translating the New World Translation?
‎Is this just coincidence
‎or do you see Jehovah’s hand in this?
‎What has happened in the years since that time?
‎It’s important to note
‎that the divine name is consistently used
‎in fragments of the Septuagint
‎that date from the first century B.C.E.
‎and the first century C.E.
‎This has led some scholars to acknowledge the possibility
‎that Jesus and his disciples
‎used the divine name when making these quotations.
‎But we need to remember that Hebrew Scripture quotations
‎account for approximately one third
‎of the 237 times
‎the New World Translation restores the divine name
‎in the Christian Greek Scriptures.
‎So, what about the other two thirds of occurrences?
‎Well, this brings us to the part of our program
‎that involves some detective work.
‎Imagine that you are a detective,
‎and you catch an art thief
‎who has stolen over 200 original pieces of art
‎from various museums and art galleries.
‎This thief not only stole each piece of art
‎but he also substituted it with a copy.
‎So you need to start an investigation
‎and follow the clues.
‎First of all, you need to find out
‎where each painting was located originally.
‎Once you have verified that fakes are hanging in those locations,
‎you would be in a position to return the originals
‎to their proper locations.
‎In a similar way, we have solid evidence
‎that a crime was committed in the second and third centuries C.E.
‎Apostate Christians removed the divine name
‎from manuscripts of the Bible
‎and replaced it with Kyʹri·os, the Greek word for “Lord.”
‎There is much evidence for this conclusion.
‎So they are like the art thief in our illustration.
‎They stole something valuable
‎when they removed Jehovah’s name from the Christian Greek Scriptures.
‎But we have a problem.
‎There are no copies of the Christian Greek Scriptures
‎from the first century for us to examine.
‎The earliest existing manuscripts
‎that would have a bearing on this matter
‎date from the late second century onward
‎—a time when we know that the crime had already been committed
‎and Jehovah’s name had already been removed.
‎So how do we know where Jehovah’s name
‎originally appeared in the Greek text
‎before the apostates removed it?
‎Well, just like the detective in our illustration,
‎we need to start an investigation
‎and follow the clues.
‎To do our work properly,
‎we need to examine every time the word “Lord” appears in the text
‎and see if it refers to Jehovah, to Jesus,
‎or to some other person with the title “Lord.”
‎Basically, there are five clues that will help us
‎to find out where the original artwork,
‎that is, Jehovah’s name, needs to be returned to.
‎Let’s scrutinize these clues.
‎The first clue is,
‎as we have already mentioned, the easiest clue,
‎where the title “Lord” appears
‎in quotations from the Hebrew Scriptures
‎that originally used the divine name.
‎The second clue is
‎where the Greek text contains a Hebrew idiom
‎that would normally contain the divine name.
‎For example, if someone says in English,
‎“He escaped by the skin of his . . . ,”
‎what word do you expect?
‎Teeth, not eye.
‎Yes, the expression is “skin of his teeth.”
‎This is similar with Hebrew expressions.
‎Some of these contain the divine name.
‎For example, the expression found at Matthew 1:20
‎is “the angel of Jehovah.”
‎So whenever we find a Greek translation of a Hebrew idiom
‎that uses the divine name,
‎this is another clue that Jehovah’s name should be there.
‎The third clue
‎is where the term “Lord” appears
‎in the context surrounding a quotation
‎that is originally attributed to Jehovah.
‎An example of this is Matthew 1:22:
‎“All of this actually came about to fulfill
‎what was spoken by Jehovah through his prophet, saying . . .”
‎The quotation that immediately follows at Matthew 1:23
‎is taken from Isaiah 7:14.
‎This is a prophetic message
‎spoken by Jehovah through Isaiah.
‎The fourth clue
‎is when we see in the Greek text
‎where there is no definite article before Kyʹri·os, the Greek word for “Lord,”
‎in places where the Greek grammar normally expects a definite article.
‎This clue may indicate that a proper name, such as Jehovah,
‎originally was there in the text
‎and was removed from later manuscripts and replaced with Kyʹri·os.
‎To illustrate the importance of this clue,
‎imagine that you are a newspaper reporter
‎who is reporting on a car accident.
‎You report that Joe Smith, the driver of the vehicle,
‎was killed in the accident.
‎But just before the story goes to press,
‎your editor informs you that Joe Smith’s relatives
‎have not yet been notified of his death.
‎So you are told to remove his name from the report.
‎You do that, but in doing so,
‎you forget to add the “the” before the word “driver.”
‎What would happen?
‎Your report would say,
‎“As a result of the accident, driver was killed.”
‎That sounds strange, doesn’t it?
‎It sounds like “driver” is the name of the person killed.
‎That’s because you suppressed the name
‎and forgot to add the appropriate article.
‎That is similar to what our symbolic art thieves did
‎when removing Jehovah’s name from the Bible.
‎An example of this
‎is found in the Greek text of Mark 13:20.
‎“In fact, unless Lord had cut short the days,
‎no flesh would be saved.”
‎That sounds like “Lord” is a name,
‎and clearly it should be Jehovah’s name.
‎That’s why the New World Translation restores the divine name in this verse.
‎However, even in cases where the definite article
‎occurs before the word “Lord,”
‎there may be other strong reasons
‎for viewing “Lord” as a substitute for the divine name,
‎like the ones we already discussed.
‎The final clue
‎is where the divine name needs to be added to avoid ambiguity.
‎An example of this
‎is in Mark 5:19.
‎There, Jesus says to a man he healed:
‎“Go home to your relatives,
‎“and report to them all the things
‎Jehovah has done for you and the mercy he has shown you.”
‎How do we know that “Lord” here refers to Jehovah
‎and not Jesus?
‎Well, in recording the same event,
‎Luke 8:39 uses the Greek word The·osʹ (God),
‎supporting the thought that Kyʹri·os (Lord) at Mark 5:19
‎is used with reference to Jehovah God.
‎So these five clues helped the New World Bible Translation Committee
‎to ascertain where the name Jehovah
‎should be restored to the Biblical text.
‎In this way, they were able to right the wrong
‎that was committed by apostate Christians
‎in the second and third centuries or,
‎in other words, they were able to return
‎the figurative pieces of stolen artwork
‎to their proper places.
‎If you would like to review these five clues,
‎you will find a detailed explanation in Appendix C
‎of the Study Edition of the New World Translation.
‎You can either find this in the JW Library® app
‎or online at Watchtower ONLINE LIBRARY.
‎In the same Appendix C,
‎you will find a list of what we call J-References
‎that support these decisions.
