ko.text: ‎그리스, 가나, 말레이시아에 있는 ‎형제들을 방문할 기회를 가졌습니다.
‎그리고 모든 참석자는 ‎발표 연설이 있고 난 직후에
‎그리스어 「신세계역」 개정판을 ‎발표할 수 있게 되어 매우 기쁩니다!
‎우린 그리스 베델 가족과 함께 ‎이틀을 더 보내고 나서
‎10월 27일 금요일에 몇 개 시설을 위한 ‎봉헌식을 가졌는데,
‎대회회관과 그 밖의 중계된 장소에 ‎1만 6000여 명이 참석했습니다.
‎이 나라의 13만 명이 넘는 전도인들이 ‎가장 많이 사용하는 언어죠.
‎가나의 이 세 가지 행사에서 ‎형제들이 느낀 기쁨을 잘 보여 줍니다.
‎규모는 작지만 아주 멋진 ‎베델 시설을 잠시 견학했죠.
‎아름답고 이해하기 쉬운 ‎새로운 회색 성경을 받게 된 것입니다.
‎여호와의 도구로 사용될 수 있었던 것은 ‎정말이지 큰 특권이었습니다!

en.text: ‎We had the privilege
‎in the latter part of October
‎and beginning of November
‎to visit our dear brothers
‎in Greece, Ghana, and Malaysia.
‎On Friday, October 20, we arrived in Athens, Greece.
‎The next day, we had a special program
‎during which the New World Translation was released in Greek,
‎and I tried to read it, but it was all Greek to me.
‎The original Greek New World Translation was released in 1993.
‎But now, 24 years later,
‎they received the revised version,
‎and they were “nothing but joyful,”
‎just like the Israelites during their festivals.
‎The brothers commented profusely
‎about how much more understandable their Bible is now.
‎And that reminds us of thoughts we still hear
‎about the revised English New World Translation.
‎How we love it!
‎We had more than 31,000 in attendance for the program,
‎including those at the Assembly Hall
‎and those tied in with us,
‎and all of them received their beautiful new gray Bibles
‎immediately after the release talk.
‎The following video
‎describes well the joy of that occasion.
‎Look at this video.
‎The Governing Body is so happy to be able to release
‎the revised Greek New World Translation.
‎After spending two additional days with the Greece Bethel family,
‎we left for Ghana, located in western Africa.
‎On Friday, October 27,
‎we held a combined dedication program
‎for the renovated expanded branch facility,
‎the Ewe remote translation office,
‎and the theocratic school facility, located not far from the branch,
‎which will primarily be used for SKE classes.
‎On Saturday, we had a special program in the Assembly Hall.
‎And during this program, the entire New World Translation
‎was released in the Ga language
‎and the Christian Greek Scriptures of the New World Translation
‎was released in the Dangme language.
‎More than 16,000 were in attendance
‎at the Assembly Hall and tied in.
‎The Dangme-speaking brothers
‎were on one side of the Assembly Hall
‎and the Ga-speaking brothers
‎on the other side of the double Assembly Hall.
‎Then on Sunday, we had a program in the Assembly Hall
‎for the entire branch territory
‎with a talk interpreted into the Twi language,
‎the biggest language
‎among the more than 130,000 publishers in the country.
‎Here’s a video that captures the spirit
‎of all three events there in Ghana.
‎The program will be streamed from here to all these three locations.
‎Do you want to dedicate these expanded facilities here at Bethel?
‎If so, say, “Yes!”
‎Then on Monday, October 30,
‎we left Ghana for our final assignment in Malaysia.
‎Then on Wednesday, after morning worship and a brief tour
‎of the small but very attractive Bethel facility,
‎we headed to the airport for a two-and-a-half-hour flight
‎to Kota Kinabalu on the island of Borneo.
‎And the next day, Thursday, November 2,
‎we held the dedication program
‎for the new Malay remote translation office.
‎What a beautiful, well-constructed new building this is,
‎and it will be used to Jehovah’s honor and praise!
‎Then Friday through Sunday,
‎we had the privilege to attend
‎the Malay regional convention with our dear brothers.
‎The first day of the convention,
‎the New World Translation in the Malay language was released.
‎Three years earlier,
‎they had received the Christian Greek Scriptures
‎but now were ecstatic to receive
‎their new beautiful, understandable gray Bibles
‎conveying the very sayings of Jehovah
‎in their mother tongue.
‎We have just one more brief video
‎to show you highlights of our visit to Malaysia.
‎Well, what a privilege it was to be able to be used
‎as a tool in Jehovah’s hand
‎to strengthen our brothers in these distant lands!
‎And every trip we take just convinces us even more
‎of the power of Jehovah’s holy spirit
‎and the fact that we truly have the truth.
‎Everywhere we went,
‎the brothers wanted to make sure
‎that we brought back the love and affection
‎that they have for the Governing Body
‎and the entire Bethel family.

ko.text: ‎어떻게 신세계역 성경 번역 위원회에 ‎크나큰 도움이 되었을까요?
‎참하느님을 찾도록 다른 사람을 ‎도울 때는 기분이 어떠신가요?
‎여호와를 찾는 일에 관한 ‎새로운 오리지널송을 들으실 것입니다.
‎새로운 증거에 따라 그 이름을 ‎여섯 군데 추가하는 거였죠.
‎성경 번역을 더욱더 ‎많은 언어로 하기 위한 겁니다.
‎좀 더 명료하고 이해하기 쉽게 ‎번역할 수 있다는 걸 알게 됐죠.
‎영어를 사용하는 전 세계 형제 자매들은 ‎큰 기쁨과 유익을 얻었습니다.
‎「신세계역」 제1권이 발표된 지 ‎60년이 넘는 시간이 지났고,
‎그리고 헝가리어가 있는데 이 언어론 ‎2000년에 처음 발행되었습니다.
‎형제 자매들은 자신의 언어로 나온 ‎「신세계역」 개정판에 대해
‎방금 읽은 내용을 깊이 ‎묵상하는 데 도움이 되죠.
‎‘나의 종 갈렙은 다른 생각을 가졌다’고 ‎번역되어 있죠.
‎형제 자매들은 하느님의 말씀을 ‎더 잘 이해하게 되었습니다.
‎성구를 읽어 줄 때 사람들이 더 빨리 ‎이해하는 걸 느낄 수 있어요.
‎사람들은 성경을 읽을 때 ‎대부분의 내용을 이해할 수 있습니다.
‎본문에 복잡하게 많은 단어가 ‎들어 있지 않기 때문입니다.
‎히브리어의 문장 구조나 표현 방식을 ‎모방하려고 하지 않은 거죠.
‎그 결과, 현대어를 사용하니까 ‎글이 더 자연스럽고 명료해졌죠.
‎화가 났는지, 절망했는지, ‎슬픈지 곧바로 알 수 있죠.
‎일례로 마태 11장에서 예수께서 ‎자신의 멍에를 메라고 말씀하실 때,
‎그런데 개정된 성경엔 ‎이 부분이 여러 문장으로 나뉘어 있어서,
‎「신세계역」 개정판은 곧 ‎더 많은 언어로 발행될 것입니다.
‎여호와께서는 그분이 분명하고 ‎이해하기 쉬운 언어로 말씀하실 때
‎그렇게 할 때 우리는 ‎여호와를 훨씬 더 잘 알게 되고,
‎성경 번역의 중요한 목표가 ‎되어야 하는 것은 무엇일까요?
‎이번 달 주제에 ‎바로 그 답이 들어 있습니다.
‎그분은 곧 겪게 될 일 때문에 ‎매우 괴로워하면서도,
‎모든 성경 번역판에 하느님의 ‎고유한 이름이 나와야 하는
‎이번 달엔 이 주제와 관련된 ‎또 다른 부면을 살펴볼 텐데요,
‎신약 성경에 그 이름을 ‎사용하는 것에는 동의하지 않습니다.
‎또 탐정이 되어 ‎몇 가지 조사를 해 봐야 합니다.
‎그 당시 신세계역 성경 번역 위원회는 ‎마태복음을 번역 중이었습니다.
‎히브리어 성경에서 인용한 부분이 ‎아주 많다는 데 유의했을 겁니다.
‎아니면 “주” 같은 대체 표현을 ‎그 이름 대신 쓰셨습니까?
‎마태 22:44을 아주 흥미롭게 ‎처리했단 걸 알게 됐을 겁니다.
‎“주”를 뜻하는 영어 단어 “LORD”를 ‎모두 대문자로 쓴 것이죠.
‎히브리어 본문에 하느님의 이름이 ‎있다는 걸 표시하기 위해 사용됩니다.
‎하느님의 이름이, 원래 그 인용문에 ‎들어 있었다는 걸 인정하는 것입니다.
‎바로 그 무렵에 ‎학자들이 틀렸다는 걸 증명해 준
‎그중 한 가지 발견에 대한 ‎증거 자료를 실어 놓았죠.
‎참조할 수 있는 가장 오래된 ‎그리스어 성경 사본들엔
‎아주 초기부터 원문의 필사자들은 ‎하느님의 이름을 그냥 대체해 버렸고
‎그리스어 성경은 신성한 히브리어 ‎성경에 추가된 영감받은 기록물이었죠.
‎따라서 히브리어 성경에 약 ‎7000번이나 사용된 하느님의 이름이
‎그리스어 본문에 테트라그람마톤이 ‎한 번도 아니고 곳곳에 있었던 거죠.
‎두 명의 여호와의 증인은 ‎이집트 카이로에 있는 그 단편들을
‎신세계역 번역 위원회의 우리 형제들이 ‎연구•조사를 하고 있을 때,
‎그 일은 하느님의 영원한 이름이 ‎드러나야 한다는 점을 확증해 줬습니다.
‎여호와를 섬기려는 모든 사람이 ‎그 이름을 알아야 했습니다.
‎예수께서 아버지께 기도하며 말씀하신 ‎이런 내용이 참됨을 보여 줍니다.
‎“저는 아버지의 이름을 알려 주었고 ‎또 알려 주겠습니다.”
‎우리 여호와의 증인들은 “그분의 ‎이름을 위한 백성”이 되어 뿌듯합니다.
‎여호와란 분을 알려면 반드시 ‎그분의 이름을 알아야 하죠.
‎여호와께서 그분의 백성을 사용해 ‎「신세계역」 성경을 마련해 주신 것을 보면
‎히브리어로 된 하느님의 이름이 ‎들어 있었다는 증거를 찾은 것입니다.
‎형제들이 그 정보를 입수할 수 ‎있었던 건 정말 다행인데,
‎왜냐면 그 단편들이 ‎대중이 볼 수 있게 출판된 건
‎1947년에 발견되기 시작한 ‎또 다른 중요한 자료를 기억하십니까?
‎두루마리 중 많은 수가 ‎예수 시대 전후의 것들입니다.
‎가장 먼저, 각 그림이 원래 ‎어디에 있었는지 알아내야겠죠.
‎일단 그 자리에 가짜 그림이 ‎걸려 있는 게 확인되면,
‎진짜 그림을 원래 있어야 할 자리에 ‎되돌려 놓을 수 있을 겁니다.
‎그림 도둑이 한 것과 ‎같은 일이 벌어진 거죠.
‎우리가 조사해 볼 수 있는 ‎그리스도인 그리스어 성경의
‎현존하는 가장 오래된 사본들도 ‎기원 2세기 말 이후의 것들인데,
‎우리가 알게 된 것처럼, 그때는 ‎이미 범죄가 저질러진 이후입니다.
‎그 이름이 그리스어 본문 어디에 ‎있었는지를 어떻게 알 수 있을까요?
‎그리스어 성경 본문에 나오는 ‎“주”라는 단어를 모두 검토해서
‎즉 여호와의 이름이 원래 있던 자리가 ‎어디인지를 찾는 데 도움이 됩니다.
‎하느님의 이름이 사용된 ‎히브리어 성경 구절을 인용한 곳에
‎그 자리에 여호와의 이름이 ‎있었다는 단서가 되는 것이죠.
‎원래 여호와께서 하신 말씀을 ‎인용한 구절의 주변 문맥에
‎“이 모든 일이 일어난 것은 ‎여호와께서 예언자를 통해 하신
‎이 예언의 소식은 이사야를 통해 ‎여호와께서 하신 말씀이죠.
‎“주”를 뜻하는 그리스어 단어 ‎‘키리오스’ 앞에 정관사가 없는 경우인데,
‎그리스어 문법상 정관사가 붙는 것이 ‎일반적인 곳에 정관사가 없는 경우죠.
‎편집자가 와서 가족들이 그의 ‎사망 소식을 아직 듣지 못했다고 하면서
‎“운전자”란 말 앞에 정관사가 ‎빠지게 되면 이상한 말이 돼 버립니다.
‎그런 예를 마가복음 13:20의 ‎그리스어 본문에서 볼 수 있습니다.
‎그래서 신세계역이 이 구절에 ‎하느님의 이름을 복원한 것입니다.
‎하느님의 이름을 “주”로 바꿨다는 ‎다른 강력한 증거들이 있을 수 있습니다.
‎“집으로 가서 친족들에게 여호와께서 ‎당신에게 해 주신 모든 일과
‎이 성구에서 왜 “주”가 예수가 아니라 ‎여호와라고 할 수 있을까요?
‎도둑맞은 그림들을 원래 자리에 ‎되돌려 놓을 수 있었던 것입니다.
‎「워치타워 온라인 라이브러리」에서도 ‎같은 내용을 보실 수 있습니다.
‎그런데 J 참고 문헌이 이 결정을 ‎하는 데 어떤 기여를 했을까요?
‎이제 그 점에 대한 설명을 듣기 위해,
‎알라디스 형제, 우리를 위해 ‎이렇게 나와 주셔서 감사합니다.
‎J 참고 문헌의 J는 ‎여호와의 영어 이름을 가리키는데,
‎그 이름의 어떤 형태가 ‎그리스어 성경 본문에 사용된
‎그럼 그 목록을 ‎지금 어디서 찾을 수 있죠?
‎90개가 넘는 성경 번역판과 ‎참고 자료가 들어 있습니다.
‎최신 목록을 영문 연구용 성경의 ‎부록 C4에서 찾을 수 있죠.
‎이제, 우리 모두 묻고 싶은 ‎중요한 질문일 텐데요,
‎테트라그람마톤이 그리스어 성경에 ‎들어 있어야 한다는 증거가 됩니까?
‎그리스도인 그리스어 성경에 ‎하느님의 이름을 복원하기로 했을 때
‎J 참고 문헌을 근거로 ‎그렇게 결정한 것이 아닙니다.
‎그 근거에 대해선 이미 잭슨 형제가 ‎앞에서 언급을 하셨죠.
‎J 참고 문헌은 그 자체가 ‎근거가 되는 게 아니라,
‎이 번역판도 J 참고 문헌에 들어 있죠.
‎주라는 단어가 나오는 경우 ‎언제 여호와를 사용해야 할지 분별했죠.
‎신세계역 성서 번역 위원회는 ‎델리치의 번역판의 그러한 모든 사례들과
‎그럼 이 J 참고 문헌의 가치에 대해 ‎어떻게 정리할 수 있을까요?
‎네, 「연구용 성경」에 새로 추가된 것들을 ‎포함해 모든 J 참고 문헌은
‎이러한 결론이 그 번역판들과 ‎참고 문헌에 반영되어 있는 것이죠.
‎제가 이해한 게 맞다면, ‎부록 C의 C3을 보면
‎그리고 돌아가시면, 번역 봉사부에서 ‎수고하는 모든 형제 자매들에게
‎왜 우리 조직은 이렇게 성경을 ‎번역하는 데 열심인 걸까요?
‎봉사에서 예수의 본을 따라 ‎하느님의 이름을 영광스럽게 하고,
‎여호와를 알게 되는 기쁨에 대해 ‎잘 표현한 노래입니다.
‎아직 그분을 찾고 있는 사람을 ‎돕는 건 정말 큰 특권입니다.
‎물론, 그 이름으로 불리는 건 ‎특권인 동시에 책임이기도 합니다.
‎하느님의 백성 즉 하느님의 ‎영적 이스라엘을 이루고 있었습니다.
‎오늘 성구 앞 구절에서, ‎베드로는 그들의 임무를 설명했습니다.
‎1세기 중앙장로회 모임에서 한 것으로 ‎보고된 말과도 일치합니다.
‎‘그 후에 내가 돌아와서 다윗의 ‎무너진 천막을 다시 일으킬 것이며
‎그것은 남은 자들이 내 이름으로 불리는 ‎모든 이방 사람들과 함께
‎유일하신 참하느님의 이름을 지니는 건 ‎정말 자랑스럽고 영광스런 일이죠.
‎그분을 잘못 알리는 거짓 가르침들을 ‎폭로할 의무 아래 있습니다.
‎먼저 많은 사람이 속아 넘어간 ‎한 거짓말의 예를 말씀드리죠.
‎아마 미술계 역사를 통틀어 가장 ‎극적인 사기극을 벌인 사람일 겁니다.
‎그는 페르메이르 작품을 흉내 낸 ‎6개의 그림을 만들어냈습니다.
‎「엠마우스의 예수와 사도들」 ‎(Christ and the Disciples at Emmaus)이란 그림이죠.
‎당시 미술사 분야의 최고 권위자는 ‎그 그림이 오리지널 캔버스에 그려진,
‎가장 오래된 그리스어 사본들에서는 ‎찾을 수 없는 표현입니다.
‎그리고 수 세기 동안 교회들은 ‎삼위일체 교리를 퍼뜨렸습니다.
‎“결국 삼위일체 교의는 ‎4세기 후반에 가서야 고안된 것이다.
‎하느님께 기도한 것은 ‎시늉에 불과했다는 뜻이 될 것이다.
‎••• 예수가 죽었음을 인정한다면, ‎또 다른 딜레마에 빠진다.
‎왜냐면 많은 사람이 믿듯, ‎세 하느님이 모두 하나라면
‎어둡고 미신적인 과거로부터 ‎우리에게 물려준 교의를 옹호하기 위해,
‎네, 여호와의 백성은 오직 ‎한 분인 참하느님에 관한 진리를
‎하느님의 이름을 거룩하게 하기 위해 ‎기울여 온 노력은
‎“그때에 여호와를 두려워하는 사람들이 ‎저마다 자기 친구와 서로 말하니,
‎‘내가 특별한 재산을 산출하는 날에 ‎그들이 나의 소유가 될 것이다.’”
‎자신을 두려워하고 자신의 이름을 ‎소중히 여기는 사람들을 사랑하시며
‎좋은 소식을 선포하는 일의 ‎장애물을 모두 없애실 수 있죠.
‎여기 사는 형제 자매들 대부분은 ‎절대 진리를 배울 수 없었을 겁니다.
‎외딴 지역 사람들에게 전도하기 위해 ‎열심 많은 형제 자매들이
‎안데스 산맥의 추운 고지대를 따라 난 ‎좁은 길을 올랐습니다.
‎케추아어를 쓰는 사람들에게 ‎그들의 언어로 좋은 소식을 전하려고
‎하지만 모국어로 전파 활동을 하는 데는 ‎몇 가지 어려움이 있었어요.
‎한 가지는 케추아어로 된 ‎좋은 성경 번역판이 없다는 것이었죠.
‎성경 본문에서 그 이름을 보는 ‎것만큼의 효과는 없었습니다.
‎또 거짓 교리의 영향 때문에 ‎진리를 가르치는 데 어려움이 있었죠.
‎그분의 이름을 알아야 하고, ‎그 이름의 의미도 이해해야 합니다.
‎이 산악 지대 곳곳에서 어떻게 ‎여호와의 큰 이름이 거룩해졌을까요?
‎하느님의 이름은 더 이상 ‎케추아 사람들에게 숨겨져 있지 않죠.
‎여호와를 알 수 있는 ‎소중한 기회를 갖게 됐습니다.
‎좋은 소식을 보내 주신 여호와께 ‎매일 매일 감사를 드립니다.
‎이 작은 섬들은 해수면에서 ‎아주 조금 올라와 있죠.
‎몇몇 곳은 폭이 워낙 좁아서 도로 옆에
‎집 한 채를 겨우 ‎지을 수 있을 정도입니다.
‎형제 자매들도 함께 모여 ‎교제하는 걸 정말 좋아하죠.

en.text: ‎Welcome, brothers and sisters, to JW Broadcasting!
‎In this edition,
‎we’ll glorify Jehovah’s name in our discussions and segments.
‎For example:
‎How was the discovery of this ancient manuscript
‎a tremendous help to the New World Bible Translation Committee?
‎How did it support their decision to restore God’s name
‎in the Christian Greek Scriptures?
‎We’ll find out.
‎We’ll visit the Quechua-speaking people in the Andes Mountains.
‎What special efforts have our brothers been making there
‎to spread the good news?
‎And what new tool do they have to glorify God’s name in Quechua?
‎How did you feel when you finally found Jehovah?
‎And how does it feel now
‎when you can help someone in his or her search
‎to know the true God?
‎You’ll enjoy a new original song
‎about the search for Jehovah.
‎You’re watching JW Broadcasting
‎for October 2018.
‎It’s hard to believe that it’s already been five years
‎since the release of the revised New World Translation in English.
‎What a wonderful blessing from Jehovah it has been!
‎Do you remember why the Governing Body saw the need for a revised edition?
‎One reason was to honor God’s name,
‎including it in six more places where new evidence made it possible.
‎Another reason to revise the English text
‎was to allow Bible translation into even more languages.
‎Thousands of questions from Bible translation teams
‎showed where the English text
‎could be made more clear and understandable
‎without sacrificing accuracy.
‎It’s our prayer that, in time,
‎more of our brothers can have
‎a revised New World Translation in their language.
‎The Governing Body feels that Jehovah is answering that prayer.
‎Revised translations are now available in 13 languages.
‎Listen to brothers and sisters from four European-language groups
‎explain how the revised Bible has benefited them
‎in their study and in their ministry.
‎The release of the revised version
‎of the New World Translation of the Holy Scriptures
‎in the English language in 2013
‎had a wonderful impact on the English-speaking world.
‎As Brother Jackson noted,
‎more than 60 years had passed since the release of the first volume
‎of the New World Translation, and during that time,
‎the English language had changed as well.
‎During 2017,
‎the revised version
‎of the New World Translation of the Holy Scriptures
‎has been released
‎in some major European languages,
‎such as Italian (originally released in 1963),
‎Dutch (also originally released in 1963),
‎Greek (originally released in 1997),
‎and Hungarian (originally released in 2000).
‎How do the brothers and sisters feel
‎about the revised New World Translation in their particular language?
‎The modern language
‎in this revised version of the Bible
‎helps me to understand Bible passages
‎because now it flows better and is much simpler.
‎This helps me to meditate more on what I have just read.
‎At Numbers 14:24,
‎Jehovah speaks to Moses.
‎In the older version, Jehovah says about Caleb
‎that “a different spirit has proved to be with him.”
‎In the revised version, the verse reads
‎that ‘my servant Caleb thinks differently’
‎—very clear and doesn’t need further explanation.
‎Psalm 7:9 now says
‎that Jehovah “examines the hearts
‎and the deepest emotions,”
‎whereas previously it said he examines the ‘hearts and the kidneys.’
‎Now it’s easier to understand.
‎Besides all the aspects of helping to get
‎a better understanding of God’s Word,
‎why are brothers and sisters happy to use this revised version
‎in field service?
‎When reading a scripture,
‎you can tell that people understand
‎it more quickly;
‎there is less need to explain more.
‎And that’s great.
‎I particularly like the glossary;
‎it’s a kind of mini Insight book.
‎It has been very useful
‎when I study and also in the ministry.
‎Furthermore, I like
‎that at the beginning of the Bible,
‎there are 20 introductions
‎that answer questions that people in the territory often ask,
‎and they have Bible verses and very nice illustrations.
‎So they are very clear and practical.
‎To achieve such an awesome result by revising the New World Translation,
‎which important aspects did the translators have to keep in mind?
‎Thanks to the modern language
‎that is used in the revision,
‎readers can understand most Bible passages as they read them,
‎without having to stop and read them over again.
‎This is possible, in part,
‎because the text is not cluttered with too many words
‎—trying to copy the Hebrew syntax and style of expression.
‎Thus, the use of modern language
‎contributes to naturalness and clarity.
‎The language used
‎in the revision also now allows
‎the emotions of the characters to come through more vividly.
‎You straightaway notice when someone
‎is angry or desperate or sad.
‎Like in Matthew 11, when Jesus invites us to take his yoke upon us,
‎his warmth is immediately obvious.
‎In the 2003 edition,
‎only one sentence was packed
‎into seven verses,
‎and its length was half a column,
‎making it very cumbersome to follow the line of thought.
‎In the revised Bible, this part was cut into more sentences,
‎so it is easier to grasp the idea.
‎Many parents have told us
‎that now when they read the Bible
‎with their children,
‎they don’t have to stop to explain words
‎and the reading is much more enjoyable.
‎The revised New World Translation will be made available
‎in more languages in the near future.
‎We know that Jehovah wants all his people to listen
‎as he speaks to them in clear, understandable language.
‎This will help us to come to know Jehovah even better,
‎and our love for him
‎will keep growing
‎while we read his Word with joy.
‎In addition to being clear and accurate,
‎what should be the primary goal of any Bible translation?
‎The answer is found
‎in the theme of our program this month:
‎“Father, Glorify Your Name.”
‎It’s based on Jesus’ words
‎recorded at John 12:28.
‎Let’s start by examining the context of those words
‎as found in verses 27 and 28:
‎“‘Now I am troubled, and what should I say?
‎“‘Father, save me out of this hour.
‎“‘Nevertheless, this is why I have come to this hour.
‎“Father, glorify your name.’
‎“Then a voice came out of heaven:
‎‘I have glorified it and will glorify it again.’”
‎Jesus uttered these words
‎just four days before his agonizing death.
‎But even though Jesus was very troubled
‎about what was soon to happen to him,
‎what was his primary concern?
‎It was for Jehovah’s name to be glorified.
‎We today are likewise concerned
‎about the glorification of Jehovah’s name and his reputation.
‎But how can someone be glorified, or made famous,
‎if nobody knows his name?
‎Knowing God’s personal name, Jehovah,
‎is closely tied in with glorifying his reputation.
‎In fact, knowing Jehovah’s name
‎is the very first step in that process.
‎The June 2015 program of JW Broadcasting
‎discussed why God’s personal name
‎should appear in all translations of the Bible.
‎You might find it helpful to review that program.
‎But this month, we will consider another aspect of this subject
‎that is far more controversial, namely,
‎Should the divine name appear in the Christian Greek Scriptures,
‎or what is commonly called the New Testament?
‎Many scholars who agree with us
‎that the divine name should appear in the Hebrew Scriptures
‎disagree with our use of the same name
‎in the New Testament.
‎So, what prompted the translators of the New World Translation

‎“for believing that their three Gods
‎“are all one person as many do,
‎“when Jesus died they must all three have died.
‎“If they all died, who raised them to life?
‎“How foolish all this sounds! . . .
‎“Shall we thus contradict the Apostles and Prophets and Jesus Himself,
‎“and ignore reason and common sense, in order to hold
‎“to a dogma handed to us from the dark, superstitious past,
‎“by a corrupt apostate Church?
‎Nay!” says The Watch Tower.
‎Well, Jehovah’s people continue to uphold the excellencies
‎ of the only true God.
‎Whether in ancient times, as with the natural Israelites
‎or in modern times, as with spiritual Israel,
‎Jehovah’s words through Isaiah are still true.
‎Look at it at Isaiah 43:21.
‎Of course, we know in Isaiah chapter 43
‎Jehovah declares: “You are my witnesses.”
‎And in verse 21 he says:
‎“The people whom I formed for myself
‎so that they might declare my praise.”
‎And the effort that Jehovah’s Witnesses​
‎—God’s people​— have put forth to expose
‎ Bible teachings that are false,
‎to teach the truth about Jehovah,
‎and to sanctify God’s name has taken on proportions
‎never attained by any other religious group.
‎And Jehovah takes notice of that.
‎Look at Malachi the 3rd chapter.
‎Malachi chapter 3,
‎beginning with verse 16.
‎Malachi 3:​16:
‎“At that time those who feared Jehovah spoke with one another,
‎“each one with his companion,
‎“and Jehovah kept paying attention and listening.
‎“And a book of remembrance was written before him
‎“for those fearing Jehovah and for those meditating on
‎“[or the footnote says, possibly, “treasuring”] his name.
‎“‘And they will be mine,’ says Jehovah of armies,
‎‘in the day when I produce a special property.’”
‎So Jehovah truly does love those
‎who fear him and treasure his name,
‎making them truly God’s people.
‎Jehovah can remove any obstacle
‎to sanctifying his name and declaring the good news
‎—even long-held false teachings.
‎And what is more amazing,
‎he uses his people —his special property—
‎to get the work done.
‎The challenges may be different where you live,
‎but the results are the same:
‎Jehovah blesses your efforts to glorify him.
‎Let’s see an example in this report from Peru,
‎where our brothers are reaching the hearts
‎of Quechua-speaking people in the Andes Mountains.
‎My name is Faustino Camacho Quispe.
‎My family and I speak Quechua or,
‎as we say, runa simi
‎—the language of the people.
‎We live in an agricultural community
‎in the mountains of Peru.
‎Our way of life depends on farming.
‎We grow crops such as corn,
‎potatoes, wheat,
‎and quinoa.
‎We also raise a small amount of livestock.
‎Many people who speak Quechua have moved to larger cities,
‎but others, like us, still enjoy
‎a more traditional way of life in the country.
‎My family and I are Jehovah’s Witnesses.
‎Most of our brothers and sisters in this area
‎would never have been able to learn the truth
‎had there not been someone sent here to preach in Quechua.
‎the Peru branch office began to expand
‎the work in the Quechua-language field.
‎In order to reach those living in isolated areas,
‎zealous brothers and sisters climbed narrow roads
‎in the frigid elevations of the Andes Mountains.
‎Great efforts were made in order
‎to bring Quechua-speaking people
‎the good news in their own language.
‎The people loved having publications in their mother tongue.
‎However, there were some challenges
‎in carrying out this work.
‎One problem was not having a good translation
‎of the Holy Scriptures in Quechua.
‎The commonly used translations here in Peru
‎omit God’s name in the main text.
‎It can be found in the glossary of some Bibles,
‎and sometimes we used that in order to preach.
‎But even so, it didn’t have the same impact
‎as seeing it in its proper place.
‎That, along with the influence of false doctrines,
‎made it difficult for us to teach the truth.
‎When we teach people about the Bible,
‎we want them to draw close to God;
‎we want them to become his friends.
‎But no one can be God’s friend
‎if they don’t know his name.
‎For people to be able to come to love God,
‎they have to know his name,
‎and they have to understand what it means.
‎It was difficult for us to use the Bible at the meetings,
‎in the field ministry, and in our family worship.
‎How could Jehovah’s great name be sanctified
‎throughout this mountainous region?
‎How could the Quechua people get to know God
‎when his name was hidden?
‎The answer to our prayers came
‎when Quechua congregations throughout the country
‎were invited to a special program
‎Imagine the great joy we felt when Brother Jackson
‎of the Governing Body announced the release
‎of the New World Translation of the Christian Greek Scriptures
‎in two Quechua languages!
‎Language number 136:
‎It’s the Christian Greek Scriptures
‎in Quechua Ayacucho!
‎But we also have number 137:
‎It’s Quechua Cuzco!
‎What a wonderful gift we’ve received today!
‎This new Quechua Bible
‎is a grand victory for Jehovah’s great name.
‎God’s name is no longer hidden from the Quechua people,
‎giving them the precious opportunity
‎to come to know our loving Creator, Jehovah.
‎I feel proud to use our new Bible to teach
‎my family and neighbors Jehovah’s name.
‎I am thankful every day
‎that Jehovah sent this good news to the mountains
‎to us who speak runa simi
‎—the language of the people.
‎It was a privilege to be at such a happy event
‎and to see our brothers’ joy
‎when they received the Christian Greek Scriptures
‎in two Quechua languages.
‎May they use their Bibles to draw close to Jehovah
‎and glorify his name in the Andes Mountains.
‎Our program now goes
‎to the South Pacific,
‎where we conclude with greetings from Tuvalu.
‎Most of Tuvalu’s nine islands are ring-shaped coral atolls
‎surrounding peaceful lagoons.
‎These small islands barely rise out of the sea.
‎On Funafuti, Tuvalu’s capital,
‎the island is just wide enough in some places
‎for the main road and a single house.
‎The motorbike is the preferred way to travel on the island.
‎So it’s good that our witnessing carts come equipped with sturdy wheels.
‎Tuvalu has a busy remote translation office.
‎the New World Translation of the Christian Greek Scriptures in Tuvaluan
‎was released.
‎In October of last year, the complete Bible was released,
‎making Tuvaluan the smallest language group
‎to receive the New World Translation.
‎I was assigned to Tuvalu in 1979
‎and enjoyed the challenging task
‎of helping to establish Tuvaluan translation.
‎There were only 3 other baptized publishers back then,
‎but in 2017,
‎Tuvalu reported a peak of 125 publishers.
‎They preach to a population
‎of around 10,000 people.
‎Tuvaluans are warm and friendly,
‎and our brothers and sisters thoroughly enjoy
‎the time they can spend together.
‎They send their love and greetings from the South Pacific.
‎Alofa atu in Tuvaluan means
‎“We send our love to you all.”
‎We send them our love and pray for Jehovah’s continued blessing.
‎This is JW Broadcasting
‎from the world headquarters of Jehovah’s Witnesses.

ko.text: ‎디모데에게 “젊음의 욕망을 피하”라고 한 말이 떠오를지 모릅니다.
‎오늘의 성구는 한 아버지가 아들에게 조언을 하면서,
‎아들에게 직접 이 경험을 이야기한다고 생각하며 읽어 보죠.
‎내 아들 너같이 경험 없는 사람들을 봤는데],
‎이게 이 청년이 문제를 겪는 첫 번째 요인이죠.
‎그는 젊고, 또 젊기 때문에 경험이 없습니다.
‎아버지는 이 청년이 어떻게 하다가 비극적인 결말을 맞게 되는지
‎심지어 위태로운 상황에서도 자신감을 가질 때가 많지 않습니까?
‎“저녁에 해 질 무렵, 어두운 밤이 가까워질 때였다.”
‎상황을 다 조절할 수 있다고 느끼고 있는 데다가,
‎제 고향에도 어두워지면 가지 않는 특정한 장소,
‎거기선 안 좋은 일이 생길 게 뻔했거든요.
‎그 결과가 나옵니다. 이어진 이 모든 행동의 결말이죠.
‎차꼬를 차고 벌을 받게 되는 어리석은 사람 같구나.”
‎성적 부도덕 때문에 질병에 걸릴 수도 있습니다.
‎“그 여자가 쓰러뜨려 죽게 한 자가 많고
‎오로지 경험 없는 사람들만 이런 잘못된 길에 들어서게 됩니까?
‎여기 두 부부가 함께 식사를 하고 있는데요,
‎그런데 화면 앞쪽에 앉은 두 사람은 뭘 하고 있는 걸까요?
‎그리고 이 네 명 모두 손에 결혼 반지를 끼고 있습니다.
‎두 사람은 나중에 저녁 집회 후 왕국회관 주차장에서
‎위험한 내리막길에 들어섰다는 걸 깨닫고 필요한 조정을 했습니다.
‎하지만 애초에 그런 길에 발을 들여놓지 않았더라면
‎나이나 환경이 어떠하든 우리 모두에게 경고가 됩니다.
‎여기 베델에 있으면 이성을 대할 일이 많은데요,
‎우리의 행실은 반드시 순결하고 여호와께서 기뻐하실 만해야죠.
‎인터넷을 사용할 때나 오락물을 고를 때도 마찬가지죠.
‎그 자매가 한 말이 아직도 기억에 남네요.
‎슬프고 비참한 결과를 가져올 게 뻔한 일을
‎‘젊은이가 어떻게 자기의 행로를 깨끗이 지킬 수 있습니까?
‎여호와의 말씀에 따라 계속 주의함으로 그렇게 할 수 있습니다.’
‎여호와께서는 깨끗이 지키는 데 필요한 모든 걸 주셨습니다.
‎분명히, 우리는 성적 부도덕을 멀리할 수 있습니다.

en.text: ‎Well, the words of today’s text
‎may have reminded you of the admonition
‎at 1 Corinthians 6:18,
‎where Paul wrote:
‎“Flee from sexual immorality!”
‎or perhaps the words at 2 Timothy 2:22,
‎where he wrote to Timothy:
‎“Flee from youthful desires.”
‎In today’s text,
‎a father is counseling his son
‎and encouraging him to stay away
‎from sexual immorality.
‎In Proverbs chapter 7, the counsel is strengthened
‎by means of an experience.
‎The king describes a scene
‎that he personally witnessed,
‎and we read about it in Proverbs chapter 7,
‎beginning in verse 6.
‎So why don’t we turn there together?
‎At Proverbs 7:6,
‎you can imagine a father
‎encouraging a son
‎and he relates this experience:
‎“From the window of my house,
‎“through my lattice, I looked down,
‎“and as I observed the naive ones
‎“[or as the footnote says, the “inexperienced” ones
‎“—like you, son, the inexperienced ones],
‎“I discerned among the youths a young man
‎“lacking good sense
‎[or, “in want of heart,” ftn.].”
‎Now, that’s the first strike
‎against the young man, isn’t it?
‎He’s young and, as a result,
‎he’s inexperienced —the two go together.
‎But the father proceeds to describe
‎what he observed and the progression of events
‎that led to a tragic outcome for the young man.
‎So it says in verse 8
‎that the young man “passed along the street near her corner.”
‎Now, the “her”
‎is a prostitute.
‎What is he doing in the neighborhood?
‎Well, we’re told that “he marched
‎in the direction of her house.”
‎The word “march”
‎implies a sense of confidence, doesn’t it?
‎Isn’t it interesting
‎that a young person is often confident
‎even in risky situations?
‎Why?
‎Because a young person lacks experience
‎and can’t always foresee
‎the implications of a situation
‎or the outcome.
‎Another factor is highlighted in verse 9:
‎“In the twilight, in the evening,
‎at the approach of night and darkness.”
‎So now we have inexperience;
‎we have a bad neighborhood;
‎we have a young man who is confident,
‎who evidently has no intention of committing immorality
‎and may even feel that he’s in control of the circumstances;
‎and it’s nighttime.
‎Now, I know as a young man where I grew up,
‎everybody knew there were certain places,
‎or parts of town, where you didn’t go after dark
‎because it was a recipe for disaster.
‎In verse 10, the inevitable happens.
‎The young man is confronted by a prostitute,
‎and rather than turning around
‎and leaving the situation,
‎he engages with her in conversation.
‎And in verse 22,
‎we read the result
‎—the culmination— of this progression
‎of ingredients:
‎“Suddenly he goes after her,
‎“like a bull to the slaughter,
‎like a fool to be punished in the stocks.”
‎Now, what do we learn
‎from this word “suddenly”?
‎Well, simply this:
‎In any situation, we can cross a line
‎where we no longer control the circumstances;
‎rather, the circumstances control us.
‎And isn’t that what happened to the young man?
‎He put himself in a situation
‎—going down a path
‎that eventuated, or culminated,
‎in his committing sexual immorality.
‎And the seriousness of the matter
‎is highlighted in the “b” portion of verse 23,
‎where it says: “It will cost him his life.”
‎So there’s a ripple effect.
‎Certainly, his relationship with Jehovah was damaged.
‎His relationship with his family would be affected.
‎And there are even physical factors
‎—illnesses that can result
‎from sexual immorality.
‎Now, note in verse 26,
‎the father says: “She has caused many to fall down slain,
‎and those she has killed are numerous.”
‎And as our Watchtower recently made the point,
‎thousands are disfellowshipped every year
‎from Jehovah’s family
‎because of sexual immorality.
‎Now, a question that Brother Kittle addressed,
‎Is it only the inexperienced
‎that fall victim to this sad progression?
‎Well, let’s look at an illustration that appeared
‎in the Watchtower article.
‎You’ll probably remember this illustration.
‎And here we see two married couples
‎having supper together,
‎a seemingly innocent situation.
‎But what are the two folks sitting closest
‎to the camera doing?
‎They’re flirting, aren’t they?
‎You see the sister twirling her hair with her finger,
‎and the brother is saying,
‎in essence, ‘I only have eyes for you.’
‎And you can see wedding rings on all four
‎of those individuals’ hands.
‎It’s a start down a slippery slope, isn’t it?
‎And as portrayed in The Watchtower,
‎this couple would later accidentally “on purpose” bump
‎into each other in the parking lot of the Kingdom Hall
‎after an evening meeting,
‎engage in conversation,
‎and that progressed to texting.
‎Now, the good news is, as depicted in The Watchtower,
‎these folks realized
‎that they were headed down a dangerous path
‎and took steps to correct it.
‎But wouldn’t it have been better
‎if they hadn’t gone down the road to begin with?
‎It’s a good reminder for all of us,
‎whatever our age or circumstance.
‎Here at Bethel, we interact with ones of the opposite sex
‎and many of us are married,
‎but many are not.
‎But as we were reminded,
‎we want to make sure our conduct is chaste
‎and pleasing to Jehovah.
‎The same holds true at the Kingdom Hall
‎and in our use of the Internet
‎and in our choice of entertainment.
‎We don’t want to start down a path
‎that could take us away from Jehovah.
‎I’ll never forget a pioneer sister
‎who used to counsel us young people
‎in the congregation, and we loved her.
‎But she had an expression that she would tell us,
‎“If you’re not going to burn down the barn,
‎don’t strike the match.”
‎Now, what’s the point of her statement?
‎Why start a progression of events
‎that we know will lead to sadness and tragedy?
‎So we don’t even go there.
‎And even if we’re inexperienced, we can act wisely.
‎What did the psalmist say?
‎He said: ‘How can a young man keep his path clean?
‎‘By keeping on guard
‎according to Jehovah’s word.’
‎So Jehovah has given us everything we need
‎to remain clean.
‎So talk to Jehovah about it.
‎Be alert to identify and be determined
‎to avoid dangerous situations,
‎and then we don’t have to experience
‎the sad outcome of the young man described
‎in Proverbs chapter 7.
‎Instead, we can succeed
‎in fleeing from sexual immorality.

cn.text: 今天的经文箴言5:8
也许让你想到了哥林多前书6:18的劝勉
保罗说
“你们要远避淫乱！”
可能你还会想起保罗写给提摩太的话
记在提摩太后书2:22
“你要远避年轻人的欲望”
箴言5:8是一位父亲给儿子的劝告
他劝儿子要避开淫乱
这位父亲也就是所罗门王
在箴言第7章里
用了一个例子来帮助儿子谨记这个劝告
他描述了一个他曾亲眼目睹的场景
我们来读一下箴言第7章
请打开圣经
到箴言7:6
我们从第6节开始读
请想象一下
一位父亲，他正在教导儿子
他告诉儿子这个场景
“在我家窗前
我从窗格子往下看
我观察那些缺乏经验的人”
没错，“缺乏经验的人”
好像父亲在对儿子说
你也是一个缺乏经验的人
父亲观察到什么呢？
他“看出在年轻人中
有一个心中不智”
这段经文提到一个年轻人犯下了大错
原因是，他很年轻
所以他也缺乏经验
年轻人往往缺乏经验
这位父亲继续描述了这个年轻人
是怎样一步一步走向可悲的结局的
第8节说
“他在街上走近淫妇家的路口”
这里的“淫妇”指的就是妓女
这个年轻人接下来做了什么呢？
经文说
这个人“往她家的方向直奔”
从“直奔”这个词
我们可以看出这个年轻人很自信，对吗？
一般来说，年轻人往往比较自信
即使处于危险的状况也觉得没什么问题
为什么呢？
因为这个年轻人缺乏经验
看不出潜在的危险是什么
以及这些危险会引发什么后果
第9节谈到了他犯错的另一个因素
“当时暮色朦胧
天已向晚
幽暗黑夜将临”
所以你看这个年轻人缺乏经验
又去了不好的地方
再加上，他非常地自信
很显然，他没打算做不道德的事情
他可能觉得不管处于什么环境
自己都不会受到影响
当时又是在晚上
记得我年轻的时候
在我长大的那个镇上
所有人都知道
有些地方天黑以后是不应该去的
为什么呢？
因为很可能会惹上麻烦
第10节描述
不可避免的事还是发生了
一个妓女上前迎接这个年轻人
年轻人非但没有转身离开
反而开始和她交谈
在22节，我们可以看到
他做的一系列不明智的决定
带来了什么糟糕的结果
“突然，他跟着淫妇走了
好像公牛被牵去屠宰
仿佛愚蠢的人戴着枷锁受罚”
从“突然”这个词
我们能看出什么呢？
简单来说，在任何情况下
我们都有可能失去辨别是非的能力
做出错误的决定
向引诱屈膝
这个年轻人的情况就是这样
他任由自己处于不好的环境
一步步走向犯罪的深渊
最终犯下了淫乱的大罪
从23节的后半部分
我们可以看出这件事的严重性
经文说他“赔上性命”
这是个连锁反应
这个年轻人的行为
肯定破坏了他跟耶和华的关系
他和家人的关系也会大受影响
他甚至可能会因为淫乱而患上某些疾病
给自己带来健康的难题
请留意26节，这位父亲说
“她让很多人倒地身亡
被她杀害的人不计其数”
我们研读过的一篇《守望台》文章指出
在耶和华的大家庭中
每年有数千人由于淫乱
而从会众当中被除去
那么，问题来了
只有缺乏经验的人
才会一步步落入淫乱的陷阱吗？
让我们来看看《守望台》文章里的一幅插图
你可能对这幅插图还有印象
我们看到两对夫妻在一起吃晚饭
这看起来很正常
但是，请留意最前头的这两个人
他们在做什么呢？
他们在调情，对吗？
你看，这位姐妹正在玩弄头发
而这位弟兄仿佛在暗示说
“我的眼里只有你”
虽然插图里的四个人都戴了结婚戒指
但他们仿佛在滑坡上行走
情况变得非常危险
《守望台》的插图描述
他们会在聚会结束后
假装在聚会所的停车场“偶遇”
停下来交谈
后来开始互发短信
幸好，后面的插图显示
他们看出自己的处境很危险
就采取措施纠正了自己的行为
不过，要是从最初就避免问题的出现
岂不是更好吗？
不论我们什么年龄
处于什么情况
这对我们所有人都是个很好的提醒
在伯特利
我们难免要跟异性工作和相处
我们当中有已婚的
也有独身的
我们希望保持行为贞洁
令耶和华喜悦
组织也这样提醒我们
在参加聚会、浏览网页、选择娱乐时
我们也要谨记这一点
我们不想踏上歧途
结果跟耶和华上帝疏远
我年轻的时候
会众里有一位先驱姐妹
她常常给我们年轻人一些劝告
我们都很爱她
她说过一句话让我非常难忘
如果你不想把谷仓烧掉
就不要随便划火柴
这句话的要点是什么呢？
不要做任何会导致不良后果的事情
如果知道会以悲剧收场
压根儿就不要开始
就算我们经验不足仍然可以明智行事
诗篇执笔者说
“年轻人怎样才能有纯洁的行为呢？
就是要按照[耶和华]的话语不断警惕自己”
是的，耶和华提供给我们所需的一切
帮助我们保持洁净
所以，要为此向耶和华祷告
要保持警觉
看出什么情况是危险的
然后马上避开
这样
我们就不会像箴言第7章里的年轻人那样
落得可悲的下场
我们就能够成功地远避淫乱!

titles.cn: 塞斯·海厄特：不要心中不智！（箴5:8）

en.text: Precious to God, we are daughters and sons,
Giving our strength as his faithful young ones.
Loving attention to us he will give,
Blessing our days for as long as we live.
Honoring parents who care for our lives
Helps us express what we’re feeling inside.
Then we find favor with God and with men,
Drawing us close to Jehovah, our Friend.
May we remember our God in our youth,
Growing each day in our love of the truth.
Giving our best to our God, we will bring
Joy to the heart of Jehovah, our King.

title: 소반투 손티: 이제는 사람들을 다르게 봅니다

ko.text: ‎지금은 사람들을 정말 좋아하는데, 항상 이랬던 건 아닙니다.
‎전에는 어머니가 그 지역에서 불법으로 술을 파셨는데
‎거기서 한 소년이 성경을 아주 잘 읽는 걸 보고 감동을 받았습니다.
‎그래서 집회가 끝난 뒤에 한 형제에게 말했더니,
‎연구는 계속 했지만 변화하는 게 정말 힘들었습니다.
‎전 여전히 나쁜 일을 많이 하고 있었고,
‎먼저 제 생활을 깨끗이 해야 한단 걸 알고 있었거든요.
‎“푸른 풀은 마르고 꽃은 시드나, 우리 하느님의 말씀은 영원할 것이다.”
‎제가 영적으로 발전하는 데 도움이 된 건
‎그 당시 여호와의 증인들은 집회에서 이 책을 공부했죠.
‎그래서 전 이 책을 쓴 사람이 누구든,
‎여호와의 도움을 받아 설명을 이렇게 잘 했을 거란 확신이 들었어요.
‎6개월 뒤에는 전 시간 성경을 가르치는 사람으로 임명받았죠.
‎더 나은 삶을 누려야 할 분들로 보죠.
‎더 나은 생활을 하도록 변화시킬 수 있습니다.
‎이젠 사람들을 제 영적 친구, 제 형제가 될 수 있는 분들로 봅니다.

en.text: ‎My name is Sobantu Sonti.
‎I grew up in Guguletu, Cape Town,
‎where I serve as a congregation elder.
‎I love the people I associate with now,
‎but I wasn’t always like this.
‎I had no love for people.
‎I viewed them only as a way to get rich,
‎by stealing their possessions.
‎I was a violent person, always on the edge of anger.
‎I used drugs, and I belonged to a gang.
‎We were violent thugs.
‎We lived a very destructive life.
‎my mother started associating with Jehovah’s Witnesses.
‎I noticed her making changes in her life.
‎Previously, she sold alcohol in the community illegally,
‎but then she stopped.
‎So one Thursday, I followed her to see where she was going.
‎I was touched to see a boy there who read the Bible really well.
‎I wanted to be able to do that too.
‎So after the meeting, I approached a brother,
‎and he said that I first needed to study the Bible.
‎And that’s how we started the Bible study.
‎I continued studying, but I struggled to make changes.
‎I was still involved in a lot of bad things,
‎and this caused me to stop the study
‎because I knew I had to clean up my life first.
‎During the years that I did not study,
‎I never stopped thinking about the Bible.
‎Isaiah 40:8 has very touching words that say:
‎“The green grass dries up, the blossom withers,
‎but the word of our God endures forever.”
‎That scripture resonated with me.
‎It helped me to trust in the Bible and made me want to read it.
‎The book that helped me to make spiritual progress
‎was the Revelation Climax book,
‎which Jehovah’s Witnesses were studying back then.
‎It thoroughly explained
‎the Bible book of Revelation, and that convinced me
‎that whoever wrote this book could not have done it on their own,
‎but they must have been influenced by God in order to explain it so well.
‎That book helped me to change my life
‎and to be sure that this was the truth.
‎Four years had passed since I stopped studying.
‎But in January 1995, I made a decision.
‎One Sunday, I woke up,
‎I got ready, and I went to the meeting.
‎I made rapid progress
‎and was baptized in September, 1995.
‎And six months later,
‎I was appointed as a full-time teacher of the Bible.
‎Now I view people differently.
‎I see them as people who deserve a better life.
‎Even if a person appears unable to change,
‎the Bible can teach a person dignity and change his life for the better.
‎Now I view people as those who could be
‎my spiritual friends —my brothers.

cn.text: ‎我叫索邦图·桑蒂
‎在开普敦的古古莱图长大
‎现在以长老的身份在会众服务
‎我现在很爱身边的人
‎不过以前并不是这样
‎以前我对别人没有感情
‎只想偷他们的东西
‎把他们看作发财的好机会
‎过去  我很暴力  动不动就发火
‎我也吸毒  还属于一个帮派
‎我们真的是一帮暴力的人
‎我们过着为非作歹的生活
‎我妈妈从1989年开始
‎和耶和华见证人学习圣经
‎我留意到她在生活中的改变
‎她以前在社区非法卖酒
‎但现在却不卖了
‎有一天  我跟在她后面
‎想看看她要去哪里
‎我看到一个男孩在读圣经
‎读得非常好
‎我很受触动
‎我也想像他一样
‎聚会后  我去问一个弟兄
‎他说我得先学圣经
‎我就这样开始学习圣经了
‎我学习了一段时间
‎知道要继续学习的话
‎必须要改过自新
‎不再做坏事
‎但改变原来的生活真的很难
‎结果我就停止学习了
‎停止学习圣经的那几年
‎我还是常常想起圣经里的话
‎以赛亚书40:8的经文深深打动了我
‎“草必枯萎  花必凋谢”
‎“我们上帝的话却万世长存”
‎我一直记得这句话
‎这句话让我对圣经有了信心
‎想要继续阅读
‎当时耶和华见证人在聚会里讨论
‎《启示录高潮》
‎这本书帮助我在属灵方面进步了
‎它详尽地解释了圣经的启示录
‎我看出  写这本书的人
‎肯定得到了上帝的帮助
‎才能把它解释得这么好
‎这本书让我确信我学到的就是真理
‎并帮助我在生活上做出了改变
‎那时  我有4年没有学习圣经
‎不过  在1995年1月
‎我终于做出了决定
‎一个星期天
‎我起来穿戴整齐
‎就去参加聚会了
‎我进步得很快
‎在同年9月就受浸了
‎6个月后  我受委任开始全时教人圣经
‎现在我对人的看法完全改变了
‎我希望他们过更好的生活
‎即使一个人看起来不会改变
‎圣经的教导也能使他更有自尊
‎并改善他的生活
‎现在我把别人看作未来的弟兄姐妹

title: 구젤 가이난시나: 세상은 세상에 없는 걸 우리에게 줄 수 없습니다

ko.text: ‎전 별이 빛나는 밤하늘과 아름다운 전나무가 있는
‎어머닌 늘 창조물의 아름다움에 대해 일깨워 주셨어요.
‎“얘야, 인생을 올바로 사는 게 정말 중요하단다.”
‎왜 이렇게 고통스럽고 불공정하고 슬픈 일이 많지?’
‎18살 때 가라테의 일종인 극진 공수도를 배웠어요.
‎저는 세계 선수권 대회에 나가 상위권에 들어서
‎운동 선수들은 멋진 말이나 구호를 많이 쓰지만,
‎한번은 성경을 가르쳐 주던 자매가 절 쳐다봤는데,
‎여기저기 멍이 들고 손가락 관절이 다친 걸 보고는
‎전 그 대회에 나가려고 5년 동안이나 훈련을 해 왔었죠.
‎그 승리의 영광은 정말 찬란해 보일 수 있어요.
‎세상은 세상에 없는 걸 우리에게 줄 수 없습니다.
‎절 사랑하지 않는 사람들 사이에서 영예를 얻어 봤자
‎자신을 영예롭게 하는 데 인생을 바치는 사람은
‎2005년 여름에 쿠르간 지역 대회에서 침례를 받았어요.
‎그 모든 것 뒤에 사랑 많은 창조주이신

en.text: ‎I lived in the north, with the glorious dark, starlit sky
‎and the beauty of fir trees.
‎I thought it was the most wonderful place in the world.
‎My mom was always drawing my attention to the beauty of creation.
‎And she always told me,
‎“My daughter, it’s so important to live your life in the right way.”
‎And the questions that stayed with me were:
‎‘So why are we alive?
‎Why is there so much suffering, injustice, pain?’
‎When I was 18, I took up a form of karate
‎known as Kyokushinkai.
‎Just imagine a large number of people in kimonos, standing in rows
‎bravely and without a shadow of fear,
‎working on improving their blows and striving to progress.
‎I thought: ‘This is it! This is what I’ve been looking for!’
‎I set the goal of reaching the next world championships,
‎winning a high place,
‎and immortalizing myself so that my name would remain
‎and generations would remember me.
‎Among those sportsmen, although I saw a lot of nice words and slogans,
‎not everything was as pure as I’d hoped for.
‎And then on one occasion, I was sitting down
‎and feelings of emptiness
‎just wouldn’t leave me alone.
‎And for the first time in my life,
‎I talked to God.
‎And then I prayed:
‎“I don’t understand you.
‎“Why is there so much beauty in the world
‎“and yet so much suffering?
‎“Is that really what you want
‎—for us to live like this?”
‎I prayed, I guess, for about four hours.
‎You know, the strongest feeling of emptiness and loneliness
‎is that of a creation
‎without its Creator.
‎And I was so lonely at that time.
‎And a while afterwards, there was a knock at my door.
‎It was Jehovah’s Witnesses.
‎I started studying the Bible.
‎It was so wonderful!
‎On one occasion, the sister who studied with me
‎looked up at me, and when she looked at those bruises
‎and those beaten-up knuckles,
‎she took a deep breath and shook her head.
‎I said, “Is there something wrong?”
‎She said, “You know, I’m in great pain.”
‎I said, “Why are you in pain?”
‎She said: “Well,
‎“I’m looking at your hands, your elbows,
‎“your battered legs, all of that.
‎Doesn’t it hurt?”
‎I said, “Well, yes.”
‎And she said, “You know, it hurts me to see you in pain.”
‎And I started to understand that Jehovah is the true God
‎and that this really was the truth.
‎It was difficult.
‎The pressure from relatives and friends was very strong.
‎But the most difficult thing
‎that I had to battle with was my strong attachment to karate.
‎Just a year remained until the world championships.
‎I had prepared for them.
‎I had been working toward that goal for five years.
‎Glory can seem really sweet
‎when you are the victor, when your opponents fall to the ground.
‎So I flew to the world championships.
‎When I made it to the last four winners
‎and I had to fight for third place,
‎I wanted to ask my trainer to let me stop. Why?
‎Because I couldn’t feel a single place on my body
‎—everything was beaten up.
‎But he said:
‎“You know, we love you so much. Go for it!”
‎And at that moment, it felt as though I was weighing love
‎—the world’s love
‎and the love of Jehovah’s organization.
‎It seemed to me that the world was saying:
‎“We love you. Now just go and die!”
‎But the love in the organization says,
‎“It hurts me to see you in pain.”
‎I realized that the world can’t give you what it doesn’t have.
‎It doesn’t know how to love.
‎But, nevertheless, I went to the fight
‎and became the bronze medalist.
‎And when I stood on the podium of glory,
‎I understood that glory among people who don’t love you
‎weighs no more than emptiness.
‎If a person dedicates his life
‎to glorifying himself, he will always meet
‎with disappointment and emptiness.
‎So I made the firm decision to escape from karate.
‎I started preaching, and I was baptized in 2005
‎at the summer convention in Kurgan.
‎Later, I started full-time service.
‎I learned the Tatar language so that I could serve in that territory.
‎Now, when in the evenings
‎I look up at the starry sky, I feel not hopelessness,
‎but tremendous joy
‎because I know who is behind it all:
‎our loving Creator, Jehovah God.

cn.text: ‎我在西伯利亚长大
‎那里的夜空繁星闪烁
‎非常漂亮
‎冷杉树也很漂亮
‎我一直觉得
‎那里是地球上最美丽的地方
‎妈妈总是让我观察大自然有多美丽
‎她常常说
‎古泽尔  你一定要做个好人
‎但有一些问题我一直想不通
‎比如  人为什么活着?
‎人生为什么充满苦难和不公?
‎十八岁的时候我开始学习空手道
‎也就是极真空手道
‎想象一下  很多人穿着空手道服
‎整齐地站成几排
‎看起来无所畏惧
‎他们拼命地操练自己
‎我当时想
‎这就是我一直要找的
‎于是  我下定决心
‎要参加下一届的世界锦标赛
‎要拿到奖牌
‎要让人永永远远记住我的名字
‎空手道提倡自尊  自律
‎尊重别人等理念
‎但我发现真实情况并不是这样
‎有一次  我独自坐在长椅上
‎突然感觉特别的空虚
‎这种感觉怎么都挥之不去
‎平生第一次  我开始向上帝祷告
‎我对他说
‎上帝啊  我真的不明白
‎为什么地球上那么多美丽漂亮的东西
‎但同时又充满那么多苦难和难题呢?
‎这真的是你想要我们过的生活吗?
‎我祷告了很久
‎大概4个小时
‎一个人如果不认识造物主
‎他就会有一种强烈的空虚感和寂寞感
‎那时  我真的很孤独!
‎祷告一周后
‎就有人来我家敲门
‎就是耶和华见证人
‎接着  我就开始学习圣经了
‎我真的很喜欢!
‎有一次
‎跟我学习圣经的姐妹看到我手受伤了
‎身上也有很多瘀青
‎就长叹了一口气  然后摇了摇头
‎我问  怎么了?
‎她说  我真的很心疼你
‎我问她  心疼我?
‎她说  你的手  你的胳膊
‎你的腿  到处都是伤
‎你不疼吗?
‎我说  嗯  疼啊!
‎她接着说  其实  我看到你疼
‎我也感觉很疼!
‎渐渐地  我开始相信
‎耶和华是真神
‎我所学到的就是真理
‎那时真的很不容易
‎家人朋友给了我很大压力
‎对我来说
‎真的很难放弃我一直痴迷的空手道
‎还有一年就要举行世界锦标赛了
‎当时我已经做好了准备
‎为了那一天
‎我已经苦苦训练了五年了
‎听到自己获胜  看到对手被击倒在地
‎那种胜利的感觉真好
‎后来  我就去参加世界锦标赛了
‎我打进了前四  接着就要角逐前三了
‎这时  我告诉教练
‎我不想再继续了
‎因为当时我浑身上下都是伤
‎已经没有知觉了
‎教练却说
‎我们都很爱你!  千万不要放弃!
‎就在那时候  我开始思考
‎到底是世界爱我
‎还是耶和华的组织爱我?
‎这个世界好像不断地对我说
‎我们很爱你  不要怕死  往前冲吧!
‎可是  上帝组织却仁爱地对我说
‎看到你很疼  我也感觉很疼!
‎我看出  这个世界没有爱
‎也不知道怎么去爱
‎又怎么能给我爱呢?
‎不过  我还是坚持到了最后
‎拿到了铜牌
‎站在领奖台上的那一刻
‎我终于明白了
‎要想从不爱你的人那里得到荣誉
‎到头来只会感到空虚
‎如果一个人拼尽一生  追求荣誉
‎那他得到的一定是失望和空虚
‎于是  我下定决心
‎彻底放弃空手道
‎我开始传道
‎在库尔干举行的区域大会上我受了浸
‎后来  我就开始全时服务
‎我很想在塔塔尔语地区服务
‎就开始学习那个语言
‎现在  每当我仰望星空
‎就会感到无比地快乐
‎不再感到绝望了
‎因为我知道
‎宇宙万物是谁创造的
‎就是我们的上帝耶和华

ko.text: 지금은 눈이 나빠 읽거나 하질 못해요.
전 어렸을 때 컨트리 밴드에서 연주를 했습니다.
테너 밴조, 테너 기타, 만돌린같은 악기를 연주했죠.
배운 대로 살고 싶어서 결국 밴드를 떠났습니다.
한번은 저와 한 형제가 축음기를 들고 문 앞에서
한 아주머니에게 연설을 틀어 드리고 있었는데
한 남자가 국기 경례를 하느냐고 물었고,
제가 설명해 주겠다고 하니까 그는 이렇게 말했습니다.
“설명은 됐고, 하는지 안하는지만 말해. 해, 안 해?”
안한다고 했더니 그는 저를 공중으로 내던졌습니다.
그리고 3명이 바닥에 누운 제 위로 올라탔어요.
한 명이 “경례를 안 하면 가만 안 두겠어!
전 여호와께 부활 때 절 기억해 달라고 기도했어요.
그때 양옆 길가에 있는 집들에서 여자들 여러 명이 나오더니,
당신들을 괴롭히지도 않았는데, 가게 해요”라고 했고,
전 브루클린 베델에 초대를 받았고 베델 가족 성원이 됐습니다.
노어 형제가 “타자기를 쓸 줄 아나요?”라고 물었고
전 “예”라고 했고 식자기 업무를 맡게 됐죠.
우리 부부는 길르앗 제21기 학급에 참석했고
그곳에서 전 지부 감독자로 일하도록 임명됐습니다.
63년 어느 날 밤 10시쯤에 경찰차가 지부에 나타났습니다.
그들은 제 서류를 가져오라고 했고 우린 경찰서로 갔습니다.
아니나 다를까 조금 후에 한 관리가 오더니 말했어요.
한 사람이 경찰관 옆에 서 있다 묻더군요.
그들은 절 가리키면서 “저기 불량배 같은 사람 보이죠?
브루클린 베델에 연락을 취해 노어 형제께 말했더니,
마침 스페인어로 된 새로운 책을 식자기로 작업해야 합니다.”
그렇게 다시 식자기 업무를 맡게 됐죠.
“1964년에 지부 경험이 있는 모든 지부 성원을 위해
성경을 많이 배우고 연설을 즐겼을 뿐 아니라,
무엇보다도 여호와에 대한 우리의 사랑이 계속 자라 가야 합니다.
그분은 우리의 생각과 정신과 마음을 아시고,
그것이 최상의 결정이라는 걸 알게 되었습니다.
또 조직과 성경에서 알려 주는 대로 순종하는 게
여호와의 뜻을 행하는 것이라는 걸 배웠죠.
어쩌면 더 많은 일을 할 수도 있었겠지만
지금까지 맡은 일에서 최선을 다할 수 있어서 기쁩니다.
살면서 전 여호와의 손길을 거듭거듭 보았습니다.

en.text: My name is Cecil Joseph Goff.
I began to lose eyesight in the ’70’s.
I can’t see to read or anything.
I see only peripheral vision.
I was playing in a country band at a very young age.
Well, I played the tenor banjo, tenor guitar, and I played the mandolin.
It was my life.
And yet, when I began reading and studying,
really, I wanted to stick with that,
and I left the band.
I started pioneering,
and then they assigned me to Texarkana, Texas.
Another brother and I were stopped
as we were holding the phonograph up,
and I was playing it for a lady at the door.
Why, here about 15 or 20 men surrounded me.
I asked him, “How did you enjoy it?”
And he said: “That’s not the question.
My question is, Do you salute the flag?”
And I said, “Let me explain it.”
He said: “I don’t want an explanation.
I just want to know yes or no; do you or do you not?”
I said, “I do not.”
He threw me up in the air.
I fell on my back in the street there,
and then about three of them got on top of me.
He said: “You’re going to salute the flag or eat it.
Bring me that flag over there.”
I was praying to Jehovah to remember me in the resurrection.
About that time, several women ran out of the houses on both sides of us:
“Leave those men alone. They didn’t bother you.
Leave them alone. Let them go.”
So they got off of me, and they left us like a bunch of beaten kittens.
I was asked to go to Brooklyn Bethel and become a member of the Bethel home.
Brother Knorr asked me, “Do you know how to use the typewriter?”
I said, “Yes, I can type.”
He said: “Well, I’m going to put you on a machine.
“It’s called a Linotype.
It has three keyboards.”
And he said: “And it will take you about two years to learn it.
Are you willing to accept it?”
And I said, “Yes, I will.”
So I was put on the Linotype.
I got married in the fall of 1945 and left Bethel.
Well, we were invited in 1949
to go into the circuit work.
We were in the 21st class of Gilead.
We enjoyed that course very much.
We received an assignment for Cuba,
and I was assigned as branch overseer.
And in ’63,
the police car came
up to the branch at about ten o’clock at night.
I was told to take my papers,
and we went over to the police station, and so forth.
And sure enough, soon thereafter, here comes an official.
He said, “You have to leave Cuba
because you’re not in favor of the Cuban government.”
A person asked a policeman standing close by, he said,
“Who are these people that are being sent out of the country?”
And they said: “Over there,”
talking about me,
“see that gangster man over there?
He’s the head of it.”
So then we got on the plane and headed back.
I got in contact with Brooklyn Bethel,
talked to Brother Knorr, and he said,
“As soon as you can, in the next day or two, come back to Bethel.”
And Brother Knorr said, “You got back just in time
“to get back on the Linotype machine
to set up a new book we have in Spanish.”
So I did that and got on the Linotype.
And then Brother Knorr told me, he said,
“In 1964, we’re going to have a ten-month course in Gilead
for all branch people who have branch experience.”
Oh, it was very, very good.
We studied a lot, not only the Bible
(we studied a lot on the Bible, discourse and everything)
but we studied a lot of branch material too.
Above everything else, our love for Jehovah should continue to grow.
He knows our thoughts, our mind, our heart.
He goes far beyond what man can do.
And whatever his decision is,
I’ve learned to understand that it’s the best decision.
I have learned that if we obey what the organization says
and what the Bible says, then we’re doing Jehovah’s will;
and that’s my concern
—no regrets whatsoever, none.
Maybe I could’ve done more at times,
but I’m certainly glad that I have taken advantage of it
as much as I have up until now.
And it’s been a happy life.
And I have seen Jehovah’s hand
time and again.

cn.text: ‎我叫赛西尔·约瑟夫·戈夫
‎四十多年前
‎我的视力开始变得越来越差
‎甚至不能阅读
‎我的视野变得很有限
‎我年轻时加入了一个乡村乐队
‎在乐队里弹次中音班卓琴
‎四弦吉他和曼陀林
‎这就是我当时生活中最重要的
‎后来  我开始阅读和学习圣经
‎我很想坚持下去  就离开了乐队
‎我开始做先驱
‎后来被派到得克萨斯州的特克萨卡纳
‎我和一个弟兄出去传道
‎在一户人家门口
‎我举着留声机给一位女士播放演讲
‎这时  大约有15到20个男子围住了我
‎我问其中一个人说
‎你觉得这个演讲怎么样?
‎他说  我要说的不是这个
‎我问你  你向国旗敬礼吗?
‎我说  让我解释一下
‎他说  你不需要解释
‎你到底敬不敬礼?
‎我回答说  我不敬礼
‎他就把我扔了出去
‎我背朝下摔在地上
‎接着  有3个人骑到我的身上
‎他又说  你必须向国旗敬礼
‎否则就把它吃掉
‎你们把那个国旗给我拿来
‎于是我向耶和华祷告
‎求他将来记得要复活我
‎就在那时
‎几个妇女从家里跑过来说
‎放开他们
‎他们又没惹你们  快放手!
‎他们就放开了我
‎然后像过街老鼠一样逃跑了
‎我受到邀请去布鲁克林的伯特利
‎成为伯特利大家庭的一员
‎诺尔弟兄问我
‎你会用打字机吗?
‎我说  会  我可以打字
‎他说  好
‎那你来操作这台机器吧
‎它叫莱诺铸排机  有3个键盘
‎他继续说
‎可能你需要大约两年才能学会
‎你愿意接受这个委派吗?
‎我说  愿意
‎于是  他就让我去操作它了
‎1945年秋天我结婚了
‎然后离开伯特利
‎1949年  我们被邀请从事分区探访工作
‎后来我们参加了第21届基列学校
‎我们非常喜欢基列的课程
‎总部派我们去古巴
‎我要担任分部监督
‎1963年的一个晚上
‎大约10点钟的时候
‎一辆警车来到分部
‎他们告诉我要带上证件去警察局
‎到那之后  不出所料
‎很快就有一个警察来对我说
‎你必须离开古巴
‎因为你对古巴政府不利
‎有人问身边的警察
‎这些要被驱逐出境的人是谁?
‎他们说  你看那边
‎看见那个歹徒了吗?
‎他就是这个组织的头目
‎他们说的就是我
‎后来我们就坐飞机回国了
‎我告诉了诺尔弟兄发生的事
‎诺尔弟兄说  请尽快到伯特利来
‎最好这两天就来
‎他继续说
‎你回来的正是时候
‎我们正需要人来操作莱诺铸排机呢
‎因为有一本西班牙语的新书要出版
‎于是我就又开始操作莱诺铸排机了
‎有一天  诺尔弟兄对我说
‎1964年我们要举行一个
‎为期10个月的基列课程
‎是为在分部担负职责的弟兄设立的
‎这个课程真的非常  非常好
‎我们学了很多圣经知识
‎怎么做演讲等等
‎不仅如此  我们还学习了怎样照管分部
‎我认为最重要的事情就是
‎我们要不断培养对耶和华的爱
‎耶和华清楚了解我们的思想和內心
‎他的思想和作为是人无法企及的
‎我体会到  无论耶和华的决定是什么
‎一定是最好的
‎我也明白了  听从组织的安排
‎也按照圣经说的去做
‎就是在遵行耶和华的旨意了
‎这是我最关心的
‎我这一生没有任何遗憾
‎一点也没有
‎在过去  也许有些事我本来可以做得更好
‎但总的来说  我一直在尽力而为
‎我这一生非常快乐
‎也一次一次地看到了耶和华大能的双手

titles.en: Cecil Goff: I Have No Regrets
titles.cn: 赛西尔·戈夫：一生无悔！

ko.text: ‎대니, 준비 됐니? 우리 차에서 기다리고 있을게.
‎하지만 제 생각은 딴 데 가 있었죠.
‎아킬이 눈치를 채고 제게 별일 없는지 물어봤어요.
‎솔직히, 전 그때 그냥 비디오 게임을 계속하고 싶었지만,
‎그 주 얼마 후에, 아킬이 친구들이랑 같이
‎어느새 아킬에게 제가 하는 비디오 게임을 보여 주게 됐어요.
‎하지만 어떤 걸 할지 잘 선택한다고 했어요.
‎아킬은 고대 로마의 검투사들에 대해 얘기해 주었죠.
‎사람들은 반복적으로 유혈과 살인을 보면서 감각이 둔해졌고
‎이것은 당시에 살던 그리스도인들에게 큰 시험이 됐습니다.
‎아킬은 제가 로마서 12:9의 이 말씀을 근거로 생각해 보게 도와줬죠.
‎여호와의 백성도 재미있게 놀고 즐길 수 있어요.
‎전 단지 현명한 선택을 하고 싶은 겁니다.
‎여호와께 제가 악한 것을 미워한다는 걸 보여 드리고 싶어요.

en.text: ‎I promised Akil I’d go out in service with him after school.
‎Hey, we’re just waiting in the car.
‎And I kept my word,
‎but my head just wasn’t in it.
‎Akil could tell, so he tried to see if everything was OK.
‎Honestly, at the time,
‎I would have rather been playing video games,
‎but I couldn’t tell him that.
‎I mean, he’s a pioneer, a ministerial servant.
‎He wouldn’t understand.
‎Later that week,
‎Akil invited me to go mountain biking with some friends.
‎It was actually really fun.
‎. . . and your croissant.
‎Great, thanks.
‎Please let me know if there’s anything else, OK?
‎All right. Thanks.
‎So, Danny, you’re obviously good at biking.
‎What else do you like to do for fun?
‎OK, so I have this game and it’s called . . .
‎Soon I was showing him my video games.
‎And surprisingly, he liked video games too.
‎But he said he chose to be selective.
‎He began to describe the gladiators in ancient Rome.
‎People would come from all over
‎to watch them fight to the death.
‎And while the spectators weren’t in any physical danger,
‎the real danger came over time.
‎Repeatedly watching the bloodshed and the killing,
‎it was dulling their senses, and they wanted more of it.
‎This was a big test for the Christians who lived back then.
‎Akil helped me to reason on the scripture
‎at Romans 12:9:
‎“Abhor what is wicked; cling to what is good.”
‎So, Danny,
‎the games may have changed over time,
‎but the violence is still the same.
‎I like video games,
‎but I avoid the ones that promote what Jehovah hates.
‎Jehovah’s people can still have fun.
‎And, yeah, we can even play video games.
‎I just want to make wise choices.
‎I want to show Jehovah that I hate wickedness
‎and make his heart glad.

cn.text: ‎我答应阿基勒
‎放学后跟他一起去传道
‎丹尼  准备好了吗?
‎那我在车里等你啊
‎我是跟他去传道了
‎可是心思完全不在这个上面
‎阿基勒看出来了
‎他问我是不是有心事
‎老实说
‎当时  我很想回家继续打游戏
‎但我不能这么跟他说
‎因为我觉得  他是先驱
‎又是助理仆人
‎他是不会理解我的
‎后来  阿基勒邀请我跟几个朋友
‎一起去野外骑车
‎当时玩得真的很开心
‎卢卡斯弟兄跳过去了......
‎-您的牛角包 -谢谢
‎如果有别的需要  请再叫我
‎好的  谢谢
‎丹尼  车技很不错啊
‎你还有别的爱好吗?
‎嗯  我喜欢这个电子游戏......
‎我就给他看我玩的电子游戏
‎没想到  他也喜欢玩电子游戏
‎可是  他说他会小心选择
‎阿基勒让我想想古罗马时期
‎竞技场上的角斗士
‎当时人们从各地赶来
‎就为了看那些角斗士互相厮杀
‎直到拼个你死我活
‎尽管观众在身体上不会受伤
‎但久而久之
‎他们会处于一种更危险的情况
‎因为他们经常观看这些杀人流血的场面
‎就会变得越来越麻木
‎甚至开始喜欢暴力
‎这对当时的基督徒来说
‎是一个很大的考验
‎阿基勒跟我分享了
‎罗马书12:9的经文
‎丹尼  虽然游戏的形式不一样
‎但是暴力还是会造成很大的影响
‎我喜欢电子游戏
‎但如果一个游戏会推崇上帝憎恨的恶事
‎我就会避开
‎耶和华的子民
‎还是可以有各种各样的娱乐活动
‎当然  电子游戏也可以玩
‎只是  我想做明智的选择
‎我很想向耶和华表明
‎我痛恨恶事
‎很想让他的心欢喜

titles.cn: 我该选择什么娱乐？

title: 케네스 플로딘: “더는 이 세상 제도를 따라 틀 잡히지 마십시오”

ko.text: ‎오늘 주제는 ‘이 세상을 따라 틀 잡히지 말라’는 것입니다.
‎고대의 욥은 하느님의 지혜가 비할 데 없이 값지다고 묘사했습니다.
‎욥기 28:17에선 “금과 유리도 그에 비할 수 없다”고 했죠.
‎유리는 욥 시대에도 존재했을 만큼 매우 오래된 겁니다.
‎하지만 공기를 불어넣는 제조 방법은 유리 생산의 혁명을 가져왔습니다.
‎이것은 속이 빈 파이프 안으로 공기를 불어넣어,
‎고온의 녹은 유리를 신속히 원하는 모양으로 틀 잡는 방법이죠.
‎사탄의 제도는 사람들의 정신을 틀 잡는 기술을 발전시켜 왔는데,
‎그렇게 해서 사람들을 쓸모없는 약한 유리그릇처럼 만들어 왔죠.
‎무엇에 따라 세상 사람들의 정신과 태도가 틀 잡히고 있는지
‎그럼, 어떤 나쁜 공기가 정신에 주입되고 있을까요?
‎그리스도인이 되기 전의 불결한 생각과 행동에 관해
‎“세상 제도”의 통치자가 있다고 분명히 알려 줍니다.
‎세상의 생각이 사람들을 어떤 행동으로 이끄는지 보시죠.
‎이런 이유로, 그들은 “멸망받기에 합당한 진노의 그릇”이 됩니다.
‎유리 제조공은 흔히 한 조를 이루어 일합니다.
‎견습생이 속이 빈 파이프를 액체 상태의 유리 속에 담급니다.
‎파이프를 회전시켜 녹은 유리를 모아 덩어리가 되도록 한 다음,
‎평평하고 매끄러운 유리 연마대 위에서 굴려 가며 모양을 잡습니다.
‎조장은 바람을 불어 넣어 유리가 둥근 형태가 되게 만듭니다.
‎그런 다음, 긴 집게를 사용해서 손잡이 부분을 성형합니다.
‎그 후 손잡이 부분에 또 다른 유리 덩어리를 덧붙입니다.
‎그런 다음 제조공은 파이프를 돌려 가면서 잔의 받침 부분을 만들게 됩니다.
‎우리의 정신을 교묘히 틀 잡는 4가지 방법을 간단히 살펴보겠습니다.
‎학교 친구들이나 직장 동료들로부터 올 수 있죠.
‎상황상 피할 수 없는 대인 관계를 사탄이 이용할 거라고 생각지 않으십니까?
‎주변의 압력은 우리 정신에 영향을 줄 수 있죠.
‎그들은 우리의 건전한 도덕관과 말, 품위 있는 옷차림을 비웃을지 모르죠.
‎결과가 안 좋을 게 뻔한 일을 하자고 부추길지도 모릅니다.
‎마치 유리를 판에 대고 계속 굴리듯 말입니다.
‎보시면서 주변 사람들의 압력과 관련 있는 단어를 찾아보시겠습니까?
‎성구에선 주변 사람의 압력 즉 유혹에 굴복하면,
‎이 세상의 영은 또 어떻게 우리의 정신을 틀 잡을까요?
‎사탄과 그 세상이 우리 생각을 틀 잡는 또 다른 방법은 뭘까요?
‎최근에 쇼핑을 하러 가서 구매한 상품들을 생각해 보십시오.
‎특정 브랜드의 옷이나 아침에 먹을 시리얼을 샀을지 모르죠.
‎우리는 항상 합리적으로 따져 보고 제품을 구매할까요?
‎아니면, 광고가 알게 모르게 우리의 선택에 큰 영향을 미쳤을까요?
‎물론 광고가 다 나쁘고 허위라는 건 아닙니다.
‎우리 생활이 물질주의에 빠져들게 될 위험이 커집니다.
‎예를 들어, 광고의 영향으로 시리얼 정도가 아니라
‎하와는 그 광고에 넘어갔고, 끔찍한 결과가 초래됐죠.
‎사탄은 광고를 사용해 예수의 초점도 흐리게 만들려고 했습니다.
‎마태 4장에서 사탄은 ‘그분에게 세상의 모든 왕국을 보여 주며’,
‎한 번만 숭배 행위를 하면 다 주겠다고 했습니다.
‎세상의 또 무엇이 우리의 정신을 왜곡시킬 수 있습니까?
‎마치 조장이 이제 파이프를 손잡이 제조공에게 넘겨주는 것과 같죠.
‎그러면 그는 또 다른 유리 덩어리를 가져다가 몸통에 덧붙입니다.
‎그러곤 붙인 덩어리를 늘려서 손잡이 모양으로 만듭니다.
‎꼭 가깝게 지내는 사람들에게서 오는 건 아니었습니다.
‎우리가 주로 시간을 보내는 대상이 누구인지 하는 것입니다.
‎믿지 않는 사람들과의 교제는 우리의 정신에 변형을 가해,
‎세상이 우릴 붙잡을 수 있는 손잡이를 달아 놓을 수 있습니다.
‎어떤 학교 친구들은 회중 아이들보다 더 낫다고 말하는 걸 들을 때가 있습니다.
‎하지만 대개 그 말은 더 재밌다는 말이지,
‎바울이 고린도 사람들에게 말한 “나쁜 교제”란 어떤 걸 가리킬까요?
‎결국 우리 생각에 영향을 미치고, 생각은 행동에 영향을 주기 때문이죠.
‎그리스도인 경주를 인내로 달리는 것이 무슨 유익이 있겠습니까?
‎사탄은 또 어떤 네 번째 방법으로 우리의 정신을 틀 잡습니까?
‎많은 분이 중앙장로회 성원인 모리스 형제가 한
‎“어떤 교육이 최상의 교육인가?” 라는 연설을 기억하실 겁니다.
‎세속 고등 교육을 추구할 때 어떤 위험이 따르는지도 분명히 언급했습니다.
‎고등 교육의 목적 자체가 생각에 영향을 주는 거죠.
‎단지 장래에 더 안정된 직업을 얻기 위한 의도라 해도,
‎고등 교육을 받는 사람은 비성경적인 생각과 행동에
‎또 다른 유리 덩어리가 손잡이 끝부분에 덧붙여진 걸 기억하시죠.
‎제조공은 그것을 좌우로 굴려서 유리잔의 받침대를 만듭니다.
‎고등 교육에 관해선 모리스 형제가 얘기해 주셨으니
‎그 내용을 다시 시청해 보실 수 있습니다.
‎유리 제조 영상을 통해 작업자들의 기술이 상당함을 보셨을 겁니다.
‎물론 보신 작업장에선 아름답고 유용한 유리 제품을 만듭니다.
‎그런데 사탄의 작업장도 우리 정신을 틀 잡는 기술이 뛰어납니다.
‎여호와께서 쓰실 만한 귀중한 그릇을 만드는 게 아니라,
‎이렇게 잘못 만들어진 잔으로 뭘 할 수 있을까요?
‎고린도 전서 6:20이 좋은 결론이 될 것 같네요.

en.text: ‎The theme is
‎“Stop Being Molded by This System of Things.”
‎In describing godly wisdom,
‎the ancient man Job
‎recognized it as priceless.
‎At Job 28:17, he said:
‎“Gold and glass cannot be compared to it.”
‎Glass —it has been around for centuries,
‎even back in Job’s day.
‎However, what revolutionized glass production
‎was the invention of glassblowing.
‎By blowing through a hollow tube,
‎a glassblower can quickly mold superheated molten glass
‎into a specific shape.
‎Satan’s system has developed the art
‎of shaping the minds of people
‎into fragile glass vessels with little useful purpose.
‎In fact, Romans 9:22 refers to such ones
‎as “vessels of wrath made fit for destruction.”
‎Find with me Romans 12:2.
‎What is responsible for molding and shaping
‎the inclinations of the people of the world?
‎Romans 12:2:
‎“And stop being molded by this system of things,
‎“but be transformed by making your mind over,
‎“so that you may prove to yourselves
‎the good and acceptable and perfect will of God.”
‎To counteract “being molded,” the verse said:
‎“But be transformed by making your mind over.”
‎So the molding of this system is related to our thinking
‎—the shaping of our minds.
‎Well, what evil air is blown down the hollow tube?
‎It’s identified quite clearly for us at Ephesians 2:2, 3.
‎Concerning a Christian’s previous unclean thinking and behavior,
‎verse 2 says:
‎“In which you at one time walked
‎“according to the system of things of this world,
‎“according to the ruler of the authority of the air,
‎the spirit that is now at work in the sons of disobedience.”
‎The verse makes clear that this “system of things” has a ruler.
‎Satan is called “the ruler of the authority of the air.”
‎The verse indicates that “the air” is “the spirit” of the world.
‎Well, with such a mind-set,
‎what kind of behavior does the thinking of the world lead to?
‎Verse 3:
‎“Yes, among them we all at one time conducted ourselves
‎“in harmony with the desires of our flesh,
‎“carrying out the will of the flesh and of our thoughts,
‎and we were naturally children of wrath just as the rest.”
‎For this reason, they become
‎“vessels of wrath made fit for destruction.”
‎Glassblowers often work in groups known as “shops.”
‎An apprentice dips a hollow blowpipe into the liquid glass.
‎By twirling it, he gathers a blob of molten glass.
‎He shapes the blob by rolling it
‎on a smooth surface called a marver.
‎He then passes the tube to the gaffer, or shop master.
‎He blows air into the tube and fashions the glass into a globe.
‎If a wine glass is being made,
‎the tube is then passed to the stem-maker
‎and another gather of glass is attached.
‎It is then shaped by means of long-pointed tongs
‎to form the stem.
‎Then, another gather of hot glass is added to the stem.
‎The craftsman rolls the tube on the arm of his chair.
‎He forms the base of the glass.
‎We will briefly consider four ways
‎that this system subtly tries to shape
‎our mind into Satan’s designs.
‎The first is harmful peer pressure.
‎Now, often this is just an apprentice in Satan’s shop
‎—maybe fellow students in school, fellow workers on the job.
‎Don’t you think Satan will try to capitalize
‎on these circumstantial relationships?
‎Absolutely!
‎Peer pressure —it can have an influence on our mind.
‎They may make fun of our wholesome morals,
‎our clean speech, our dignified dress.
‎That is pressure.
‎Possibly, they invite us to do things that we know will lead to no good.
‎They are twirling us
‎with their thinking, with their taunts,
‎or maybe with their flattery and temptation.
‎They are rolling things over and over in our mind.
‎Turn to 2 Peter 2:18, 19.
‎And as you read this,
‎can you pick out a word that is equivalent to peer pressure?
‎Let’s read
‎“They make high-sounding statements that are empty [like air].
‎“By appealing to the desires of the flesh and with acts of brazen conduct,
‎“they entice [that’s peer pressure] people
‎“who have just escaped from those who live in error.
‎“While they are promising them freedom,
‎“they themselves are slaves of corruption;
‎“for if anyone is overcome by someone,
‎he is his slave.”
‎The verse says that if we are overcome by peer pressure—enticed—
‎we actually become a “slave” of that person.
‎That is scary!
‎It’s dangerous!
‎Peer pressure is deceptively strong.
‎Well, what is another way that the spirit of this system
‎can shape our thinking?
‎You recall that the apprentice passed the glassblowing tube
‎to the gaffer who blew air into the glass, giving it shape.
‎What does Satan and this system next use to mold our thinking?
‎Enticing advertisements.
‎Like the air of a glassblower,
‎advertisements often have little substance.
‎For example, that product we decided to buy
‎when we last went shopping.
‎Maybe it was a brand of clothing
‎or a brand of dry cereal we bought for breakfast.
‎Is that always purely a personal, rational decision on our part?
‎Or did advertising
‎subtly but powerfully affect our choice?
‎Now, it’s not that all advertising is bad or misleading.
‎But the more we allow ourselves to be influenced by it,
‎the more we are in danger of being led into a materialistic way of life.
‎For example, instead of dry cereal,
‎are we now influenced to buy that flashy-looking sports car?
‎Turn to 1 John 2:15-17.
‎This system inflates our thinking by means of “things.”
‎First John 2:15, 16:
‎“Do not love either the world or the things in the world.
‎“If anyone loves the world, the love of the Father is not in him;
‎“because everything in the world
‎“—the desire of the flesh and the desire of the eyes
‎“and the showy display of one’s means of life—
‎“does not originate with the Father,
‎but originates with the world.”
‎Why do we need to resist catering
‎to advertisements that feed the spirit of the world?
‎Verse 17:
‎“Furthermore, the world is passing away
‎“and so is its desire,
‎but the one who does the will of God remains forever.”
‎Remember Eve!
‎Satan advertised the forbidden fruit.
‎The scripture says it was “desirable to the eyes,
‎. . . the tree was pleasing to look at.”
‎She succumbed to the advertisement
‎with disastrous results.
‎Similarly, Satan used advertisements to try to reshape Jesus’ focus.
‎Matthew chapter 4 says that Satan
‎“showed him all the kingdoms of the world,”
‎offering them in exchange for one act of worship.
‎Jesus simply turned him off.
‎Don’t be overly influenced by advertisements.
‎What’s the next aspect of this system that can distort our minds?
‎Bad associations.
‎It is as if the gaffer has now passed the glassblowing tube
‎ to the stem-maker.
‎He takes another gather of molten glass
‎and attaches it to our globe.
‎Then he stretches that associated blob
‎into the form of a stem.
‎Well, we already talked about peer pressure,
‎but that often comes from those who are not necessarily
‎our close associates.
‎What we’re discussing now is our decisions
‎about whom we spend a lot of time with.
‎People who don’t love Jehovah can stretch and misshape our minds,
‎providing a stem or a handle for the world to hold us by.
‎Turn to 1 Corinthians 15:33.
‎Sometimes we hear the phrase that some of the kids in school
‎are nicer than some of the kids in the congregation.
‎But usually, nicer actually means more fun
‎rather than more wholesome.
‎But let’s look at 1 Corinthians 15:33 in its context.
‎What did the apostle Paul mean
‎when he said to the Corinthians “bad associations”?
‎First Corinthians 15:33:
‎“Do not be misled.
‎Bad associations spoil useful habits.”
‎But what made these ones bad association?
‎Let’s see it in context.
‎Look at 1 Corinthians 15:12:
‎“Now if it is being preached that Christ has been raised from the dead,
‎how is it that some among you say there is no resurrection of the dead?”
‎Well, what was the initial problem with these associates?
‎They did not believe the same way.
‎Why would that make them bad associations?
‎Because what an associate believes
‎will eventually affect our thinking,
‎and our thinking affects our behavior.
‎Notice how Paul describes this.
‎Look at 1 Corinthians 15:32.
‎What good is it to endure the rigors of the Christian race for life
‎if there is no resurrection, no future, no hope?
‎Verse 32:
‎“If like other men, I have fought with wild beasts at Ephesus,
‎“of what good is it to me?
‎“If the dead are not to be raised up,
‎‘let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we are to die.’”
‎May all of us avoid bad association
‎whether in person, on TV, or on the Internet.
‎What’s a fourth means by which Satan
‎attempts to fashion us, reshaping our thinking?
‎Higher education.
‎Most of us remember the January 2015 JW Broadcasting program
‎hosted by Brother Morris of the Governing Body.
‎He focused on the value of divine education.
‎But he also reaffirmed
‎the dangers of pursuing higher secular education.
‎Its whole purpose is for learning —influencing one’s thinking.
‎And while a person’s intention might be just to create
‎a stable base for his secular future,
‎his decision could expose him
‎to unscriptural ideas and practices.
‎Back to the glass shop.
‎Recall that another gather of hot glass
‎is added to the end of the stem.
‎The craftsman then rolls the tube backward and forward.
‎He forms the base for the glass.
‎Well, we will say no more about this topic
‎other than what Brother Morris has already shared.
‎You might want to go back and review that broadcast.
‎However, we would like to read 1 Timothy 6:20, 21:
‎“Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you
‎“[that’s divine education],
‎“turning away from the empty speeches that violate what is holy
‎“and from the contradictions
‎“of the falsely called ‘knowledge.’
‎“By making a show of such knowledge,
‎some have deviated from the faith.”
‎Unfortunately, in an effort to make
‎a stable base for one’s financial future,
‎many “have deviated from the faith.”
‎In the visuals of a glassblowing shop,
‎we observed the skill of the workers involved.
‎And that shop obviously produces
‎beautiful, useful glass vessels.
‎Satan’s glass shop is also skilled at shaping one’s thinking.
‎But what does it produce?
‎Instead of a person becoming a valuable vessel that Jehovah can use,
‎Satan is actually mass-producing
‎worthless vessels that Jehovah cannot use.
‎What could you do with this misshaped creation?
‎Nothing —it is useless.
‎At the outset, Romans 9:22 was quoted.
‎Those who conform to Satan’s system are referred to
‎as “vessels of wrath made fit for destruction.”
‎Jehovah has paid a high price for us.
‎Gold and glass cannot be compared to it.
‎May we make over our minds by applying godly wisdom.
‎Glorify Jehovah as a vessel that he can use.
‎First Corinthians 6:20 concludes this discussion nicely, saying:
‎“For you were bought with a price.
‎By all means, glorify God in your body.”

cn.text: ‎本月节目的主题是
‎“不要被这个制度同化”
‎古人约伯看出
‎上帝所赐的智慧是无价的
‎他在约伯记28:17说
‎“黄金和玻璃比不上它”
‎玻璃  早在几千年前
‎约伯的时代就已经存在了
‎随着玻璃吹制术的发明
‎玻璃产品的制作工序也彻底改变了
‎吹制玻璃的人
‎会用一根空心管
‎将熔化的玻璃吹成特定形状
‎撒但的制度也好像吹制玻璃的人
‎正如吹制玻璃的人能改变玻璃的形状
‎撒但的制度也能塑造人的思想
‎让人变成无用的器皿
‎这样的人
‎在罗马书9:22
‎被比作“可怒当灭的器皿”
‎请打开圣经到罗马书12:2
‎世人的思想是怎样被同化
‎被塑造的呢?
‎经文说
‎所以
‎为了不被“同化”
‎经文说“要更新思想而改变自己”
‎可见  经文说的同化
‎与我们的思想有关
‎也就是塑造我们的思想
‎那么  撒但用什么来塑造我们的思想呢?
‎让我们看看以弗所书2:2,3
‎谈到基督徒以往的不洁思想和行为
‎第2节说
‎经文清楚指出
‎“这个世界的制度”有一个统治者
‎就是撒但
‎他也是“掌管不良风气的王”
‎经文也提到
‎这股“风气”
‎就是指世界的精神
‎既然世界的精神来自撒但
‎人的行为会受到什么影响呢?
‎3节说
‎结果  他们就成了“可怒当灭的器皿”
‎在工厂里
‎吹制玻璃的工匠们会分组合作
‎首先  学徒会用空心铁管
‎蘸取一团高温玻璃液
‎他会把这团玻璃液
‎放在光滑的平台上来回滚动
‎之后  他就把这根管子交给领班师傅
‎领班师傅负责向管子里吹气
‎把玻璃液吹成球状
‎如果是制作高脚杯
‎就会由另一个人负责制作杯梗
‎他会再取一些玻璃液
‎用长尖头钳塑形做成杯梗
‎最后  工匠会在杯梗底部
‎加一些玻璃液
‎并来回转动铁管
‎直到杯座完成
‎这个世界怎样从四个方面
‎潜移默化地塑造我们的思想呢?
‎接下来  我们讨论一下
‎第一
‎就是同辈压力
‎这也许来自你的同学  或是同事
‎他们就好像是撒但工厂里的学徒一样
‎有时我们避免不了和这些人接触
‎撒但会不会放过这个好机会呢?
‎当然不会!
‎同辈压力会影响我们的思想
‎比如  同学  同事
‎也许会嘲笑我们的道德标准
‎言谈举止  还有衣着打扮
‎这都是压力
‎他们也可能会引诱我们
‎做一些违反圣经原则的事
‎这些人会扭曲我们的思想
‎方法就是嘲笑  引诱
‎这就好像把我们放在平台上
‎来回滚动一样
‎用这样的方法来塑造我们
‎请翻到彼得后书2:18,19
‎读出这两节经文时
‎请找找哪个词语和同辈压力有关
‎好像空气一样
‎这就是同辈压力
‎经文表明
‎如果我们受引诱
‎被同辈压力制伏
‎就成了他们的“奴隶”
‎这很可怕
‎也很危险!
‎而且是我们察觉不到的
‎这个世界
‎还用什么手段塑造我们的思想呢?
‎回想一下
‎学徒把吹制玻璃的空心管
‎交给领班师傅
‎领班师傅会吹入空气
‎给玻璃塑形
‎撒但和他的制度
‎也用类似的方法塑造我们的思想
‎就是通过广告引诱我们
‎这些广告一般来说
‎很少有实质性的东西
‎就好像吹入铁管的空气一样
‎不妨想一想你最近买的东西
‎比如某个品牌的衣服
‎或某个牌子的麦片
‎我们买东西的时候
‎总是按照个人的需要理性购物吗?
‎还是说
‎不知不觉中
‎受到广告影响了呢?
‎当然  我们不是说所有广告都不好
‎都误导人
‎不过  如果我们做选择时
‎常常受广告影响
‎就会很容易落入物质主义的陷阱
‎比如说
‎我们容许自己受广告影响挑选麦片
‎是不是也可能受影响
‎去买很炫的跑车呢?
‎请翻到约翰一书2:15-17
‎这个世界不断鼓吹物质主义
‎想要塑造我们的思想
‎先来看看约翰一书2:15,16
‎为什么要小心
‎不要迎合源于这个世界的广告呢?
‎17节说
‎要记住夏娃的教训!
‎撒但为禁果做广告
‎经文说
‎夏娃看禁果
‎“十分好看  实在赏心悦目”
‎她受广告引诱
‎带来致命的结果
‎撒但也曾企图用广告

en.text: ‎Right now I am serving in the Central America branch,
‎and I have the opportunity to work with extraordinary brothers and sisters
‎—both here and in other parts of the world.
‎My name is Rogelio.
‎I’m part of the Art Department,
‎and I’m a digital illustrator.
‎Music really means the world to me.
‎I am Joyce; I’m a pioneer,
‎and I sing alto in the Bethel chorus.
‎My name is Lou-Len,
‎and I serve as a regular pioneer in a congregation where there’s a need.
‎I love doing that.
‎My life is wonderful.
‎Seeing people’s faces light up when you teach them God’s name
‎or when you tell them of Jehovah’s promises for us
‎fills me with great joy.
‎My name is Josué Martell.
‎I serve as a regular pioneer
‎and as an elder in the congregation.
‎Ever since I was little,
‎I’ve always loved playing soccer, and that was my biggest dream.
‎My goal was to become a professional soccer player.
‎The truth is, setting goals was always difficult for me
‎because I always had two passions,
‎‘Am I a servant of Jehovah or an artist?’
‎My goal was to become the best gymnast in the world.
‎At that moment,
‎gymnastics were number one in my life.
‎I played at big festivals.
‎Standing ovations
‎—that was amazing.
‎I was surrounded by non-Witnesses
‎who were using drugs, smoking, and swearing.
‎My trainer had mapped out a complete training program
‎with the Olympics as a goal.
‎This made me feel trapped.
‎I started thinking, ‘What do I want to do with my life?’
‎More importantly, ‘What does Jehovah want?’
‎When I was studying design, I was already a regular pioneer.
‎It wasn’t easy for me to come to the understanding
‎that the one who really matters is Jehovah.
‎When I was 16 years old,
‎different teams started offering me high-paying contracts.
‎I felt a lot of pressure, and it was a temptation
‎because they would constantly call me and come to my house.
‎I noticed that when the players played the sport,
‎they were happy, but afterwards they weren’t.
‎My mother was in the full-time service, and I saw her happiness.
‎That motivated me because I too wanted
‎to experience that lasting happiness.
‎I felt a little guilty when I thought of how much of myself
‎I was giving to design and art and all of that.
‎So that’s when I made my decision.
‎I decided to leave university and focus on my service.
‎I realized that for a long time I hadn’t been growing spiritually.
‎I prayed intensely to Jehovah.
‎I asked: “Do I know you?
‎Do I live the way you would want?”
‎And after that,
‎I stopped performing with non-Witnesses.
‎I prayed to Jehovah.
‎And then, at the convention,
‎we received the DVD Young People Ask —What Will I Do With My Life?
‎That really was Jehovah’s answer
‎to my prayer.
‎In the Bible it says
‎that “the truth will set you free.”
‎That freedom is something I never used to feel.
‎I love working together with other sisters in the ministry
‎and seeing how they share my enthusiasm for making return visits
‎and conducting Bible studies.
‎It’s just wonderful to see!
‎To wake up each day knowing
‎that I am going to do something new for Jehovah is extraordinary.
‎It’s an unbelievable blessing; it’s like living a dream.
‎I feel that I belong to a global organization
‎and we are all going in the same direction.
‎It’s something really wonderful for me.
‎To sing for Jehovah is the most beautiful privilege
‎I could ever imagine.
‎One of the biggest blessings
‎is that I have a real friendship with Jehovah
‎and friendships with my brothers and sisters —young or old.
‎It doesn’t matter.
‎I am really happy that when Jehovah looks at me,
‎I feel his approval.
‎That makes me happy.
‎My trust in Jehovah has grown stronger.
‎The way I communicate with him continues to improve.
‎And I also love my assignment
‎of being a regular pioneer, an elder, and being able to support
‎the brothers and sisters.
‎To continue to be among Jehovah’s people,
‎that’s the joy I was looking for
‎—and I found it!
